Kennedy. Sep 15, 2017. [https://weatherfactory.biz/fucine-was-spoken-in-the-dry-country-it-is-the-language-of-witches/ "Fucine was spoken in the dry country. It is the language of witches. It shares words with High Aeolic."]Alexis Kennedy. March 16, 2018. [https://weatherfactory.biz/weather-factory-at-gdc-and-actual-tantric-phrase-or-occult-invention/ Weather Factory at GDC; and ACTUAL TANTRIC PHRASE OR OCCULT INVENTION] Fucine is based on Marsian, the language on the lost "Bronze of Lake Fucinus", a bronze tablet that was found at Lake Fucino. *Before the addition of the "[[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via X]]" aspects, Fucine was one of three skills that could not be used to upgrade any [[Elements of the Soul]]. ==References== {{Skills Navbox}} [[Category:Language]] [[Category:Skill]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Knock]]

Cracktrack.title: Cracktrack
Cracktrack.text:
[[File:Cracktrack Icon.png|right|64x64px]] {{Quote|A primal language.}} '''Cracktrack''' is a [[Languages|Language]]. There are few [[Readable|Readables]] written in Cracktrack, mostly from the [[Dawn Period]], but half of them contain [[Numen|Numina]]. [[Lalla Chaima]] and [[Fr. Stanislav John Schaller]] understand Cracktrack, and can teach it to the Librarian for 1 [[Tally]]. If either is present at a [[Salon]], a language [[Memory|Lesson]] may result from conversing with them. ==Skill== {{BoH Skill |title1=Cracktrack |wisdoms=[[Illumination]]
[[Preservation]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Nectar}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Scale}} |image1=Cracktrack Skill.png}} {{Quote|In the Tracks of Beasts, in the Convolutions of his own Carapace, in Egg-vein and Shell-shadow, the Many-Eyed One found the Signs which can be History.}} As a skill, Cracktrack has 2 {{Lore|Nectar}} and 1 {{Lore|Scale}}. Languages cannot be used in crafting recipes, but can be used to explore the [[The Tree of Wisdoms|Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{Quote|Cracktrack was a gift from the light above the world. When Glory touched the first life-motes with this language, they entered the waking world. They were Illuminated.|A Tongue of Sky}} Committing Cracktrack to [[Illumination]] provides [[Phost]] (2 {{Lore|Lantern}}, 1 {{Lore|Sky}}), which can be evolved at the [[Practice Equipment]]. {{Quote|Cracktrack is the native tongue of the living world. As long as Cracktrack is spoken, in cloud-shape and hill-form, life persists. This is a matter of Preservation.|A Tongue of Earth}} Committing Cracktrack to [[Preservation]] provides [[Chor]] (2 {{Lore|Heart}}, 1 {{Lore|Grail}}), which can be evolved at [[Altar: Malachite]]. ==Books== The following books are written in Cracktrack. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Book !! Principle !! Lesson !! Memory |- | [[The Sun Disfigured]] || 10 {{Lore|Grail}} || 2x [[Applebright Euphonies]] || [[Numen: the Sun's Weakness]] (5 {{Lore|Grail}}, 5 {{Lore|Lantern}}, 5 {{Lore|Moth}}) |- | [[Green Jasper Tablet]] || 10 {{Lore|Nectar}} || 2x [[Rites of the Roots]] || [[Memory: Impulse]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}) |- | [[Serpent-Root]] || 10 {{Lore|Nectar}} || 2x [[Rites of the Roots]] || [[Numen: Loopholes]] (5 {{Lore|Knock}}, 5 {{Lore|Moon}}, 5 {{Lore|Moth}}) |- | [[The Sun's Design]] || 10 {{Lore|Lantern}} || 2x [[Watchman's Paradoxes]] || [[Numen: the Paths of the Sun]] (5 {{Lore|Forge}}, 5 {{Lore|Knock}}, 5 {{Lore|Lantern}}) |- | [[White Jade Tablet]] || 14 {{Lore|Moth}} || 2x [[Rites of the Roots]] || [[Memory: Impulse]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}) |- | [[Echidnalia]] || 21 {{Lore|Scale}} || 3x [[Stone Stories]] || [[Memory: Impulse]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}) |} ==Trivia== *Cracktrack was not an available language in [https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Cultist_Simulator_Wiki Cultist Simulator]. *It appears to be inspired by the oracle-bone script of ancient China.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oracle_bone_script The "Many-Eyed One" may be a version of Cangjie, the mythological creator, or rather discoverer, of Chinese. In one version of the myth, Cangjie was ordered by the Yellow Emperor to find a better way to keep records, and discovered lines on the shell of a female tortoise, which he realized were words. He then observed all manner of natural phenomena to find more.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cangjie *More books containing Numina are written in Cracktrack than any other language. {{Skills Navbox}} [[Category:Language]] [[Category:Skill]] [[Category:Nectar]] [[Category:Scale]]

Kernewek Henavek.title: Kernewek Henavek
Kernewek Henavek.text:
[[File:Henavek Icon.png|alt=Kernewek Henavek icon|right]] {{Quote|A forgotten language.}}
'''Kernewek Henavek''' is a [[Languages|Language]]. There are very few [[Readable|Books]] written in Henavek, likely due to its nature as a mostly forgotten tongue. [[Professor Rowena Hengerst]] and [[Dr Yvette Southey]] understand Henavek, and either can teach it for 1 [[Tally]]. During a [[Salon]] that includes Yvette, or both [[Sr. Corso Reverte]] and [[The Smithy|Denzil]], or both [[Mr Fraser Strathcoyne]] and [[Magister Hokobald]], random conversation may produce a language [[Memory#Lessons|Lesson]]. ==Skill== {{BoH_Skill |title1=Kernewek Henavek |wisdoms=[[The Bosk]]
[[Ithastry]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Scale}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Forge}} |image1=s.henavek.png}} {{Quote|Kernewek Henavek; the oldest form of the language now called Cornish; or something even older.}}
As a [[Skills|Skill]], Kernewek Henavek starts with {{Lore|Scale|2}} and {{Lore|Forge|1}}. Languages cannot be used in [[Crafting]] recipes, but can be used to explore the [[The Tree of Wisdoms|Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{Quote|A farmers' proverb in Brancrug: 'What starts in the roots, ends in the sky.' A superstition goes with it, that before a child's first birthday you should leave her for a summer night sleeping in the roots of an apple-tree, to make sure she grows tall and straight-backed. Not many pay heed to the superstition now, but everyone remembers the proverb. It would probably count as Bosk.|The Roots}}
Committing Kernewek Henavek to [[The Bosk]] provides [[Health]] ({{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}, {{Lore|Scale|1}}), which can be evolved at [[Deeplight Corals]] or the [[Chrysalis]]. {{Quote|A smiths' proverb in Brancrug: 'What starts in the sky, ends in the earth.' A story goes with it, that the village smith's anvil in the time of the Dewulfs was hatched from a meteor stone, and so every plough in the village knows something of the stars. Not many remember the story, but everyone remembers the proverb. It would probably count as Ithastry.|The Stars}}
Committing Kernewek Henavek to [[Ithastry]] provides [[Wist]] ({{Lore|Winter|2}}, {{Lore|Lantern|1}}), which can be evolved at [[Shrine: the Madrugad]] or the [[Oubliette Containment]]. ==Books== The following books are written in Kernewek Henavek. {| class="article-table" |- ! Book !! colspan=2|Principle !! Lesson !! Memory |- | ''[[The Most Sorrowful End of the Lady Nonna]]'' || {{Lore|Nectar}} || 4 || [[Herbs & Infusions]] || [[Memory: Impulse|Impulse]] ({{Lore|Moth|2}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}) |- | ''[[The Tripled Heart]]'' || {{Lore|Grail}} || 4 || [[Tridesma Hiera]] || [[Memory: Intuition|Intuition]] ({{Lore|Moon|2}}, {{Lore|Rose|2}}) |- | ''[[Ud Rocashaas]]'' || {{Lore|Scale}} || 10 || [[Stone Stories]] (x2) || [[Memory: Impulse|Impulse]] ({{Lore|Moth|2}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}) |} == Trivia == * This is the only esoteric language in Book of Hours that does not have a Numen associated with it. * "Kernewek" is the endonym of Cornish, a real Celtic language, which had died out before the 19th century but has since been reconstructed.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cornish_language "Henavek" is a reconstructed Cornish word meaning "elder," as the original term has been lost.https://www.cornishdictionary.org.uk/?locale=en#henavek&sln=kw * Both [[Ericapaean]] and Kernewek Henavek have one teacher outside of Numa: [[Dr Yvette Southey]]. As she may be removed from the game due to [[Further Stories]] choices, Salons can provide Lessons instead if the player missed their chance. {{Skills Navbox}} [[Category:Language]] [[Category:Skill]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Scale]] [[Category:The Bosk]] [[Category:Ithastry]]

Deep Mandaic.title: Deep Mandaic
Deep Mandaic.text:
[[File:Deep Mandaic Icon.png|right]] {{Quote|A resonant language.}} __NOTOC__
'''Deep Mandaic''' is a [[Languages|Language]], once used in the [https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Shadowless_Empire Shadowless Empire]. [[Readable]]s written in Deep Mandaic are primarily from the [[Dawn Period]]. [[Ms Azita Bukhara]], [[Mr Ehsan Fekri]], [[Lord Franklin Bancroft]], and [[Magister Hokobald]] understand Deep Mandaic, and can teach it for 1 [[Tally]]. If any of these Visitors are present at a [[Salon]], random conversation with them may produce a language [[Memory|Lesson]]. ==Skill== {{BoH Skill |image1=Deep Mandaic Skill.png |wisdoms= *[[Horomachistry]] *[[Ithastry]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Forge}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Lantern}}}} {{Quote|The most secret script of the innermost rites of the deep sects of the deep desert. The birth-tongue, it is claimed, of the Mother of Ants herself.}}
As a Skill, Deep Mandaic starts with {{Lore|Forge|2}} and {{Lore|Lantern|1}}. Languages cannot be used in [[Crafting]] recipes, but can be used to explore [[The Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{Quote|There is a story known to jewellers: of a guild-master who made a wager with a keeper of butterflies. The master-jeweller claimed his jewelled egg would hatch something greater than any of the butterfly-keeper's chrysalids. Of course, after a month, the butterfly-keeper's gardens were bright with wings and the egg had hatched nothing at all. The jeweller, unable to pay his debts, fled into the desert with his egg. Horomachistry teaches us: know your limits.|The Jeweller's Tale}}
Committing Deep Mandaic to [[Horomachistry]] provides {{Soul|Mettle}} ({{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Edge|1}}), which can be evolved at the [[Great Clock]], [[Telescope]] or [[Shrine: the Chancel]] (if ''[[Mihail in Glory]]'' was put inside). {{Quote|There is a story known to candle-makers: of a guild-master who made a wager with a master of the potter's guild. The potter's oldest cup (she said) was older far than the chandler's oldest candle. However often one drinks from a cup, it can always be refilled. So they brought their witnesses to the judging on the appointed day, and the potter's witness brought a cup he had used for seventy years until its shattering. But the chandler's witness brought a candle seventy-seven years old: every month, the chandler had bought the old stumps, returned their matter to the vat, and used them in his wares, so that each newest candle was also the oldest. Ithastry teaches us: there's always a way.|The Chandler's Tale}}
Committing Deep Mandaic to [[Ithastry]] provides {{Soul|Phost}} ({{Lore|Lantern|2}}, {{Lore|Sky|1}}), which can be evolved at [[Shrine: the Madrugad]], [[Instrument: Bells]], or [[Oubliette Containment]]. ==Books== The following items are written in Deep Mandaic. {| class="article-table sortable" |- !Book!!Type!! colspan="2" |Principle!! colspan="2" |Lesson!! colspan="3" |Memory |- |''[[A Second Glory]]''|| rowspan="4" |[[Codex]]|| data-sort-value="W12" |{{Lore|Winter}}||12||[[Snow Stories]]||x2||[[Memory: Hindsight]]||{{Lore|Scale}}

Ericapaean.title: Ericapaean
Ericapaean.text:
[[File:Ericapaean Icon.png|right]] {{Quote|An elegant language.}} __NOTOC__
'''Ericapaean''' is a [[Languages|Language]]. There are few books written in Ericapaean, but two of them contain [[Numen|Numina]]. [[Julian Coseley]] and [[Dr Yvette Southey]] understand Ericapaean, and can teach it if paid 1 [[Tally]]. With [[House of Light]], you can potentially draw an Ericapaean Lesson if you invite both [[Mr Peter Agdistis|Peter Agdistis]] and [[The Rector|Reverend Timothy]], or both [[Sr. Corso Reverte]] and [[Lt Arthur Thomas Moore (Ret.)]] to a [[Salon]], despite none of these four Visitors knowing Ericapaean themselves. ==Skill== {{BoH_Skill |primary_principle={{Lore|Lantern}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Winter}} |image1=Ericapaean.png |wisdoms=[[Hushery]]
[[Illumination]]}} {{Quote|A language of surpassing beauty and allusiveness, revealed through the ecstatic apprehensions of the Orphics, the Eleusinians, and the Sibyls of the Rhine. Ericapaean, these mystics claimed, allows the elaboration of hues, sensations and states of mind too subtle for grosser tongues.}} As a skill, Ericapaean provides 2 {{Lore|Lantern}} and 1 {{Lore|Winter}}. Languages can not be used in crafting recipes, but can be used to explore the [[The Tree of Wisdoms|Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{Quote|There is a story told by students of silence: that a great and golden King held the only key to his deepest prison cell. One day he gave the key to his minister, and offered him a choice: to submit to execution, or to visit the cell and tell him what he found there. The minister made the wiser choice, and returned to show the King what he had found in the cell: a mirror. 'Then I release you,' the King declared. The minister left the palace that same day. His reflection, of course, said nothing at all.|The King in the Mirror}} Committing Ericapaean to [[Hushery]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), which can be evolved at the [[Columbic Sarcophagus]] or the [[Catacombs Altar]]. {{Quote|There is a story told by students of light: that a great and golden King held the only key to his deepest prison cell. One day he asked his minister to make eight copies, and distribute them among the people. 'But Sire,' the minister said, 'if a rebel contrives to enter our palace, might they not release their confederates?' 'They might,' answered the King. 'But all kingdoms fall, and one day I might myself seek release from that cell.'|The King and the Key}} Committing Ericapaean to [[Illumination]] provides [[Phost]] (2 {{Lore|Lantern}}, 1 {{Lore|Sky}}), which can be evolved at the [[Practice Equipment]] or [[Shrine: the Watchman]]. ==Books== The following books are written in Ericapaean. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Hill & Hollow.title: Hill & Hollow
Hill & Hollow.text:
{{BoH Skill |image1=Hill_&_Hollow.png |title1=Hill & Hollow |wisdoms=[[Preservation]]
[[Birdsong]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moon}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Scale}} |special_ability=Effective Against [[Infestation]]}} {{Quote|The ways of the hill-children and the gods-from-stone. Old paths, old secrets, the songs that still echo beneath the earth.}}
'''Hill & Hollow''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Moon}} and 1 {{Lore|Scale}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|In the beginning, the Carapace Cross served the first Hours, the gods born from stone. And the first of the Carapace Cross were the Thritige-kind, who sought the Monarch-at-the-Crossroads to rule them wisely and found him in themselves, who began as many and ended as one. This is a riddle, and the riddlemakers know its importance.|How They Began|}}
Committing Hill & Hollow to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Chor]] (2 {{Lore|Heart}}, 1 {{Lore|Grail}}) but cannot evolve Chor by itself. It will need a memory that has the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Birdsong]] aspect, for example [[Forbidden Epic]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as [[Practic Garden|Practic Garden Dummy]]. {{quote|In the beginning, the Carapace Cross served the first Hours, the gods born from stone. When the gods-from-stone were defeated, where could the Cross go? Into the hills; into the Bounds; and into us. This is how humankind came to be, and in our most secret hollows, the Cross endures. This is a matter of Preservation.|How They Endured}} Committing Hill & Hollow to [[Preservation]] provides [[Health]] (1 {{Lore|Heart}} 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}, 1 {{Lore|Scale}}), but cannot evolve Health by itself. It will need a memory that has the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Preservation]] aspect, for example [[Old Moment]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as [[Practic Garden|Practic Garden Dummy]]. == Acquiring the Skill == ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Herbs & Infusions.title: Herbs & Infusions
Herbs & Infusions.text:
{{BoH_Skill |image1=Herbs & Infusions.png |wisdoms=[[Preservation]]
[[The Bosk]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Heart}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Nectar}} |special_ability=Effective Against [[Corruption]]}} {{quote|Pluck it, powder it, mix it, warm it, drink it. But not that one.}} '''Herbs & Infusions''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Heart}} and 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|In the inmost walled garden of the palace of the Shadowless Kings in Persia, there grew a yew-tree older than any other. Its root was red, its flowers were black, its berries were white. The Kings would leave their girl-children overnight in the nest of its roots, in memory of the great Mother of their line, and so their daughters were assured health, longevity and wisdom. This is the source of all our science, and this is Bosk.|The Root and the Source}} Committing Herbs & Infusions to [[The Bosk]] provides [[Ereb]] (2 {{Lore|Grail}}, 1 {{Lore|Edge}}), and can be evolved at the [[Calicite Altar]]. {{quote|In the inmost walled garden of the palace of the Shadowless Kings in Persia, there was preserved a yew-tree older than any other. The Kings set a bee-hive in its branches, in memory of their forefathers, and they brewed from its flowers a sovereign cure against all poisons. This is the root of all our science, and this is Preservation.|The Source and the Root}} Committing Herbs & Infusions to [[Preservation]] provides [[Health]] (1 {{Lore|Heart}} 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}, 1 {{Lore|Scale}}), and can be upgraded at the [[Barber's Chair]], [[Instrument: Hallowed Drum]], or [[Altar: Malachite]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Books !! Principle !! Language !! [[Skolekosophy]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Grail}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Nectar}}}} {{quote|There is no greed without beauty.}} '''Orchids & Narcotics''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card. that starts with 2 {{Lore|Grail}} and 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|Learn from blood and drink from the earth. Pearl & Tide.text:
{{BoH_Skill |image1=Pearl & Tide.png |wisdoms=[[Nyctodromy]]
[[The Bosk]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Rose}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Moon}}}} {{quote|The depths of the sea, the waves upon the shore, and the memories of their withdrawal.}} '''Pearl & Tide''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Rose}} and 1 {{Lore|Moon}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The Sea accepts every gift it is given, and sometimes, now and then, those gifts are returned. The Red Grail slew the Hour named Tide, and what remained was given to the Sea; so, perhaps, one day, that Hour might return. This is life, and so this is Bosk.|What Returns}} Committing Pearl & Tide to [[The Bosk]] provides [[Health]] (1 {{Lore|Heart}} 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}, 1 {{Lore|Scale}}), which can be evolved at the [[Altar of the Knot]], the [[Calicite Altar]], or [[Deeplight Corals]]. {{quote|The Sea: whale-road, salt-realm, moon-way. Anything given to the waves may find another home - unless its home is the Sea. Chandlery.title: Chandlery
Chandlery.text:
[[File:Chandlery.png|right]] {{Quote|A skill that can be used, with suitable ingredients, to make candles. [The most likely ingredients are beeswax and herbs; but to confound villagers and visitors, leave a meaningful pause before the word 'suitable.']}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Aspects|Aspect]] present in several [[Skill]]s, which allows the Librarian to [[Crafting|Craft]] [[Candle]]s in any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that can take [[Material]]s or [[Fuel]], by adding [[Beeswax]]. Specific plants ([[Flower]]s, and [[Pyrus Auricalcinus]]) can be added to create a specific scented-candle. There is no requirement on [[Principles]] or their levels. The following Skills have [[Chandlery]]: * [[Glaziery & Lightsmithing]] * [[Insects & Nectars]] * [[Pyroglyphics]] * [[Transformations & Liberations]] All of these skills can create all Candles, provided the Workstation can fit the components.Note that if you place the Skill first before the wax, the game will default to Crafting regular stuff instead of Candles (similarly to Reading vs Crafting). Use the small triangle near the "Craftable" tab to reset Skill to Chandlery. Since all non-trivial recipes require adding a Flower or [[Sustenance]] possessing {{Lore|Nectar}} in addition to Beeswax, [[Kitchen Range: Gaol]] is probably best suited for Chandlery, as it not only accepts them all (all [[Workstations#Kitchen Ranges|Kitchen ranges]] do since all have {{Lore|Nectar}}), but also supports three out of four suitable Skills as well (with the exception of Transformations & Liberations). The [[Dispensary]] is also a good choice (can be used with Transformations & Liberations and Insects & Nectars), but it unfortunately doesn't accept Sustenance. {{#lst:Light|craftable.lights.list}} [[Category:Aspect]] [[Category:Skill]] [[Category:Crafting]]

Sabazine.title: Sabazine
Sabazine.text:
[[File:Sabazine Icon.png|64x64px|right]] {{quote|An enigmatic language.}} '''Sabazine''' is a [[Languages|Language]]. Of the five Sabazine texts, one houses a [[Numen]] and another is [[Multitudinuous]]. [[Dr Ibn al-Adim]] and [[Lt Arthur Thomas Moore (Ret.)|Lt Arthur Thomas Moore]] understand Sabazine, and can teach it for 1 [[Tally]]. If either is present at a [[Salon]], random conversation with them may produce a language [[Memory|Lesson]]. ==Skill== {{BoH Skill |title1=Sabazine |wisdoms=[[Birdsong]]
[[Horomachistry]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moth}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Lantern}} |image1=Sabazine.png}} {{Quote|There is a History where Alexander defeated first the Great Knot of Sabazos, and then the King of Kings. There is another History where, instead, he learnt from them. How many more? If we curl our hands into the correct shapes, we may yet understand.}} As a skill, Sabazine starts with 2 [[Moth]] and 1 [[Lantern]]. Languages cannot be used in crafting recipes, but can be used to explore the [[The Tree of Wisdoms|Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|There's a story told by fisherfolk, about a city of amber and orichalcum that lies behind the waves. Those who eat of its fruits can breathe water and drink light, but they can never drink anything else afterwards. Only in another History, they say; but with if you tie your nets right, you might just catch one of its citizens in this History, and they might just tell you the way.|The Fisher's Tale}} Committing Sabazine to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), but cannot be used to evolve Trist by itself. It will need a memory with the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Birdsong]] aspect, for example [[Ascendant Harmony]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as [[Instrument: Piano]]. {{quote|There's a story told by sailors, about a city of ivory and iron across the sea. Those who come there never die, but those who leave again have never lived. Only in another History, they say; but if you rig your sails right, you might just catch the wind that takes you there in this one.|The Sailor's Tale}} Committing Sabazine to [[Horomachistry]] provides [[Fet]] (2 {{Lore|Rose}}, 1 {{Lore|Moth}}), which can then be evolved at [[Shrine: the Chancel]] or [[Altar: St Tentreto]]. ==Books== The following books are written in Sabazine. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Book !! Principle !! Lesson !! Memory |- | [[The Carbonek Schism]] || 6 {{Lore|Moth}} || 1x [[Sacra Limiae]] || [[Memory: Hindsight]] (1 {{Lore|Scale}}, 2 {{Lore|Winter}}) |- | [[An Echo of Silence]] || 10 {{Lore|Moth}} || 2x [[Sacra Limiae]] || [[Memory: Impulse]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}) |- | [[Unhatched Hymns]] || 10 {{Lore|Lantern}} || 2x [[Sacra Solis Invicti]] || [[Savage Hymn]] (2 {{Lore|Scale}}, 2 {{Lore|Sky}}) |- | [[The Sky in the Scar]] || 10 {{Lore|Edge}} || 2x [[Sickle & Eclipse]] || [[Numen: Back Into Balance]] (5 {{Lore|Heart}}, 5 {{Lore|Sky}}, 5 {{Lore|Winter}}) |- | [[Naenian Sketches]] || 21 {{Lore|Winter}} || 3x [[Sights & Sensations]] || [[Memory: Hindsight]] (1 {{Lore|Scale}}, 2 {{Lore|Winter}}) |} ==Trivia== *Sabazine was not an available language in [https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Cultist_Simulator_Wiki Cultist Simulator]. *The name "''Sabazine''" likely derives from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabazios Sabazios], a sky-god from [[Phrygian]] mythology[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabazios]. The skill description references Alexander defeating the Great Knot of Sabazios -- a reference to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gordian_Knot Gordian Knot], which [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gordias King Gordias] dedicated to Sabazios when he founded the city of Gordium. {{Skills Navbox}} [[Category:Language]] [[Category:Skill]] [[Category:Lantern]] [[Category:Moth]]

Surgeries & Exsanguinations.text:
{{BoH_Skill|wisdoms=[[Hushery]]

There are subtler tools than either.}} '''Solutions & Separations''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Moth}} and 1 {{Lore|Knock}}. == Wisdom Attunement == {{quote|The world is all imbalance, and imbalance is opportunity. Moth knows that; Worms prove it. This is Skolekosophy.|The Crooked}} Committing Solutions & Separations to [[Skolekosophy]] provides [[Shapt]] (2 {{Lore|Knock}}, 1 {{Lore|Forge}}), which can be upgraded at the [[Condignator]]. It can also be evolved at the [[Rowenarium (Workstation)|Rowenarium]] if the [[The Affair of the Endless Guest|Affair of the Endless Guest]] is concluded with Spencer Hobson entering the Rowenarium. {{quote|The world is all imbalance. With time, with care, with ingenuity, we can restore the balance, through the shaping of stone, the equilibrium of ichors, the unhatching of the egg. Ithastry teaches ingenuity.|The Straight}} Committing Solutions & Separations to [[Ithastry]] provides [[Wist]] (2 {{Lore|Winter}}, 1 {{Lore|Lantern}}) which can be upgraded at the [[Exercise Yard]]. ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Books !! Principle !! Language !! Vak.title: Vak
Vak.text:
[[File:Vak Icon.png|right]] {{Quote|A bold language.}} __NOTOC__
'''Vak''' is a [[Skill]] and a [[Languages|Language]]. In ''[https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Cultist_Simulator_Wiki Cultist Simulator]'', Vak is referred to as the language of [https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Mansus The Mansus]. [[Princess Coquille Amirejibi]] and [[Dr Arun Peel]] understand Vak, and can teach it for 1 [[Tally]]. If either is present at a [[Salon]], random conversation with them may produce a language [[Memory|Lesson]]. ==Skill== {{BoH_Skill |image1=Vak.png |wisdoms= *[[Birdsong]] *[[Nyctodromy]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Knock}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Rose}}}} {{Quote|Before gods arose from blood, before ever ape stood upright, this was the language heard in the House of the Sun.... 'I am Vak,' the Peacock Door boasted, 'both the tongue and the Goddess. I am the only entrance into secret light. I was worshipped before you upright apes, and I will be still when all of you are ugly ash. Listen, and I will prove it.'}}
As a skill, Vak starts with {{Lore|Knock|2}} and {{Lore|Rose|1}}. Languages cannot be used in [[Crafting]] recipes, but can be used to explore [[The Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{Quote|Something not commonly understood: were there no Calyptra to conceal perilous knowledge, there could be no Vak. A door opens both ways. This is understood by scholars of the Arts Unregarded.|An Opportunity}} Committing Vak to [[Birdsong]] provides {{Soul|Chor}} ({{Lore|Heart|2}}, {{Lore|Grail|1}}), but cannot be used to evolve {{Soul|Chor}} by itself. It will require a memory with the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Birdsong]] aspect, such as [[Ascendant Harmony]], and can then be evolved at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that accepts the relevant principles, such as [[Mirrors]]. {{Quote|Something not commonly understood: without Vak, the exception, there could be no Calyptra, the law. Vak is in this sense, and perhaps in every sense, Calyptra's servant. This is known to scholars of the Night Arts.|An Arrangement}} Committing Vak to [[Nyctodromy]] provides {{Soul|Fet}} ({{Lore|Rose|2}}, {{Lore|Moth|1}}), which can be evolved at [[Shrine: St Januarius]] or [[Altar: St Tentreto]]. ==Books== The following [[Books]] are written in Vak: {| class="article-table sortable" |- ! Ramsund.title: Ramsund
Ramsund.text:
[[File:Ramsund Icon.png|right|64x64px]] {{Quote|A lively language.}} '''Ramsund''' is a [[Languages|Language]]. Only two books are written in it, but one houses a [[Numen]]. [[Mme Olympe Bechet]], [[Daymare]], and [[Mr Fraser Strathcoyne]] understand Ramsund, and can teach it for 1 [[Tally]]. If any of these Visitors are present at a [[Salon]], random conversation with them may produce a language [[Memory|Lesson]]. ==Skill== {{BoH_Skill |image1=Ramsund.png |title1=Ramsund |wisdoms=[[Birdsong]]
[[Preservation]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moth}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Sky}}}} {{Quote|This language has been called 'mantiq al-tair' and 'lenga aucel' and 'the speech of birds' and 'Ramsund' and 'the hazelnut tongue', but it's a language of secrets, and its true name may never be used. The aviform Hours use it at their Roost, or so the story goes.}} As a skill, Ramsund starts with 2 {{Lore|Moth}} and 1 {{Lore|Sky}}. Languages cannot be used in crafting recipes, but can be used to explore the [[The Tree of Wisdoms|Tree of Wisdoms]]. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{Quote|There's a very old story told by falconers about the aviform Hours - the secret gods who take the shape of birds. Once there were only five - the dove, the crow, the laughingthrush, the twin kites. The sixth had fallen to the talons of an owl, and they sought another to join their company. But the crow rejected half of all those they found, for the dowdiness of their plumage, and the dove rejected the others, for being too gaudy. At last they found a night-bird whose feathers were both the perfect white and the perfect black of the crow and of the dove. But once they had accepted him they learnt he was no bird at all - only a night-flitting moth. Fortunately for the moth, their pride kept them from admitting their mistake; but since that day, the aviform Hours will only meet at night, when the sixth of their kind won't be unmasked.|The Falconer's Tale}} Committing Ramsund to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), which can be evolved at [[Instrument: Sunset Harp]]. {{Quote|There's a very old story told by thieves about a competition among the aviform Hours - the secret gods who take the shape of birds. The dove boasted of the bones he'd stolen from flesh, and the crow of the flesh he'd picked from bones. One of the kite-twins bragged that that she'd stolen the borders from kingdoms, and the other that she'd taken the roads from crossroads. The magpie told all the colours he'd taken that are no longer found in the world, and the laughingthrush topped that with the tales of the sights she'd stolen. But when the glitter-winged seventh of their number told them what he'd stolen, they all were shocked into silence. They fell upon him and stripped him of his wings and drove him from the sky. So he, and what he stole, are gone from the world, and now we cannot even name them, but still we feel their lack.|The Thief's Tale}} Committing Ramsund to [[Preservation]] provides [[Chor]] (2 {{Lore|Heart}}, 1 {{Lore|Grail}}), which can be evolved at the [[Barber's Chair]], [[Instrument: Hallowed Drum]], or [[Altar: Malachite]]. ==Books== The following books are written in Ramsund. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Book !! Principle !! Lesson !! Memory |- | [[On the Winding Stair]] || 8 {{Lore|Knock}} || 2x [[Door & Wall]] || [[Memory: Pattern]] (1 {{Lore|Forge}}, 2 {{Lore|Knock}}) |- | [[The Turquoise Hand]] || 10 {{Lore|Rose}} || 2x [[Pentiments & Precursors]] || [[Numen: That Old Lost Music]] (5 {{Lore|Rose}}, 5 {{Lore|Scale}}, 5 {{Lore|Sky}}) |} == Trivia == *Ramsund is likely named after the Ramsund carving, part of a series of Viking inscriptions located in Sweden, known as the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sigurd_stones Sigurd stones]. The Ramsund carving depicts, among other things, the Norse hero Sigurd coming to understand the language of the birds. {{Skills Navbox}} [[Category:Skill]] [[Category:Language]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Sky]]

The Great Signs and the Great Scars.title: The Great Signs and the Great Scars
The Great Signs and the Great Scars.text:
{{BoH_Skill |image1=The Great Signs and the Great Scars.png |title1=The Great Signs and the Great Scars |wisdoms=[[Hushery]]
[[Horomachistry]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Grail}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Knock}}}} {{quote|Some glyphs are too obscure to reside in any language, but too potent to remain unwritten.}} '''The Great Signs and the Great Scars''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Grail}} and 1 {{Lore|Knock}}. ==Wisdom Attunements== {{Quote|Vak is a Great Scar; the first enemy of Calyptra. When the black flower blossoms on the Watchman's tree, she retreats, and Calyptra protects perilous knowledge behind secrecy's veil. The nature of their enmity is a Horomachistry matter.|The First Enemy}} Committing [[The Great Signs and the Great Scars]] to [[Horomachistry]] provides [[Fet]] (2 {{Lore|Rose}}, 1 {{Lore|Moth}}), which can be evolved at the [[Altar: St Tentreto]]. {{Quote|Vak is a Great Scar; Calyptra's first mistake. If she could only be healed of her pain, Calyptra might reign inviolate, and the perilous knowledge it protects might be truly safe. The nature of her healing is a Hushery matter.|The First Error}} Committing [[The Great Signs and the Great Scars]] to [[Hushery]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), but it cannot be used to evolve Trist by itself. It will need a memory that has the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Hushery]] aspect, for example [[Didumos]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as [[Altar: St Tentreto]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Rites of the Roots.title: Rites of the Roots
Rites of the Roots.text:
{{BoH_Skill |image1=Rites of the Roots.png |wisdoms=[[The Bosk]]
[[Preservation]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Nectar}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Moth}}}} {{quote|The oldest Hours are the gods-from-blood, who rose from sacrifice. That blood was always spilt on the roots, and the rites of its spilling are still remembered.}} '''Rites of the Roots''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Nectar}} and 1 {{Lore|Moth}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The oldest living Hours are the gods-who-were-blood. The gods-from-Stone were older still, but they're buried in the earth, scattered in the sea, lost to the moon. This is why we're always careful where we make the sacrifice, because if we spilt enough blood on their graves, they'd return for their revenge. Bosk knows.|What is Taken}} Rites of the Roots can be committed to [[The Bosk]] for [[Ereb]] (2 {{Lore|Grail}}, 1 {{Lore|Edge}}), but cannot be used to evolve Ereb by itself. It will need a memory that has the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Bosk]] aspect, for example [[Hive's Lament]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as the [[Barber's Chair]]. {{quote|The oldest living Hours are the gods-who-were-blood. The gods-from-Stone were older still, but they're buried in the earth, scattered in the sea, lost to the moon. This is why we're always careful where we make the sacrifice: without it, the gods-from-Stone would pass from memory. This is Preservation.|What is Given}} Rites of the Roots can be committed to [[Preservation]] for [[Health]] (1 {{Lore|Heart}} 1 {{Lore|Nectar}}, 1 {{Lore|Scale}}), which can be evolved at the [[Barber's Chair]] or [[Altar: Malachite]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! [[Hushery]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moth}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Sky}} |special_ability=Effective Against [[Curse]]s}} {{quote|The rites of an order of immortals who have tried to remain apart. These rites touch on secrets of Hours of the Mansus - chiefly gods-who-were-flesh and gods-from-Light.}} '''Sacra Limiae''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Moth}} and 1 {{Lore|Sky}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The Hours are not all-powerful. There is a place beyond their reach, where mortals and immortals might build a shining City of iron and ivory. Horomachists understand the Hours' limits.|Of Limits}} Committing Sacra Limiae to [[Horomachistry]] provides [[Mettle]] (2 {{Lore|Forge}}, 1 {{Lore|Edge}}), which can be upgraded at the [[Telescope]], [[Shrine: the Chancel]], or the [[Great Clock]]. {{quote|The Hours are not eternal. Understand Hushery, and you understand endings.|Of Endings}} Committing Sacra Limiae to [[Hushery]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), which can be upgraded at [[Spire Prospect]] or the [[Columbic Sarcophagus]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Serpents & Venoms.title: Serpents & Venoms
Serpents & Venoms.text:
{{BoH Skill |title1=Serpents & Venoms |image1=Serpents & Venoms.png |wisdoms=[[Hushery]]
[[Skolekosophy]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Scale}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Moon}}}} {{quote|These are the Mother's neglected children, and we prefer that they pass not through any door.}} '''Serpents & Venoms''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Scale}} and 1 {{Lore|Moon}}. ==Committing to Wisdom== {{quote|In the dawn times the sun was lower, so we gave it our blood. From our blood it knew us, and so it was kinder. Its serpents brought us its poisons to drink, and so we died. But we only died a little, and so we dreamed, and returned the next day to give it our blood again. Those times of peace persist in the lessons of Hushery.|The Last Sun}} Committing Serpents & Venoms to [[Hushery]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), which can be evolved at the [[Catacombs Altar]] or the [[Loggia Prospect]]. {{quote|In the dawn times the sun was lower, so we gave it our blood. From our blood it knew us, and so it was kinder. But those days are long gone. If we were foolish enough to find the first Sun and give it our blood again, it would devour us. If we fed it the blood of our enemies, of course, it might devour them. This is the kind of thing you hear from skolekosophists.|The First Sun}} Committing Serpents & Venoms to [[Skolekosophy]] provides [[Shapt]] (2 {{Lore|Knock}}, 1 {{Lore|Forge}}) but cannot be used to evolve Shapt by itself. It will need a memory that has the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Skolekosophy]] aspect, for example [[Wormwood Dream]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as the [[Telescope]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Sharps.title: Sharps
Sharps.text:
{{BoH Skill |title1=Sharps |image1=Sharps.png |wisdoms=[[Skolekosophy]]
[[Hushery]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Edge}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Moon}}}} {{quote|Knives, dangers, and things out of place.}} '''Sharps''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Edge}} and 1 {{Lore|Moon}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|Before speech, we could not dream, which is to say that before we could wield words, we were weaponless, and even Long dared not enter the Mansus for fear of being devoured. It's not obligatory for Long to wield the weapons of speech, but they generally choose to. Perhaps that's why the Hours charge their Names to hunt down Long - even the Long who claim to serve them.|A War in Dreams}} Committing Sharps to [[Skolekosophy]] provides [[Shapt]] (2 {{Lore|Knock}}, 1 {{Lore|Forge}}), which can be evolved at the [[Condignator]]. {{quote|Before speech, we could not dream, which is to say that before speech tore open the Peacock Gate to dreams, the Mansus was unwounded and at peace. It's not obligatory for Long to pass that gate, but they generally choose to. Perhaps that's why the Hours charge their Names to hunt down Long - even the Long who claim to serve them. Hushery recognises this truth.|A Wound in Dreams}} Committing Sharps to [[Hushery]] provides [[Wist]] (2 {{Lore|Winter}}, 1 {{Lore|Lantern}}), which can be evolved at the [[Catacombs Altar]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! {{BoH Skill |title1=Snow Stories |image1=Snow Stories.png |wisdoms=[[Hushery]]
[[Birdsong]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Winter}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Moon}} }} {{quote|Of wind, woe, and winter.}} '''Snow Stories''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Winter}} and 1 {{Lore|Moon}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|Still all the winds, still every beating tongue
Now still the mirrored moon, the sea's cauldron
When nothing's left then nothing is undone.
Hushery.|Much is Lost}} Committing Snow Stories to [[Hushery]] provides [[Wist]] (2 {{Lore|Winter}}, 1 {{Lore|Lantern}}), which can be evolved at the [[Solar Altar]], [[Tower-Top Prospect]], the [[Columbic Sarcophagus]], or the [[Catacombs Altar]]. {{quote|Medusa's Riddle, first: What Is Not Seen?
The Night, the Heart, the Moon, the Day. Between.
The palest key. The birth-scarred Coil Queen.
This is Birdsong.|Much Remains}} Committing Snow Stories to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), which can be evolved at [[Instrument: Sunset Harp]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Wolf Stories.title: Wolf Stories
Wolf Stories.text:
{{BoH_Skill |title1=Wolf Stories |image1=Wolf Stories.png |wisdoms=[[Birdsong]]
[[Skolekosophy]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moon}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Scale}} |level_1=|level_2=}} {{quote|"Sometimes we eat the wolf, and sometimes the wolf eats us."}}
'''Wolf Stories''' is a [[Skill|Skill]] card that starts with {{Lore|Moon|2}} and {{Lore|Scale|1}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The Sanctioned Version of the Book of Suns says that the Wolf-Divided was awoken by the Sun's division. We know from this that the Wolf was its own Hour even when the Sun was whole. So we glean and we guess that the Sun might be healed, and the Wolf return to its slumbers. So we glean and guess that a Second Dawn would bring peace, but the Wolf will fight to prevent it. This is Birdsong.|The Wolf's Return}} Committing Wolf Stories to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Trist]], which can be evolved at [[Instrument: Sunset Harp]]. {{quote|The Received Version of the Book of Suns tells us that the Wolf-Divided was born from the Sun-in-Splendour's division. We know from this that the Sun can be reborn only if the Wolf joins the Sun's other selves. Only if the Wolf's hunger is assuaged will it join its other selves. And only the flesh of its other selves can assuage the hunger of the Wolf. A Second Dawn would herald the Last Day. This is the grim lesson of Skolekosophy.|The Wolf's Beginning}} Committing Wolf Stories to [[Skolekosophy]] provides [[Ereb]], which can be evolved at the [[Nocturnary]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books: {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Sea Stories.text:
{{BoH_Skill |image1=Sea Stories.png |title1=Sea Stories |wisdoms=[[Birdsong]]
[[Nyctodromy]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moon}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Grail}}}} {{quote|The sea has always been the widest road.}} '''Sea Stories''' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Moon}} and 1 {{Lore|Grail}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The Ligeian Morgen, holder of the key of black sapphire, called sea-born, tide-drawn. Did she come from Ys behind the wave? If we speak her name at the rising of the moon, can we summon that old song of flutes and bells? These are Birdsong-riddles.|The Sea-Born}} Committing Sea Stories to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Chor]] (2 {{Lore|Heart}}, 1 {{Lore|Grail}}), which can be evolved at [[Instrument: Quivering Double Bass]]. {{quote|The Ligeian Rowena, holder of the Mare's Key, called sea-opener, wolf-wife. Whom did she invite from Ys behind the wave? When the moon sets across the sea, will they follow its road again? This matter of roads and keys is Nyctodromy.|The Wolf-Wife}} Committing Sea Stories to [[Nyctodromy]] provides [[Shapt]] (2 {{Lore|Knock}}, 1 {{Lore|Forge}}), which can be evolved at [[Altar: St Tentreto]]. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! Tridesma Hiera.title: Tridesma Hiera
Tridesma Hiera.text:
{{BoH_Skill |image1=Tridesma Hiera.png |wisdoms=[[The Bosk]]
[[Preservation]] |primary_principle={{Lore|Moon}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Grail}} |special_ability=Effective Against [[Curse|Curses]]}} {{quote|The rites of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot, which include certain mysteries of the dwellers in the Wood behind the World.}} ''Tridesma Hiera'' is a [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Moon}} and 1 {{Lore|Grail}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The Moth consumed the Wheel; the Grail consumed the Tide; in the days of the Forge, the Stars fled from every facet of Flint. What feast was the first? Those who walk the Wood know that whichever was first, the Grail's was greatest.|The First among the Feasts}} Committing Tridesma Hiera to [[The Bosk]] provides [[Ereb]] (2 {{Lore|Grail}}, 1 {{Lore|Edge}}), which can be evolved at the [[Calicite Altar]]. {{quote|What lit the Wood in the days before its darkening? There was a light upon the earth long before Glory came to the sky. Sand Stories.text:
{{BoH Skill |primary_principle={{Lore|Rose}} |secondary_principle={{Lore|Moon}} |title1=Sand Stories |image1=File:Sand_Stories.png |wisdoms=[[Birdsong]]
[[Skolekosophy]]}} {{quote|Of wandering tribes, watchful vagabonds, and winged devourers.}} '''Sand Stories''' is [[Skills|Skill]] card that starts with 2 {{Lore|Rose}} and 1 {{Lore|Moon}}. ==Wisdom Attunement== {{quote|The seven tainted immortals we call Ligeians are relentless in their appetite, and outcast under the laws of heaven. But they have their uses to the Hours. The Ligeian Kleidouchos has known all the great keys, and even now she holds the Key of Days; so every year she meets the Vagabond in Vienna, to exchange the names of lesser keys for the stories of the Vagabond's travels. We call their gossip Birdsong.|A City}} Committing Sand Stories to [[Birdsong]] provides [[Trist]] (2 {{Lore|Moth}}, 1 {{Lore|Moon}}), which can be evolved at [[Instrument: Sunset Harp]]. {{quote|The seven tainted immortals we call Ligeians are relentless in their appetite, and outcast under the laws of heaven. But they have their uses to the Hours. The Ligeian Echidna learnt her shaping arts in the world's dawn, and even now the Lionsmith values her skill; so every year they meet in the desert, among the furnace shadows of the Seven-Coiled temple, to share their knowledge of how monsters were made. We call their stories Skolekosophy.|A Temple}} Committing Sand Stories to [[Skolekosophy]] provides [[Shapt]] (2 {{Lore|Knock}}, 1 {{Lore|Forge}}), but cannot be used to evolve Shapt by itself. It will need a memory that has the [[Memories that can evolve Elements of the Soul|Evolve via Skolekosophy]] aspect, for example [[Wormwood Dream]], and can then be evolved at any workstation that accepts the relevant principles, such as the [[Telescope]].It can also be evolved at the [[Rowenarium (Workstation)|Rowenarium]] if the [[The Affair of the Endless Guest|Affair of the Endless Guest]] is concluded with Spencer Hobson entering the Rowenarium. ==Acquiring the Skill== ''Lesson: {{PAGENAME}}'' can be acquired by studying the following books. {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%" |- ! '''Desk: Eva''' is a [[Workstations|Workstation]] located in the [[Watchman's Tower: First Floor]]. Like all Desks, Desk: Eva can be used to read or re-read [[Readable|Books]], read or reply to letters, or [[Crafting|Craft]]. Unlike most Desks, it has several built-in shelves. This can sometimes cause issues when dragging and dropping items into the Desk to activate its Workstation interface, as items can end up on the shelves instead. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Workstation]] located in the [[Columbic Crypt]]. It can evolve [[Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skills]] attuned to [[Hushery]].{{quote|'Sarcophagus': the eater of flesh. No bones remain, but the marble is chilly with power. Observe the indwelling light that was not here when it's first occupant - Rowena's heir? - was laid to rest long ago. [The Sarcophagus now admits Forge and Lantern intentions.]}}Putting the ''[[Mihail in Chains]]'' painting in the Sarcophagus starts a 60s Action after which the Sarcophagus will accept {{Lore|Forge}} and {{Lore|Lantern}} Principles. ==Evolution== ===Trist=== The following Skills can be used at the {{PAGENAME}} to evolve [[Trist]] with no additional requirements: *[[Disciplines of the Scar]] (if ''Mihail in Chains'' was put inside) *[[Ericapaean]] *[[Quenchings & Quellings]] *[[Sacra Limiae]] ===Wist=== The following Skills can be used at the {{PAGENAME}} to evolve [[Wist]] with no additional requirements: *[[Inks of Revelation]] *[[Sights & Sensations]] *[[Snow Stories]] [[Category:Workstation]] [[Category:Evolve via Hushery]]

Brancrug Boathouse.title: Brancrug Boathouse
Brancrug Boathouse.text:
{{Workstation |image1=[[File:Boathouse.png]] |location=[[Boathouse]]}} {{Quote|The boat is gone, the Sea remains. That is, of course, the way it usually works. [Discard objects here; release beasts; or go for a swim.]}}
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is located in the [[Boathouse]]. It is functionally identical to the [[Sea's Edge]] and the [[Loading Dock Crane]], except the Librarian cannot renounce a [[Penny]]. It can be used to: * Dispose of [[Thing|Things]] to obtain [[Memory: Loss]]. * Release [[Beast|Beasts]] to obtain [[Memory: Hindsight]]. * Drown your [[Journals|Journal]] for an [[Old Moment]] and an [[Achievements|Achievement]], renouncing the ability to win on this save. * Swim here with a [[Health]] card to obtain [[Memory: Salt]] ([[Curious Hunch]] in Numa instead). ** Or Dry yourself off with a [[Basket of Towels]], to obtain [[Memory: Solace]], as well as Memory: Salt. You cannot swim in [[Storm]]y weather. Swimming during Numa or Winter gives you a [[Elements of the Soul#Maladies|Malady]] - the Winter Malady can be prevented by using a Basket of Towels. {| class="mw-collapsed mw-collapsible article-table" |+ Quotes ! Action !width=80%| Quote |- | Never Again - During Storm || ''"The waves are hungry today. I'm not going swimming in a storm... well, not a second time."'' |- | Renounce Thing - Start || ''"If I cast an object into the sea, it will be lost, perhaps irretrievably. [Use this to dispose of junk, or of danger.]"'' |- | Renounce Thing - End || ''"When something is given to the sea it rarely returns... although, of course, I did.."'' |- | Release Beast - Start || ''"I could release it to the waves, the winds, or the sands, as it prefers."'' |- | Release Beast - End || ''"There were two of us, and now there's one."'' |- | Renounce What Could Be - Start || ''"My journal won't survive a second soaking. [THIS WILL DESTROY YOUR JOURNAL, which will make it IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPLETE THE GAME. You'll be stuck! But you can do it if you really want.]"'' |- | Renounce What Could Be - End || ''"Does anything happen? Does an arm in white samite rise from the sea to accept the book? No. Only the water lapping on the beach, and the long ripple washing, as the old knight once said... and the White Flower has triumphed. [It is no longer possible to complete the game.]"'' |- | A Brisk Swim - Start || ''"I'll plunge again into the waves..."'' |- | A Brisk Swim - Winter|| ''"I'll plunge again into the waves... but swimming in a winter sea might be rash. [Make sure you have dry towels at the ready.]"'' |- | A Brisk Swim - End || ''"The waves raise me; the salt stings my eyes; the horizon waits."'' |- | Numa - Start || ''"I'll plunge again into the waves... though in the labyrinth season, something might be different."'' |- | Numa - End || ''"It is difficult afterwards to remember what I felt, there among the billows. The waves have made their pilgrimage from the horizon. Now I am a pilgrim too."'' |- | A Brisk Swim with a towel - Start || ''"I'll plunge again into the waves... and dry off afterwards.''" |- | A Brisk Swim with a damp towel || ''"I'll plunge again into the waves... though I have no dry towels."'' |- | A Brisk Swim with a towel - End || ''"The waves raise me; the salt stings my eyes; the horizon waits. Afterwards, the towels are clean and soft. [By drying off afterwards, you've gained a Memory: Solace.]"'' |- |} [[Category:Workstation]]

Entrance Hall Fireplace.title: Entrance Hall Fireplace
Entrance Hall Fireplace.text:
{{Workstation |image1=[[File:Entrance Hall Fireplace.png]] |location=[[Entrance Hall]]}} {{Quote|Visitors found the warmth welcome after the battering winds of the bridge crossing.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Workstation]], located in the [[Entrance Hall]]. It can be used to: *[[Brewable#Brewing|Brew]] Tea and Coffee *[[Brewable#Hatching|Hatch]] Eggs *Dry out a [[Basket of Damp Towels]] or your [[Journals|Journal]] *Burn a [[Thing]] or [[Correspondence]] to gain [[Memory: Sight]] *Burn the [[Journals|Journal]] for an [[Invincible Audacity]] and losing the ability to win the game. Burning things does not require an [[Elements of the Soul|Element of the Soul]]. {| class="mw-collapsed mw-collapsible article-table" |+ Quotes !Action !Quote |- |Brew over the Fire Start||"Bring water to the boil - permit the potential here to express itself -" |- |Brew over the Fire End||"- steam and scent both rise. It's ready." |- |Hatch the Egg Start||"The fire's warmth can stir this egg to life - but it'll take a full day." |- |Hatch the Egg End||"New life!" |- |Dry Out Something Start||"With care..." |- |Dry Out Something End||"Soft vapours rise." |- |Dry Out a Book?||"[This will need care as well as warmth and time; add a Soul card.]
With great care... |- |Dry Out a Book||"Another treasure saved from the sea. |- |Renounce (or Brew?)||"If I cast an object into the fire, it will be transformed; destroyed; lost.
[If the item is Brewable, add a Soul card to brew it instead of destroying it.]" |- |Renounce||"If I cast an object into the fire, it will be transformed; destroyed; lost.
[Use this to dispose of junk, or of danger.]" |- |Burn Correspondence||"Perhaps this letter is irritating; or useless; or dangerous." |- |Renounce (or Brew?) / Burn End||"The flames leap up, and die away.", |- |Renounce What Could Be Start|| "Do I really want to burn a book? Do I really want to burn this book?
[THIS WILL DESTROY YOUR JOURNAL, which will make it IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPLETE THE GAME.
You'll be stuck! But you can do it if you really want.]" |- |Renounce What Could Be End||"Page by page, my future curls, blackens, disintegrates.
Smoke curls thoughtfully, and then the Red Flower thrusts it aside.
[It is no longer possible to complete the game.]" |} [[Category:Workstation]] [[Category:Fireplace]]

Hush House Well.text:
{{Workstation |image1=[[File:Hush House Well.png]] |location=[[Well]]}} {{Quote|Here I can draw up water - or drop something in, most likely to be lost forever.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Gathering|Gathering station]] located in the [[Well]]. It can be used to: *Draw [[Isle-Water]], or [[Mist-Kissed Water]] during [[Numa]]. This action takes 90 seconds. *Drop a [[Penny]] for a [[Memory: Satisfaction]]. This and the following actions take 10 seconds. *Dispose of a [[Thing]] for a [[Memory: Sound]] *Fling your [[Journal]] down the well for an amusing ''The Fellowship of the Ring'' reference and losing the ability to win the game, as well as a [[Memory: Sound]] ==Slots== * '''Effort''': ** '''Essential''': {{Lore|Heart}}, [[Elements of the Soul|Element of the Soul]] - {{Soul|Chor}} or {{Soul|Health}} ** '''Forbidden''': [[Elements of the Soul#Fatigue|Fatigued]], [[Elements of the Soul#Maladies|Malady]] * '''Thing''': ** '''Required''': [[Penny]], [[Thing]] [[Category:Workstation]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Now and then, she has lent it unwisely. But only once has she lent it to Ys.}} __NOTOC__
The '''Rowenarium''' is a Workstation located in the [[Rowenarium (Room)]]. It can evolve [[Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skills]] attuned to [[Skolekosophy]]. ==Evolution== ===Ereb=== The following Skills can be used at the Rowenarium to evolve [[Ereb]] with no additional requirements: *[[Edicts Liminal]] *[[Hyksos]] *[[Killasimi]] *[[Pentiments & Precursors]] *[[Putrefactions & Calcinations]] *[[Rhyme & Remembrance]] ===Shapt=== [[Shapt]] cannot be evolved at the Rowenarium as it does not take its Principles of {{Lore|Knock}} or {{Lore|Forge}}. However if during the [[The Affair of the Endless Guest|Affair of the Endless Guest]] the player lets Spencer Hobson to enter the Rowenarium, it will accept the {{Lore|Knock}} for the rest of the game. The following Skills can be used at the Rowenarium to evolve Shapt with no additional requirements if Hobson enters the Rowenarium: * [[Horns & Ivories]] * [[Lockworks & Clockworks]] * [[Orchids & Narcotics]] * [[Ragged Crossroads]] * [[Sand Stories]] * [[Solutions & Separations]] {{Spoilers|caption=Secret of the House|content=A [[Towards a Fundamental Aesthetic: Second Edition|secret of the house]] is hidden within the Rowenarium. It can be discovered by using the Workstation with the [[Hush House Key]].|caption_element=h3}}
[[Category:Workstation]] [[Category:Evolve via Skolekosophy]]

Serve Here.title: Serve Here
Serve Here.text:
[[File:Serving Station - Keeper's Lodge.png|right]] {{Quote|Plates, cups and glasses, so that if I want to offer someone wine, I needn't give them the whole bottle.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}'''  are a type of [[Workstation]], which can be used with [[Beverage]]s with the [[To Serve -]] [[Aspects|Aspect]], in order to divide them into smaller portions. Using this workstation with a [[Beverage]] with the [[To Serve -]] aspect will start a three second timer, after which you will receive the smaller portion, as well as a modified version with fewer uses of the original item back if there are any portions remaining. Full versions of [[Beverage]]s either have two or three uses before being exhausted. Pots of Tea and pitchers of water have two uses for this workstation, while bottles of wine and liquor have three uses. There are three Serving stations, which are located in: *[[Keeper's Lodge]] *[[Kitchen]] *[[Gaol Hall]] [[Category:Workstation]]

Loading Dock Crane.title: Loading Dock Crane
Loading Dock Crane.text:
{{Workstation |image1=[[File:Loading Dock.png]] |location=[[Loading Dock]]}} {{Quote|Long ago, this was the route by which provisions entered the gaol, and by which prisoners failed to escape. [Discard objects here, or release beasts.]}}
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is located in the [[Boathouse]]. It is functionally identical to the [[Sea's Edge]] and the [[Brancrug Boathouse]], except the Librarian cannot renounce a [[Penny]] or go for a swim. It can be used to: * Dispose of [[Thing|Things]] to obtain [[Memory: Loss]]. * Release [[Beast|Beasts]] to obtain [[Memory: Hindsight]]. * Drown your [[Journals|Journal]] for an [[Old Moment]] and an [[Achievements|Achievement]], renouncing the ability to win on this save. {| class="mw-collapsed mw-collapsible article-table" |+ Quotes ! Action !width=80%| Quote |- | Renounce Thing - Start || ''"If I cast an object into the sea, it will be lost, perhaps irretrievably. [Use this to dispose of junk, or of danger.]"'' |- | Renounce Thing - End || ''"When something is given to the sea it rarely returns... although, of course, I did.."'' |- | Release Beast - Start || ''"I could release it to the waves, the winds, or the sands, as it prefers."'' |- | Release Beast - End || ''"There were two of us, and now there's one."'' |- | Renounce What Could Be - Start || ''"My journal won't survive a second soaking. [THIS WILL DESTROY YOUR JOURNAL, which will make it IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPLETE THE GAME. You'll be stuck! But you can do it if you really want.]"'' |- | Renounce What Could Be - End || ''"Does anything happen? Does an arm in white samite rise from the sea to accept the book? No. Only the water lapping on the beach, and the long ripple washing, as the old knight once said... and the White Flower has triumphed. [It is no longer possible to complete the game.]"'' |- |} [[Category:Workstation]]

Workstations.title: Workstations
Workstations.text:
[[File:Workstation.png|right]] {{Tocright}}
'''Workstations'''Strictly speaking, in-game text refers to any place that has a "Start" action as a "Workstation". On this wiki, however, the term "Workstation" is used commonly to describe places which can be used for Reading/Crafting/Evolving. are locations within [[Hush House]] that allow the Librarian to [[Crafting|Craft]] items, break down certain [[Thing]]s, evolve [[Elements of the Soul]], and study [[Books]]. Each Workstation accepts different [[Principles]], limiting what can be done with each one. Regular Workstations have five (or rarely six) slots. The first three slots are for an [[Elements of the Soul|Element of the Soul]], a [[Skills|Skill]], and a [[Memory]]. The last slots will vary depending on the kind of Workstation. (Note: Save files last updated before the "Bancroft" update will likely have Workstations whose slots do not match the newly allowed Principles (this mismatch can be seen by clicking on a slot such as the Soul slot), thereby rejecting Skills and Soul cards that should be accepted. To remedy this, simply run any recipe allowed by the old principle schema to force the game to update the Workstation.)
Toggle All ==Desks== Desks can be used to Master [[:Category:Codex|Codices]], [[:Category:Tablet|Tablets]] and [[:Category:Scroll|Scrolls]], or to reread them in order to gain their associated [[Memory]], as well as to Craft.
Their final two slots are '''Papers''' and '''With''':
The '''Papers''' slot accepts cards with the Aspects [[Readable]] or [[Blank]], and will not accept a [[Phonograph Record]] or a [[Reel of Film]].
The '''With''' slot accepts a [[Tool]] or an [[Ink]]. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-desks" |+ style="white-space:nowrap;text-align:left"|List of Desks Toggle !Name !Principles !Location ! width="50%" |Description |- |'''[[Desk: Ambrose|Ambrose]]''' |{{Lore|Forge}}
{{Lore|Knock}}
{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Sky}} |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Westcott Room]] |''Ambrose did most of his work downstairs in the foundry and kitchen, or upstairs in the laboratory that later became the Fludd Gallery, but it was at this desk that he composed 'The Temptations of Architecture' and wrote long cross letters to the Times about the flaws of the British constitution.'' |- |'''[[Desk: Eva|Eva]]''' |{{Lore|Edge}}
{{Lore|Grail}}
{{Lore|Moon}}
{{Lore|Winter}} |[[Watchman's Tower: First Floor]] |''A magnificent eighteenth-century secretary desk commissioned for Lady Eva Dewulf, last of the Brancrug Dewulfs.'' |- |'''[[Desk: Governor|Governor]]''' |{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Edge}}
{{Lore|Moth}}
{{Lore|Forge}} |[[Crucible Tower: Governor's Office]] |''A desk as severe and as practical as Collers himself.'' |- |'''[[Desk: Natan|Natan]]''' |{{Lore|Heart}}
{{Lore|Knock}}
{{Lore|Rose}}
{{Lore|Moth}} |[[Motley Tower: Regensburg Room]] |''It's an apothecary's desk, all right, but it dates from at least a hundred years after Natan of Regensburg came here. Of course his son, his grandson, and his great-grand-son were all Natans too…'' |- |'''[[Desk: Nonna|Nonna]]''' |{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Grail}}
{{Lore|Nectar}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |[[Chapter House]] |''Abbess Nonna, apothecary, scholar, dancer.'' |- |'''[[Desk: Reading Room|Reading Room]]''' |{{Lore|Heart}}
{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Moon}}
{{Lore|Sky}} |[[Reading Room]] |''The bookwheel is a Dewulf heirloom - a gift to Eva Dewulf from her admirer, the adept Franklin Bancroft. The desk and lectern are much more recent. Steel plaques on both read 'TO GERVINUS VAN LAUREN - IN GRATITUDE FOR HIS ASSISTANCE IN THE CLOSING OF THE WINDING STAIR - E. ABNEY-HASTINGS, NOCTURNAL SECRETARY, 1928''' |- |'''[[Desk: Pale|Pale]]''' |{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Scale}}
{{Lore|Sky}}
{{Lore|Winter}} |[[Long Tower: Solomon's Study]] |''Solomon Husher himself commissioned this from Lockwood Fen bog-yew, blackened and half-fossilised by centuries underwater. Here at this desk he wrote his doomy allegory of Winter and its romance with the sun. When he blotted the last word on his manuscript and rose from his work, the timber had turned pale as fresh-cut maple. Or so the story goes.'' |- |'''[[Desk: Vagabond|Vagabond]]''' |{{Lore|Edge}}
{{Lore|Knock}}
{{Lore|Rose}}
{{Lore|Scale}} |[[Map Room]] |''An elegant relic, repurposed by Greene for his small and secret war.'' |} == Beds == Guest beds can be used to extend a [[Visitors|Visitor's]] stay at Hush House. Each Visitor will only accept a bed of same [[Principles]] they are interested in. [[Numa]] Visitors can't occupy a bed so their visits can't be prolonged. The Librarian can claim a bed as their own by using an [[Elements of the Soul|Element of the Soul]]. The title of a bed will change from "Guest Bed" to "My Bed" once claimed. Soul cards that are Fatigued or tainted with a [[Elements of the Soul#Maladies|Malady]] can be restored here with [[Beverage|Beverages]]. It is not possible to Craft in bed. "My Bed" can also be used to preserve one [[Memory]] overnight, provided it has at least one Principle in common with the bed. To switch "My Bed" to a different bed, the Librarian will need to "Decamp" by using a [[Elements of the Soul|Soul card]] by itself in "My Bed", before placing another Soul card in the desired guest bed. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-beds" |+ style="white-space:nowrap;text-align:left"|List of Guest Beds Toggle !Name !Principles !Requirements !Location ! width="35%" |Description |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Infirmary|Infirmary]]''' |{{Lore|Nectar}}
{{Lore|Edge}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Heart}} |[[Infirmary]] |''Clean white sheets and the unmistakable military ping of a steel bed-frame.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Librarian's Quarters|Librarian's Quarters]]''' |{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Rose}}
{{Lore|Sky}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Lantern}} |[[Librarian's Quarters]] |''Librarians are prone to back-ache, and the mattress here has always been a hard one, even in Westcott's time.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Lodge|Lodge]]''' |{{Lore|Scale}}
{{Lore|Forge}}
{{Lore|Knock}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Heart}} |[[Keeper's Lodge]] |''Stout, rustic, snug.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Long Cell|Long Cell]]''' |{{Lore|Scale}}
{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Edge}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Edge}} |[[Cell: Long]] |''A bunk-bed constructed for two immortals who could neither be together, nor apart.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Motley|Motley]]''' |{{Lore|Forge}}
{{Lore|Rose}}
{{Lore|Moth}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Moth}} |[[Motley Tower: Regensburg Room|Motley Tower:
Regensburg Room]] |''An exile slept here, long ago.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Pale|Pale]]''' |{{Lore|Grail}}
{{Lore|Sky}}

{{Lore|Heart}} | {{Lore|Sky}} | [[Pale Chamber]] |''Seven generations of Dewulfs slept here… as did Kitty Mazarine, who never cared much for tradition.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Severn Chamber|Severn Chamber]]''' |{{Lore|Grail}}
{{Lore|Moon}}
{{Lore|Rose}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Grail}} |[[Severn Chamber]] |''For those who prefer their mattresses soft.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Solomon|Solomon]]''' |{{Lore|Rose}}
{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Winter}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Winter}} | [[Long Tower: Solomon's Quarters|Long Tower:
Solomon's Quarters]] |''Julian Coseley and Solomon Husher - both great sages of Winter - slept in this bed. Although not simultaneously. No-one, the story runs, has ever managed a serene night's sleep in it since.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Violet Chamber|Violet Chamber]]''' |{{Lore|Grail}}
{{Lore|Knock}}
{{Lore|Moth}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Knock}} |[[Violet Chamber]] |''Six generations of Dewulf heirs were born in this room. It would have been seven, but Hafren Waters had the ill grace to give birth to Baron Walter in (family legend has it) a cow-byre outside Kerisham.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Hermit|Hermit]]''' |{{Lore|Scale}}
{{Lore|Moon}}
{{Lore|Sky}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Moon}} | [[Hermit Cell]] |''A snug nook where absolutely nobody will bother the occupant.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Servant's Quarters|Servant's Quarters]]''' |{{Lore|Forge}}
{{Lore|Nectar}}
{{Lore|Scale}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Heart}} |[[Servants' Quarters - North]]
[[Servants' Quarters - South]] |''Narrow, but comfortable.'' |- |'''[[Guest Bed: Adept Cell|Adept Cell]]''' |{{Lore|Scale}}
{{Lore|Lantern}}
{{Lore|Winter}}
{{Lore|Heart}} |{{Lore|Scale}} |[[Cell: Adepts]] |''A bed stamped with sigils to discourage access to the Mansus in dream.'' |- |} ==Instruments == Certain [[Memory|Memories]] of [[Sound (Aspect)|Sound]] can only be Crafted at Instruments (or using the [[Mazarine Fife]] at any workbench that takes [[tools]]). Thirza's Phonograph.title: Thirza's Phonograph
Thirza's Phonograph.text:
{{Workstation |image1=[[File:Thirza's Phonograph.png]] |principles={{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Sky}} |location=[[Severn Chamber]] |fourth_slot_aspects=[[Phonograph Record]] |fifth_slot_aspects=[[Memory]]}} {{Quote|Thirza Blake invited a nameless friend (or according to Brancrug tradition, her sister) to Hush House to recover from an illness. Thirza was uncharacteristically secretive about the whole business, perhaps because her own solicitude embarrassed her. She cooked her guest's meals herself; read to her in the afternoons; and purchased this phonograph so her guest could listen to Viennese opera.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Workstations|Workstation]] located in the [[Severn Chamber]]. It can be used to play [[Phonograph Records]], either to solve their Mystery or to "re-read" them to gain a [[Memory]]. In theory, it can be used for [[Crafting]], but the Librarian will almost certainly have access to more suitable Workstations for anything they might wish to craft. [[Category:Workstation]] [[Category:Phonograph]]

(Summer, Numa)}} {{quote|agave aeterna, the 'history plant', unlike its cousin the century plant, blooms every year. Perhaps it will do so forever.}} '''Agave Aeterna''' is a [[Flower]] and [[Cooking Ingredient]]. *It can be used to [[Crafting|Craft]] a [[Historywax Candle]] with a [[Chandlery]] skill and [[Beeswax]]. *It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from the [[Scent Garden]] (x2) in [[Season|Summer]] and [[Numa]]. [A previous librarian was said to sweeten lapsang tea with historied honey from this plant.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. 'Abbot Thomas'.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=[[File:'Abbot Thomas'.png]] |principles={{Lore|Moth|1}} |type=[[Thing]] |Location=[[Entrance Hall]]}} {{Quote|Thomas was one of the first abbots here, just before the beginning of the Solar Gothic period. This bust is much more recent - a nineteenth-century bronze. An inscription reads: SPEECH, THE FIRST SWORD.|}}
'''''{{PAGENAME}}'''''  is a [[Busts|Bust]] of Abbot Thomas. It is located in the [[Entrance Hall]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|The Abbey chronicles record how Viking mercenaries were quartered at the Abbey. One of their number, Toke, attempted to loot the church, and his eyes are pecked out by 'thorn-beaked crows'. He repented, became a sworn brother of the abbey under the name Thomas, and rose in time to be Abbot. But that was not the end of his story...}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. == Trivia == *[[The Sun's Lament]] describes how Thomas lost his sight for looting the Abbey and how he broke his oaths to his sword-brother Trygve and to the Colonel to become a monk of the Abbey. *[[The Wind's Ruin]] describes how Abbot Thomas used to be a raider called Toke. As much as he regrets being a raider, he also misses the memories, especially with his companion, Trygve. *[[The Moon's Egg]] narrates about how Trygve raided Abbot Thomas' Abbey as he fought back, and both became mortally wounded. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Cache]]. It can only be found in the [[Silver Vault]].

==== [[Consider]] this: ====
{{Quote|What bright treasure?}}

Convert this to one of the following:

* [[Chronsichord]]
* [[Iotic Essence]]
* [[Orpiment Exultant]]
* [[Uzult]]

The deck for this cache is shared with the [[Coppery Casket]] and the [[Ironclad Casket]].  You will not get duplicate items from these caches.

==Trivia==
* There is a connection between this [[Cache]] and [[The Twice-Born]] in the game files.<ref>https://uadaf.theevilroot.xyz/rowenarium/element/qf</ref> This implies that the description applies to [[The Twice-Born]], and that they stored away the item inside.
