Asimel.title: Asimel
Asimel.text:
{{BoH Item |image1=File:Asimel.png |principles={{Lore|Knock|3}}, {{Lore|Moon|5}}, {{Lore|Moth|1}}, {{Lore|Rose|1}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]] |Location=* [[Gullscry Loggia]] * [[Cell: ?]] *[[Crafting]]}} {{Quote|A silver ink that can only be made and used in dreams. An Ink of Revelation.}}
'''Asimel''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Rose}} [[Ink]]. It can also be found in: *[[Gullscry Loggia]] *[[Cell: ?]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|A silvery glimmer like a spilt star.
[Scholar-level Moon and Moth recipes exist that can craft this with lenses or liquids.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Moth}} or {{Lore|Moon}}, a [[Liquid]] or [[Lens]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Revelation]] ||{{Lore|Moth|10}} |rowspan=4|[[Liquid]] |rowspan=4|"Brew a silvery Moon-ink." |"[With Keeper-level Moon - not Moth - asimel can deepen to black sapphire.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pearl & Tide]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Moon|10}} |rowspan=3|"[With Keeper-level Moon, asimel can deepen to black sapphire.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Putrefactions & Calcinations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sea Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Ouranoscopy]] |[[Lens]] |"Focus the light of the heavens
to enliven a silvery Moon-ink." |"[With Keeper-level Moon, asimel sigils can evoke a celestial influence.]" |}
Asimel is required for Crafting [[Black Sapphire Wash]] and [[Didumos]]. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Moon]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Rose]]

Awakened Feather.title: Awakened Feather
Awakened Feather.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=Awakened_Feather.png |principles={{Lore|Scale|1}}, {{Lore|Sky|2}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Material]], [[Remains]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Solarium]] *[[Crafting]] [[Gathering]]: *[[The Gull-Colony]]}} {{Quote|Alive to every draught and spark.}}
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Material]] and [[Remains]]. It can be found in: *[[Solarium]] *[[Gathering]] in [[The Gull-Colony]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Something on the wind… [There are Prentice-level Sky recipes which can create one of these.]}} Generates [[Cheerful Ditty]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Prentice-level {{Lore|Sky}} and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |[[Anbary & Lapidary]] |rowspan=6|{{Lore|Sky|5}} |"Spark a life-current in an abandoned feather." |rowspan=6|"A smooth sweep of quill alert with life." |- |[[Furs & Feathers]] |"Smooth an abandoned feather to enchanted alertness." |- |[[Lockworks & Clockworks]] |"Enact a life-current in an abandoned feather." |- |[[Sacra Limiae]] |"Whisper an ascension-cantrip to awaken an abandoned feather." |- |[[Sights & Sensations]] |"Align an abandoned feather to the currents of light." |- |[[Stitching & Binding]] |"Bind a little wandering life to an abandoned feather." |} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Material]] [[Category:Remains]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Scale]] [[Category:Sky]]

Blue Crown.title: Blue Crown
Blue Crown.text:
{{BoH Item |image1=[[File:Blue.crown.png]] |principles={{Lore|Nectar|1}}, {{Lore|Sky|2}}, {{Lore|Winter|2}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Flower]],
[[Cooking Ingredient]] |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[St Brandan's Cloister]] (x2)
(Spring, Winter)}} {{quote|The sky-coloured petals of blue crown are always cold as frost.}}
'''Blue Crown''' is a [[Flower]] and [[Cooking Ingredient]]. *It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from [[St Brandan's Cloister]] (x2) in [[Season|Spring]]The tooltip only says Winter, but it is harvestable in Spring as well. or [[Season|Winter]]. *In the ''[[House of Light]]'' DLC, it can be used to [[Cooking|Cook]] a [[Blue Crown Tea]] in a [[Workstation#Kitchen Ranges|Kitchen Range]] with a compatible [[Element of the Soul]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Solomon Husher often used this in his preparations.}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Trivia== *It is one of the best Flowers for [[Crafting]] [[Solomon’s Preparation]]. ==References== [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Flower]] [[Category:Cooking Ingredient]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Ashartine.title: Ashartine
Ashartine.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Ashartine.png| |principles={{Lore|Forge|1}}, {{Lore|Lantern|6}}, {{Lore|Sky|2}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: * [[Westcott Room]] * [[Severn Chamber]] * [[Crafting]] [[Cache]]s: * [[Morbid Casket]] * [[Scaled Casket]] * [[Scarred Casket]]}} {{quote|Lies written in Ashartine tend to fade or be misspelt. It's legible in the dark. An Ink of Revelation.}}
'''Ashartine ''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Ink]]. It can also be found in: *[[Westcott Room]] *[[Severn Chamber]] *[[Morbid Casket]] *[[Scaled Casket]] *[[Scarred Casket]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|If dark were light… [There are Keeper-level Sky and Lantern recipes that can craft this from Ichor Vitreous.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Lantern}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, [[Ichor Vitreous]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- ||[[Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Lantern|15}} |rowspan=6|[[Ichor Vitreous]] |rowspan=6|"Brew the bright ink ashartine from the ichor." |rowspan=6|"While the vapours of ashartine's making hang in the air, it is very difficult to speak a lie aloud…" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Glaziery & Lightsmithing]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pyroglyphics]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Watchman's Paradoxes]] |- ||[[Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Sky|15}} |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Anbary & Lapidary]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: {| class="article-table" !|{{Lore|Lantern}} !|{{Lore|Sky}} |- | *[[Alchemist's Glassware]] *[[Shrine: the Watchman]] *[[Solar Altar]] | *[[Shrine: St Januarius]] *[[Shrine: the Madrugad]] *[[Shrine: the Watchman]] *[[Solar Altar]] *[[Spire Prospect]] *[[Tower-Top Prospect]] |} ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found by reading ''[[The Lion and the Glass]]'': {{quote|Omar divulges a glassmaker's secret: that 'the Ichor Vitreous' can be filtered and enriched (with enough Lantern Aspect) to become the ink ashartine, which resists untruths…}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Lantern]] [[Category:Sky]]

Black Sapphire Wash.title: Black Sapphire Wash
Black Sapphire Wash.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Black_Sapphire_Wash.png |principles={{Lore|Moon|6}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Pigment]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: * [[Crucible Tower: Interview Laboratory|Crucible Tower:
Interview Laboratory]] * [[Hall of Voices]] * [[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: * [[Morbid Casket]] * [[Scaled Casket]] * [[Scarred Casket]]}} {{quote|The colour, perhaps, of the doors of the House of the Moon.}}
'''Black Sapphire Wash''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Moon}} [[Liquid]] and [[Pigment]]. It can also be found in: *[[Hall of Voices]] *[[Crucible Tower: Interview Laboratory]] *[[Morbid Casket]] *[[Scaled Casket]] *[[Scarred Casket]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|'When the light is extinguished, the shadow persists. After the House of the Sun, the House of the Moon.'
[There are Keeper-level Moon recipes which can create this from Asimel.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Moon}}, [[Asimel]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Desires & Dissolutions]] |rowspan=5|{{Lore|Moon|15}} |rowspan=5|[[Asimel]] |rowspan=5|"Darken the asimel into a potent Moon-pigment." |rowspan=5|"Whence came the light in the House of the Moon? We still don't know; but perhaps this colour is its darkness." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pearl & Tide]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Putrefactions & Calcinations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sea Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Tridesma Hiera]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: *[[Altar: St Tentreto]] *[[Desk: Eva]] *[[Desk: Reading Room]] *[[Nocturnary]] == Trivia == *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Operations of a Certain Finality]]'': {{Quote|The author gloats that with the techniques of Putrefaction and Calcination, they have transformed the Library's stocks of asimel to 'a seduction of black sapphire' which will ensure the texts therein contain only 'Moon-truths'.}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Pigment]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Moon]]

Azoth.title: Azoth
Azoth.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=Azoth.png] |principles= {{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Knock|6}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]]}} {{quote|A solvent of frightening voracity.}}
'''Azoth''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Knock}} [[Liquid]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Once spilt, nothing remains.
[There are Keeper-level Forge recipes that can create this with the assistance of Orichalcum, among other things.]}} Generates [[Memory: Foresight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Forge}}, [[Wire (Orichalcum)]] or [[Honeyscar Jasmine]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Bells & Brazieries]] |rowspan=7|{{Lore|Forge|15}} |rowspan=6|[[Wire (Orichalcum)]] |rowspan=6|"Use orichalcum to catalyse the ferocious Knock-solvent called the azoth." |rowspan=6|"The orichalcum must be incorporated, very carefully, into the vessel, so that the azoth does not escape. A hidden compartment will be opened, revealing a small bookshelf containing a bottle of {{PAGENAME}}.}} == Consider this == {{Quote|The taste is not 'good' in any reasonable sense, and since no trace of alcohol remains, neither is this wine in any reasonable sense. But the layers and flavours go on and down, as if I were descending a cramped passage into the earth: moss, oak, deep tar, a sudden bright wince like grapes, and then at last stone's long savour fading. I'll taste it again tonight in every dream.}}
[[Consider]]ing {{PAGENAME}} will convert it into [[Old Moment]]. }}

Cuckoo-Honey.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=[[File:Cuckoo-Honey.png]] |title1=Cuckoo-Honey |principles={{Lore|Edge|2}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Knock|1}}, {{Lore|Moth|3}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}, {{Lore|Scale|3}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Sustenance]], [[Liquid]], [[Cooking Ingredient]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Kitchen]] *[[Pantry]] *[[Gaol Kitchen]] [[Gathering]]: *[[Beehive]]}} {{Quote|The Blomberende were rogues and trickster-heroes among the Carapace-kinds: ingenious, brave, prolific, untrustworthy. In Numa, their children might yet bring their gifts to ordinary hives…}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Liquid]] [[Sustenance]] and a [[Cooking Ingredient]]. It can be found in the [[Kitchen]], the [[Pantry]] and the [[Gaol Kitchen]]. It can also be [[Gathering|Gathered]] at the [[Beehive]] in [[Numa]], and is a required component for [[Crafting]] the [[Skinshuck Mead]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|A fleetingly familiar taste, and a prickling in the skull… not surprising, perhaps, that it can be brewed into Skinshuck Mead with the great arts of Moth.}} Generates [[Old Moment]] and consumes the item. ==Gathering== {{PAGENAME}} can be obtained by Gathering at the Beehive in Numa, with a drop rate of 33%. {{PAGENAME}} can also be obtained by considering [[Soft Amber Pumpkin]]. One [[Soft Amber Pumpkin]] can be found in the [[Pantry]], and it can also be obtained from [[Tall Parcel]] with a drop rate of 6.25%. Given that the chain of gathering events required to repeatably obtain [[Soft Amber Pumpkin]] have a effective drop rate of 0.1%[[Beachcombing]] in any season has a 1 in 15 chance of dropping [[Contraband Flotsam]]; opening [[Contraband Flotsam]] has a 1 in 4 chance of dropping [[Tall Parcel]]; [[Tall Parcel]] has a 1 in 16 chance of dropping [[Soft Amber Pumpkin]]; resulting in a cumulative drop rate of 1 in 960, or 0.1%., the only feasible method of repeatably obtaining {{PAGENAME}} is [[Gathering]] at the [[Beehive]] in [[Numa]]. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Sustenance]] [[Category:Cooking Ingredient]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Gathering]]

{{BoH_Item |image1=Ichor_Vitreus.png |principles={{Lore|Lantern|4}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Pigment]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: * [[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] * [[Chancel of the Abbey Church|Chancel of the

'''Ichor Vitreous''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Lantern}} [[Liquid]] [[Pigment]]. It can also be found in: *[[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] *[[Chancel of the Abbey Church]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|It stings like wasps. [There are Scholar-level Lantern recipes that can be used to craft this with glass.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Lantern}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, [[Glass]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]] |rowspan=5|{{Lore|Lantern|10}} |rowspan=6|[[Glass]] |rowspan=6|"Distil a pale and watchful Lantern-fluid." |rowspan=6|"[With Keeper-level Sky, Ichor Vitreous is the precursor of the ink ashartine.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Glaziery & Lightsmithing]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Revelation]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sacra Solis Invicti]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Watchman's Paradoxes]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]] ||{{Lore|Sky|10}} |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Ashartine]]. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Pigment]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Lantern]]

[There are Scholar-level Rose and Sky recipes that can be used to craft this in the presence of a light source.]}} Generates [[Memory: Intuition]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Rose}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, a [[Light]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Auroral Contemplations]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Rose|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Light]] |rowspan=5|"Condense light to a Rose-fluid." |rowspan=3|"[With Keeper-level Rose, the Ichor Auroral is a precursor to the Great Ink Porphyrine.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Power]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sand Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sights & Sensations]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Sky|10}} |rowspan=2|"[With Keeper-level Rose - not Sky - the Ichor Auroral is a precursor to the Great Ink Porphyrine.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Watchman's Paradoxes]] |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Porphyrine]]. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Pigment]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Lantern]] [[Category:Rose]]

Honeyscar Jasmine.title: Honeyscar Jasmine
Honeyscar Jasmine.text:
{{BoH Item |image1=[[File:Honeyscar.jasmine.png]] |principles={{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}, {{Lore|Rose|1}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Flower]],
[[Cooking Ingredient]] |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[Scent Garden]] (x2)
([[Autumn]], [[Numa]])}} {{quote|Sweet-scented, night-blooming.}}
'''Honeyscar Jasmine''' is a [[Flower]] and a [[Cooking Ingredient]]. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from the [[Scent Garden]] (x2) in [[Season|Autumn]] and [[Numa]]. *It can be used with [[Spices & Savours]] to [[Crafting|Craft]] [[Azoth]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Forge}}.
*It can also be used to Craft a [[Honeyscar-Scented Candle]] with a [[Chandlery]] Skill and [[Beeswax]]. *In the ''[[House of Light]]'' DLC, it can be used to [[Cooking|Cook]] a [[Honeyscar Jasmine Tea]] in a [[Workstation#Kitchen Ranges|Kitchen Range]] with a compatible [[Element of the Soul]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Ambrose Westcott found a way to scent his pipe tobacco with honeyscar. Kitty Mazarine made jam. And Gervinus van Lauren, it is said, found a Keeper-level recipe which somehow uses it as the basis for the azoth...}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Flower]] [[Category:Cooking Ingredient]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Iotic Essence.title: Iotic Essence
Iotic Essence.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=Iotic Essence.png |principles={{Lore|Forge|5}}, {{Lore|Lantern|3}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Pigment]], [[Fuel]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Ambered Casket]] *[[Coppery Casket]] *[[Ironclad Casket]]}} {{quote|'In the later operations of the Forge, the Madrugad yields to the true Forge of Days, and the essence begins to redden.' The bit about the 'true Forge of Days' nearly got St Melancthe burned for heresy, but no-one ever said she was wrong about the second part.}}
'''Iotic Essence''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Forge}} [[Pigment]] and [[Liquid]] [[Fuel]]. It can also be found in: *[[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] *[[Ambered Casket]] *[[Coppery Casket]] *[[Ironclad Casket]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Redder than sunset. [A range of Forge recipes can be used to create Iotic Essence from a range of precursors.]}} Generates [[Memory: Foresight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Forge}}, a [[Liquid]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Anbary & Lapidary]] |rowspan=5|{{Lore|Forge|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Liquid]] |"Energise this liquid into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |rowspan=5|"[With Keeper-level Forge, Iotic Essence is the precursor to the Great Ink called Orpiment Exultant; with Keeper-level Lantern, it can become Xanthotic Essence instead.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Meniscate Reflections]] |"Equilibrate this liquid into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pyroglyphics]] |"Candesce this liquid into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Spices & Savours]] |"Spice this liquid into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |"Transform this liquid into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |} {{PAGENAME}} can also be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Forge}}, [[Bitterblack Salts]] or [[Xanthotic Essence]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Disciplines of the Hammer]] |rowspan=6|{{Lore|Forge|15}} |rowspan=3|[[Bitterblack Salts]] |rowspan=3|"Transform these salts into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |rowspan=6|"Red as sunset…" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Meniscate Reflections]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Disciplines of the Hammer]] |rowspan=3|[[Xanthotic Essence]] |rowspan=3|"Transform this into a ruddy essence of Forge-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Meniscate Reflections]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Orpiment Exultant]]. ==Trivia== *A hint about Crafting this recipe can be found when [[Consider]]ing [[Bitterblack Salts]]: {{Quote|"There's a brightness locked within. Keeper-level Forge or Lantern might transform these into a more potent essence.}} *A hint about Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Book of Cinders]]'': {{Quote|"A surprisingly casual final section mentions that iotic essence, 'the root of the Great and Exultant Ink Orpimental', can be refined with enough Forge from a variety of liquids."}} *A hint about Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Opus Magnum Caeruleum]]'': {{Quote|...The book mentions that Pyroglyphics techniques can be used with Forge to create Iotic Essence as a necessary component...}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Pigment]] [[Category:Fuel]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Lantern]]

It disappears when used, but can be found again by [[Gathering]] in a garden, at the [[Beachcombing|beach]], at the [[The Gull-Colony|Gull-Colony]], in the [[The Sea-Caves|Sea Caves]], or from the [[Hush House Well|well]] as a special spawn. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|Serena Blackwood herself forged this key. [[File:De.moon.png|60px|left|link=]]

Houndsgall.title: Houndsgall

{{BoH_Item |image1=Houndsgall.png |principles={{Lore|Edge|1}}, {{Lore|Heart|2}}, {{Lore|Scale|5}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]] |Location=* [[Reading Room]] * [[Spire]] * [[Crafting]]}} {{quote|Books written in Houndsgall are more likely to return to their owner, or one to whom they have been legitimately sold. An Ink of Containment.}}

Isle-Water.text:
{{BoH_Item |title1=Isle-Water |image1= Isle-Water (Pitcher).png|Pitcher Isle-Water (Glass).png|Glass |principles={{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Moon|1}}, {{Lore|Winter|1}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Beverage]], [[Restorative]], [[To Serve -]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Long Tower: Solomon's Quarters| Solomon's Quarters]] (Glass) *[[Kitchen]] (Pitcher) *[[Servants' Quarters - North]] (Glass) *[[Stores]] (Pitcher) *[[Gaol Hall]]
(Pitcher, Glass x2) *[[Cell: Adepts]] (Glass) [[Gathering]]: *[[Hush House Well]] (Pitcher)}} {{quote|From Brancrug's deep springs.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Restorative]] [[Beverage]]. It can be found in many locations in [[Hush House]] and can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from the [[Hush House Well]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|The water of the isle has a very faint, very distinctive taste sometimes described as 'appleshroomy'.}} Generates [[Memory: Taste]] and destroys the item. ==To Serve -== {{PAGENAME}} has 3 states: Isle-Water (Pitcher), Isle-Water (Half-Pitcher) and Isle-Water (Glass). Each Pitcher of water will serve two Glasses at a [[Serve Here]] station.

Marakat.title: Marakat
Marakat.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Marakat.png |principles={{Lore|Grail|7}}, {{Lore|Knock|7}}, {{Lore|Nectar|7}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]], [[Encaustum Terminale]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Attaché Case]] *[[Hive Casket]] *[[Mottled Casket]] *[[Records Box]]}} {{quote|The encaustum terminale of the Fifth History. The colour of the Principle that once occupied the place that Heart does now. In the Fifth History itself, the cult of Marakat was everywhere suppressed, but it's sometimes been venerated otherwise. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]}}
'''Marakat''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Nectar}} [[Encaustum Terminale]]. It can also be found in: *[[Attaché Case]] *[[Hive Casket]] *[[Mottled Casket]] *[[Records Box]] It can be used with the [[Journals|Journal]] to make [[Determination|Determinations]] and record a [[History]], fulfilling the [[Librarians|Librarian's]] purpose at [[Hush House]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Another history spilt… [There are Keeper-level Nectar recipes that can craft this from Leathy.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Nectar}}, [[Leathy]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Power]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Nectar|15}} |rowspan=3|[[Leathy]] |rowspan=3|"Brew the encaustum terminale called Marakat." |rowspan=3|"[This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Insects & Nectars]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Tridesma Hiera]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create Marakat include: *[[Chrysalis]] *[[Dispensary]] *[[Hearth: Hall of Voices]] *[[Kitchen Range: Gaol]] *[[Kitchen Range: Servants]] *[[Nocturnary]] == Trivia == *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The History of Inks]]'': {{Quote|'The encaustum Marakat is refined from the liquor named leathy in the presence of Nectar aspect...}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Malachite Supplications]]'': {{Quote|One prayer describes how a strong degree of Nectar-aspect can be used with Leathy and Tridesma Hiera rites to bring forth 'the Last Nectar of the Last History, the Living Ink, the Ink-in-Secret…'}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Red Book of Brittany]]'': {{Quote|...A variant of the same approach, with the Inks of Power techniques outlined here, can 'gentle Leathy into a Great Ink...}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Encaustum Terminale]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Grail]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Nectar]]

January Sanguinary.title: January Sanguinary
January Sanguinary.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=January Sanguinary.png |principles={{Lore|Heart|5}}, {{Lore|Knock|3}}, {{Lore|Sky|3}} ||type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] *[[Hermit Cell]] *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Attaché Case]] *[[Hive Casket]] *[[Mottled Casket]] *[[Records Box]]}} {{quote|Also called sanguis saltandis or, by the ignorantly superstitious, 'true blood of St Januarius'.}}
'''January Sanguinary''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Liquid]]. It can also be found in: *[[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] *[[Hermit Cell]] *[[Attaché Case]] *[[Hive Casket]] *[[Mottled Casket]] *[[Records Box]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|'And so it will not, will not, will not stop dancing.'
[With Keeper-level Heart recipes, this can be crafted from Gideon's Soaks.]}} Generates [[Thunderskin's Paean]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Heart}} and [[Gideon's Soaks]], or {{Lore|Knock}} and [[Glassfinger Toxin]], and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Edicts Inviolable]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Heart|15}} |rowspan=4|[[Gideon's Soaks]] |rowspan=4|"Enliven the soaks into something with a greater Heart-aspect." |rowspan=5|"Stopper it quickly. Quickly!" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Herbs & Infusions]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Maggephene Mysteries]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Surgeries & Exsanguinations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Surgeries & Exsanguinations]] ||{{Lore|Knock|15}} |[[Glassfinger Toxin]] |"Enliven the toxin into something with a greater Heart-aspect." |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: {| class="article-table" !|{{Lore|Heart}} !|{{Lore|Knock}} |- | *[[Chrysalis]] *[[Dispensary]] | *[[Altar: St Tentreto]] *[[Dispensary]] *[[Foundry (Workstation)|Foundry]] |} ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The World Despoil'd]]'': {{Quote|Gideon concludes with a concrete example: that the Mysteries can be used to despoil 'mine own Soaks', but then the Soak can then be refined with sufficient Heart into 'the sanguis saltandis'.}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Sky]]

Lenten Rose.title: Lenten Rose
Lenten Rose.text:
{{BoH Item |image1=[[File:Lenten.rose.png]] |principles={{Lore|Grail|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}, {{Lore|Rose|2}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Flower]] |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[Scent Garden]] (x2)
(Spring, Winter)}} {{quote|Pretty; poisonous; no true rose.}}
'''Lenten Rose''' is a [[Flower]] with {{Lore|Grail|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}} and {{Lore|Rose|2}}. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from the [[Scent Garden]] in [[Season|Spring]] and [[Season|Winter]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|There's a story that Serena Blackwood took a specimen of this rose to the Invisible Serapeum when she left. There's another story that it's the unexpected component of a secret Keeper-level recipe for the Great Ink Porphyrine...}} Considering Lenten Rose will consume the Flower and produce [[Memory: Scent]]. It can be used with [[Pearl & Tide]] and Keeper-level {{Lore|Rose}} to Craft [[Porphyrine]]. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Flower]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Mazarine Fife.title: Mazarine Fife
Mazarine Fife.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Mazarine_Fife.png |principles={{Lore|Sky|3}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Tool]], [[Instrument]] |Location=[[Crafting]]}} {{quote|Whittled according to Kitty Mazarine's patient, eccentric instructions.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Sky}} [[Tool]]. It is the only [[Instrument]] that is not a [[Workstations|Workstation]], and the only craftable Tool that is not a [[Device]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|To be used carefully; just in case of storms.
[Crafted from wood with certain Scholar-level Sky recipes.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sound]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Sky}}, [[Wood]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Ouranoscopy]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Sky|10}} |rowspan=3|[[Wood]] |rowspan=3|"Carve a Sky-aspected instrument." |rowspan=3|"[With Keeper-level Sky, a Mazarine Fife is an essential tool to conjure a Wind-in-Waiting.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sacra Limiae]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sacra Solis Invicti]] |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Wind-in-Waiting]]. Below is a list of [[Workstations]] which accept the required [[Wood]] (including those which accept [[Fuel]] or [[Material]], since all Woods have these [[Aspects]] as well).
Note that it is impractical to Craft with most Workstations that aren't compatible with {{Lore|Sky}} or {{Lore|Lantern}} until high Skill or Soul levels and high-tier [[Memory|Memories]]. {| class="wikitable" |+Compatible Workstations !All Skills

Leathy is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Scale}} [[Restorative]], [[Intoxicating]] [[Beverage]]. It can also be found in: *[[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] (x2) *[[Night Gallery]] *[[Chapel Malachite]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|Exhausted.}} Generates [[Memory: Taste]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Nectar}} or {{Lore|Moon}}, a [[Beverage]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Herbs & Infusions]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Nectar|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Beverage]] |rowspan=5|"Brew a Moth-liquor." |rowspan=5|"[With Keeper-level Nectar - not Moon - Leathy is a precursor to the Great Ink Marakat.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Insects & Nectars]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Orchids & Narcotics]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Rites of the Roots]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Containment]] ||{{Lore|Moon|10}} |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Marakat]]. ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Most Sorrowful End of the Lady Nonna]]'': {{Quote|...asked her and another sister to prepare her a leathy-draught (which can be brewed from another beverage with Herbs and Infusions techniques, and a sufficient quantity of Nectar)}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Beverage]] [[Category:Restorative]] [[Category:Intoxicating]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Grail]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Nectar]] [[Category:Scale]]

It can also be found in [[Abandoned Luggage]] and [[Forsaken Packages]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|In Brancrug Village, they tell of Thirza Blake's boast that she crossed an ocean in the Bounds by clinging to a broom of lignum vitae after a shipwreck. Much later, Governor Collers speculated that this might be a sly alchemical parable...}}
Generates [[Memory: Gossip]] and destroys the item. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Material]] [[Category:Wood]] [[Category:Fuel]]

Orpiment Exultant.title: Orpiment Exultant
Orpiment Exultant.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Orpiment_Exultant.png |principles={{Lore|Forge|7}}, {{Lore|Heart|7}}, {{Lore|Sky|7}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]], [[Encaustum Terminale]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Ambered Casket]] *[[Coppery Casket]] *[[Ironclad Casket]]}} {{quote|The encaustum terminale of the Fourth History. It's the incandescent orange of Forge. One ingredient - it's been, as it were, long-rumoured - is the blood of candescents. Certain Masonic and related traditions venerate what they call 'O.E'.
[Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Encaustum Terminale]]. It can also be found in: *[[Ambered Casket]] *[[Coppery Casket]] *[[Ironclad Casket]] It can be used with the [[Journals|Journal]] to make [[Determination]]s and record a [[History]], fulfilling the [[Librarians|Librarian's]] purpose at [[Hush House]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Another history spilt… [There are Keeper-level Forge recipes that can craft this from Iotic Essence.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Forge}}, [[Iotic Essence]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Anbary & Lapidary]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Forge|15}} |rowspan=3|[[Iotic Essence]] |rowspan=3|"Transform the essence into the encaustum terminale Orpiment Exultant." |rowspan=3|"[This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.]." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Power]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: *[[Alchemist's Glassware]] *[[Condignator]] *[[Foundry (Workstation)|Foundry]] *[[Oubliette Containment]] *[[Shrine: the Madrugad]] ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this item can be found in ''[[The Book of Cinders]]'': {{Quote|...A surprisingly casual final section mentions that iotic essence, 'the root of the Great and Exultant Ink Orpimental', can be refined with enough Forge from a variety of liquids.}} *A hint for Crafting this item can be found in ''[[The History of Inks]]'': {{Quote|...The History concludes with the admission that the encaustum named 'Orpiment Exultant' was once drawn from the veins of Forge-long. Thankfully, it seems, it can also be refined from Iotic Essence using the techniques in this book - or with 'transformations' and 'the jewel-science'.}} *"Orpiment" is the traditional name for [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orpiment yellow arsenic blende], a vivid yellow-orange crystal, often found near volcanic activity such as fumaroles. The name comes from the Latin ''aurum pigmentum'', "gold(en) pigment". It was once widely used in art, as one of the few vivid yellow pigments available to pre-modern artists. However, because it is unstable and highly toxic, its usage has declined sharply since synthetic alternatives appeared in the 19th century. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Encaustum Terminale]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Sky]]

Nillycant.title: Nillycant
Nillycant.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Nillycant.png |principles={{Lore|Edge|7}}, {{Lore|Scale|7}}, {{Lore|Winter|7}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]], [[Encaustum Terminale]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Morbid Casket]] *[[Scaled Casket]] *[[Scarred Casket]]}} {{quote|The encaustum terminale of the Third History. It's the bleak white-blue of Winter. It has spawned an itinerant order of secret celebrants who regard Worms as semi-gods, and who are sometimes called on to celebrate difficult funerals. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes.]}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Edge}}, {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Winter}} [[Encaustum Terminale]]. It can also be found in: *[[Morbid Casket]] *[[Scaled Casket]] *[[Scarred Casket]] It can be used with the [[Journals|Journal]] to make [[Determination]]s and record a [[History]], fulfilling the [[Librarians|Librarian's]] purpose at [[Hush House]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Another history spilt… [There are Keeper-level Winter recipes that can craft this from Solomon's Preparation, or from Glassfinger Toxin]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Winter}}, [[Solomon’s Preparation]] or [[Glassfinger Toxin]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Containment]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Winter|15}} |rowspan=2|[[Solomon’s Preparation]] |rowspan=2|"Clarify the preparation into the encaustum terminale Nillycant." |rowspan=3|"[This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sights & Sensations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Ragged Crossroads]] |[[Glassfinger Toxin]] |"Soften the toxin into the encaustum terminale Nillycant." |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: *[[Alchemist's Glassware]] *[[Nocturnary]] == Trivia == *The main Crafting route is hinted at in the book ''[[Musgrave's Sketches]]'', whereby the 'final pigment' [[Nillycant]] can be prepared using [[Solomon's Preparation]] as an ingredient: {{Quote|Musgrave discusses the temptation of the perfectly minimal 'palest painting'. He has so far managed to resist this temptation, but does guiltily describe success in using Sights and Sensations with Winter-aspect to create first a 'chilly elixir' from flowers, which he believes he can refine further into a 'final pigment'...}} *The main Crafting route is also hinted at in ''[[The Black Book of Brittany]]'': {{Quote|The Black Flower, spoken of as a doom or geas, can be held at bay with the Last Ink of Power - brewed from 'the Pale Mixture' in the presence of sufficient Winter with the arts of Containment.}} *The alternate Crafting route is hinted at in ''[[The White Book of Brittany]]'': {{Quote|The White Flower is described as the 'death of wisdom' - but wisdom can pass into sleep, not death, when 'the Rage of Glass' is subjected to sufficiently powerful Winter-aspect while the Ragged Crossroads arts are invoked...}} *The alternate Crafting route is also hinted at in ''[[Those Indignities Perpetrated By the Deceitful Fraternity of Obliviates]]'': {{Quote|...The Glassfinger Toxin is no mere assassin's convenience for the Obliv-IDIOTS to confine to the disposal of their enemies. It has higher uses! Certainly it is a great matter of Winter, but I have already outlined the technique by which it may be fitted for its ultimate destiny...}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Encaustum Terminale]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Edge]] [[Category:Scale]] [[Category:Winter]]

I can brew an ink of links." |rowspan=3|"Some authorities claim it's difficult to lose a pot of perhibiate ink,

Porphyrine.title: Porphyrine
Porphyrine.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Porphyrine.png |principles={{Lore|Knock|7}}, {{Lore|Moon|7}}, {{Lore|Rose|7}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]], [[Encaustum Terminale]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Attaché Case]] *[[Hive Casket]] *[[Mottled Casket]] *[[Records Box]]}} {{quote|The encaustum terminale of the Second History. It's the glowing crimson-mauve of the Secret Histories. Porphyrine was venerated in secret by a confraternity of corresponding Cluniacs and Benedictines. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes...

Porphyrine might also be used to compose a petition for the labyrinth season,
if you can provide at least 20 of  [[File:Knock.png|24px|Knock]] ,  [[File:Rose.png|24px|Rose]] , or  [[File:Moon.png|24px|Moon]] ; no  [[File:Edge PNG.png|24px|Edge]] , [[File:Heart.png|24px|Heart]] , or  [[File:Winter.png|24px|Winter]]  at all; and suitable writing material.]}} __NOTOC__
'''Porphyrine''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Rose}} [[Encaustum Terminale]]. It can also be found in: *[[Attaché Case]] *[[Hive Casket]] *[[Mottled Casket]] *[[Records Box]] It can be used with the [[Journals|Journal]] to make [[Determination]]s and record a [[History]], fulfilling the [[Librarians|Librarian's]] purpose at [[Hush House]].
In addition to the normal uses of an Encaustum Terminale (and those of any [[Ink]]), Porphyrine can also be used create a [[Petition for a Labyrinth Season]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Another history spilt… [Certain Keeper-level Lantern and Rose recipes can brew this from Ichor Auroral, and perhaps from other things.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Lantern}} or {{Lore|Rose}}, [[Lenten Rose]] or [[Ichor Auroral]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="article-table sortable" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Workstation !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Auroral Contemplations]] ||{{Lore|Lantern|15}} |rowspan=4|[[Ichor Auroral]] |[[Alchemist's Glassware]] |rowspan=4|"Deepen the ichor into the encaustum terminale Porphyrine." |rowspan=5|"[This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Power]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Rose|15}} |rowspan=2|[[Loggia Prospect]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sand Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Revelation]] |[[Rowenarium (Workstation)|Rowenarium]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pearl & Tide]] |[[Lenten Rose]] |[[Altar of the Knot]] |"A little-known secret: use the rose-petals to brew the encaustum terminale Porphyrine." |} === Crafting tips=== Note for the [[Pearl & Tide]] recipe that there are no [[Workstations]] that accept both {{Lore|Rose}} and [[Flower]]s. This can be gotten around by using the [[Altar of the Knot]], as it accepts {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, and {{Lore|Heart}}. {{Lore|Moth}} matches with [[Fet]], and {{Lore|Moon}} with [[Pearl & Tide]]. A [[Memory]] like [[Enduring Reflection]], [[Intuition]], or [[Confounding Parable]] could be used if more {{Lore|Rose}} is needed. ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[A Light in the Inkwell]]'': {{Quote|...Musgrave identifies 'the Ichor Auroral' as the mother of the encaustum Porphyrine...}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[From History to Eternity]]'': {{Quote|...'Ichor Auroral' can be brewed into an encaustum terminale associated with the Second History, using Inks of Revelation techniques with Rose aspect. The author warns that this is exceptionally difficult, since these techniques aren't aligned with Rose....}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found by [[Consider]]ing a [[Lenten Rose]]: {{Quote|There's a story that Serena Blackwood took a specimen of this rose to the Invisible Serapeum when she left. There's another story that it's the unexpected component of a secret Keeper-level recipe for the Great Ink Porphyrine...}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Encaustum Terminale]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Moon]] [[Category:Rose]]

Pale Mommet.title: Pale Mommet
Pale Mommet.text:
{{BoH Item |image1=Pale Mommet.png |principles={{Lore|Grail|4}}, {{Lore|Heart|2}}, {{Lore|Moth|2}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Tool]], [[Device]],
[[Inert]], [[Woven]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Infirmary]] *[[Fludd Gallery]] (Hidden) *[[Crafting]] [[Cache]]: *[[Box of Oddities]]}} {{Quote|A gently twitching little cloth doll with melancholy button eyes and a frill of coloured ribbons.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Grail|}}, {{Lore|Heart|}}, {{Lore|Moth|}} [[Woven]] [[Device]]. It can also be found in: *[[Infirmary]] *[[Fludd Gallery]], by Considering the [[Lumpy Melodic Chair]] *[[Box of Oddities]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|It's cold. It's always cold. It's grateful for my warmth…
[There are Scholar-level Grail recipes which can craft one of these from fabric.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Grail}}, [[Fabric and Fibre]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pentiments & Precursors]] |rowspan=5|{{Lore|Grail|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Fabric]] |rowspan=5|"Invest Grail-power in an almost-living doll." |rowspan=5|"[With Keeper-level Grail, a Pale Mommet is a precursor to a Flushed Mommet.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Resurgences & Emergences]]Because it has {{Lore|Moth}}, this is the only Skill which can Craft the Pale Mommet on a [[Loom]]. |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sea Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[The Great Signs and the Great Scars]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Tridesma Hiera]] |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Flushed Mommet]]. Because the [[Loom]] does not accept items with {{Lore|Grail}}, but no other [[Workstations|Workstation]] accepts items with [[Fabric and Fibre]], crafting [[Pale Mommet]] is going to puzzle most beginners.
To make this work, Workstations will need to be tricked into accepting [[Elements of the Soul|Elements]] outside their specialty, either by using [[Resurgences & Emergences]] to get {{Lore|Grail}} into the Loom, or using [[Human Hair]] (an uncommon item) to get Fabric into any Workstation that accepts [[Remains]] and works with the given Skill. Recommended Workstations include: *[[Loom]] in [[Servants' Hall]] - Requires {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Nectar}} or {{Lore|Rose}}. This is the only Workstation which accepts any and all Fabric. *[[Calicite Altar]], [[Nocturnary]], [[Rowenarium (Workstation)|Rowenarium]], [[Sacred Spring (Workstation)|Sacred Spring]] - These all accept both {{Lore|Grail}} and [[Remains]], making it possible to Craft them with any of the eligible Skills and Human Hair. *Any workstation that accepts [[Fuel]] and {{Lore|Grail}}, like [[Alchemist's Glassware]], or any [[Workstations#Kitchen Ranges|Kitchen Range]], making it possible to Craft with any of the eligible Skills and Rags. *Any workstation that accepts [[Tools|Tool]] or [[Device]] and {{Lore|Grail}}, namely [[Desk: Eva|Eva]], [[Desk: Nonna|Nonna]], or [[Nocturnary]] may be used to Craft with any of the eligible Skills and [[Swaddled Thunder]]. This allows Swaddled Thunder, the only renewable Crafted Fabric, to be used with any of the eligible Skills. == Trivia == *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Calicite Supplications]]'': {{Quote|"One prayer describes how sufficient Grail-aspect can be used with [[Tridesma Hiera]] rites to give 'a life, a little life, a little little life' to a doll twisted from fabric…"}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[OGHKOR OGHKOR TISSILAK OGHKOR]]'': {{Quote|'With adequate Grail,' the Excellency Gnathobasis explains, 'the Pale Mommet wakes to life...}} *As of the "BANCROFT" update (21.9.2023), [[Rags]] now also count as [[Fabric and Fibre]], meaning any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that accepts [[Fuel]] and {{Lore|Grail}} can be used. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Tool]] [[Category:Device]] [[Category:Inert]] [[Category:Woven]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Grail]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Moth]]

Gather more Nectar! Wring it from the trees and earth! And our pyrissimus gushes forth the Sacrament! You will thank me.'}} *Another crafting hint can also be read from the book ''[[An Impertinent Vitulation]]'' with the following description (reading the book or hint is '''not''' needed for crafting). It also hints on the harvest results during Numa season in Practic Garden: {{Quote| 'Peterhans mentions that one of these Leaves & Thorns techniques, with sufficient Nectar aspect, can supposedly cause 'a marvellous copper fruit' to burst from wood, although she has never managed it herself - but in a 'certain season' the pear-trees in the Practic Garden will deliver something similar.'}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Fruit]] [[Category:Sustenance]] [[Category:Cooking Ingredient]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Nectar]]

{{BoH Item |image1=[[File:Sea.holly.png]] |principles={{Lore|Moon|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}, {{Lore|Winter|1}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Flower]] |Location=[[St Brandan's Cloister]] (x2)
(Summer, Autumn, Numa)}} {{quote|Umbelled spiny flowers, the steel-blue of a winter afternoon.}}
'''Sea Holly''' is a [[Flower]] with {{Lore|Moon|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}} and {{Lore|Winter|1}}. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from [[St Brandan's Cloister]] in [[Summer]], [[Autumn]] and [[Numa]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Traditionally, this was the flower of Hush House. Sometimes you find it along the dunes and cliff-tops hereabouts.}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. == Trivia == * Sea holly, ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eryngium_maritimum Eryngium maritimum]'', is a real plant that grows on various European coastlines. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Flower]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Sacrament Malachite.title: Sacrament Malachite
Sacrament Malachite.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Sacrament_Malachite.png |principles={{Lore|Nectar|6}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Beverage]], [[Restorative]], [[Cooking Ingredient]], [[Intoxicating]] |Location=*[[Fludd Gallery]] *[[Crafting]]}} {{Quote|Back in the Dawn Period, the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot used this in the rites of the Ring-Yew, the Hour which has also been called the Malachite.}}
'''Sacrament Malachite''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Nectar}} [[Restorative]], [[Intoxicating]] [[Beverage]] and a [[Cooking Ingredient]]. It can also be found in the [[Fludd Gallery]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Syrupy, applesome. Sleep too soon after drinking this, and there's a real chance you'll put down tiny roots.
[There are Keeper-level recipes that can brew this from pyrus auricalcinus , in the presence of sufficient Nectar.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Nectar}}, [[Pyrus Auricalcinus]] or [[Essential Periost]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Coil & Chasm]] |rowspan=7|{{Lore|Nectar|15}} |rowspan=6|[[Pyrus Auricalcinus]] |rowspan=6|"This pear can be a basis for a Nectar-sacrament of the deep woods." |rowspan=7|"In the name of the roots, of the blood, of the buzzing within…" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Drums & Dances]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Herbs & Infusions]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Leaves & Thorns]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Rites of the Roots]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Spices & Savours]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Stone Stories]] |[[Essential Periost]] |"From these green-dark earth-memories bone-borne, from these sticks of soul and substance, brew the sacrament which the earth might again claim as blood…" |} ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Red Book of Brittany]]'': {{Quote|The Red Flower is described as 'the temptation of suffering'; but its suffering can apparently be allayed when 'the Copper Fruit' is enspelled with Nectar-aspect alongside Herbs and Infusions techniques.}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Berrybook]]'': {{Quote|'Nectar, children mine - cast my words into a sufficiency of Nectar and watch the pyrus pyrissimus burst from wood. Gather more Nectar! Wring it from the trees and earth! And our pyrissimus gushes forth the Sacrament! You will thank me.'}} *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Green Jasper Tablet]]'': {{Quote|...Along the way, it reveals the secret of the Sacrament Malachite ('in which the merry Mare merrily spits') - brewed with the Rites of the Roots from the numa-pear, in the presence of sufficient Nectar-aspect."}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Beverage]] [[Category:Restorative]] [[Category:Cooking Ingredient]] [[Category:Intoxicating]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Nectar]]

Thankfully, this was true yesterday and it is still true today." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sharps]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sickle & Eclipse]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Meniscate Reflections]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Serpents & Venoms]] ||{{Lore|Scale|15}} |} ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Enchiridion Tragularis]]'': {{Quote|Immunity to their own poisons was a constant concern for the Tragulari, and they constantly dosed themselves with substances that might built up immunity. Sack of Vegetables.title: Sack of Vegetables
Sack of Vegetables.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=[[File:Sack of Vegetables.png]] |principles={{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Sustenance]], [[Raw]], [[Cooking Ingredient]] |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[Kitchen Garden]] (x3)
(Summer, Autumn)}} {{Quote|Stew-in-waiting.}}
'''Sack of Vegetables''' is a [[Raw]] [[Sustenance]] and a [[Cooking Ingredient]]. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] in the [[Kitchen Garden]] (x3) in [[Summer]] and [[Autumn]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Fresh and hearty.}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. Considering a sack of vegetables also gives options to identify it into one of five kinds of vegetable: Marrow, [[Potatoes]], [[Pumpkin]], [[Basket of Onions|Onions]] or [[Basket of Leeks|Leeks]]. If Marrow is selected, all four kinds of Marrows are given in turn: *[[Dark Marrow]] ({{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Moon|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}) *[[Golden Marrow]] ({{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Lantern|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}) *[[Pale Marrow]] ({{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}, {{Lore|Winter|1}}) *[[Acrid Marrow]] ({{Lore|Edge|1}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}) The other vegetables are as follows: * [[Potatoes]] ({{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Winter|1}}) * [[Pumpkin]] ({{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}}) * [[Basket of Onions]] ({{Lore|Edge|1}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}) * [[Basket of Leeks]] ({{Lore|Edge|1}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}}) Note that selecting pumpkin ''always'' yields [[Pumpkin]], never [[Soft Amber Pumpkin]], [[Amber Pumpkin]], nor [[Wormy Pumpkin]]. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Sustenance]] [[Category:Raw]] [[Category:Cooking Ingredient]] [[Category:Gathering]]

[There are Prentice-level Sky recipes which can create this.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Prentice-level {{Lore|Sky}} and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Containment]] |rowspan=3 |{{Lore|Sky}} |rowspan=3|5 |rowspan=3|"Brew a bright and persistent ink." |rowspan=3|"Don't spill it." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Power]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Revelation]] |} ==Trivia== * Stargall Ink has very little, if any, long-term use for reading, as [[Mazarine Fife]], a Craftable mid-game [[Tool]], provides more {{Lore|Sky}} than this Ink does and is not consumed in the process. * It IS however a [[Liquid]] that provides {{Lore|Sky}}, making it a good ingredient to use when Crafting [[Xanthotic Essence]] using [[Anbary & Lapidary]]. * Stargall is an easy to craft {{Lore|Forge}}/{{Lore|Sky}}/{{Lore|Rose}} Ink for writing [[Manuscript]]s on [[Skills]] with the same main [[Principles]], although none of Skills required to craft it have the {{Lore|Sky}} Principle. * A hint for this recipe is found in ''[[It Is Written]]'': {{Quote|...He insist that yewgall and stargall, which can be mixed with sufficient Nectar or Sky aspect, are sufficient for 'most befitting Purposes'.}} * A hint for this recipe is found in ''[[Annals of St Brandan's]]'': {{Quote|...The helpful scribe explains that for the new foundation, the Abbot has mandated stargall, not yewgall, ink. He outlines the differences (use of Inks of Containment techniques with a Sky, not Nectar, context)...}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Rose]] [[Category:Sky]]

Swaddled Thunder.title: Swaddled Thunder
Swaddled Thunder.text:
{{BoH_Item |principles={{Lore|Heart|6}}, {{Lore|Sky|4}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Tool]], [[Device]],
[[Fabric and Fibre]] |image1=Swaddled Thunder.png}} {{quote|A storm swathed in subtle threads, ready to be released with a few judicious snips.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Tool]], [[Device]] and [[Fabric and Fibre]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|The thread parts - the weave is empty - the skies cry out!
[There are Keeper-level Heart recipes that can craft this from a Frith-Weft or a Thunderskin's Paean.]}} Generates [[Storm]] and destroys the item. Unlike other [[Memory|Memories]], this Weather can stack with itself multiple times and doesn't remove the current Weather card. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Heart}}, [[Frith-Weft]] or [[Thunderskin's Paean]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Stitching & Binding]] |rowspan=5|{{Lore|Heart|15}} |rowspan=3|[[Frith-Weft]] |rowspan=5|"Draw storm-potential into the weft, to capture more Heart-aspect." |rowspan=5|"Sleep, o thou tempest;
for now, bow thy head…" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Quenchings & Quellings]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Weaving & Knotworking]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Drums & Dances]] |rowspan=2|[[Thunderskin's Paean]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Strings & Songs]] |} ==Trivia== *Prior to ''[[House of Light]]'', the Swaddled Thunder was not a [[Device]], making it reusable. Now it has the Device aspect, and is consumed when you [[Consider]] it, but you can still hold onto multiple copies to use back to back. *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Two Wombs, One Heart]]'': {{Quote|...Although Thirza is very probably just making up much of the story, there are long passages expounding notable techniques of weave-work and thread-feit. In particular, when Witch and Sister flee across the Sea to be together, Thirza explains how they fashioned a 'peace-weave' with Heart and these arts, and then, to tame the winds, called on Heart again to swaddle the thunder in the peace-weave.}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Tool]] [[Category:Device]] [[Category:Fabric and Fibre]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Sky]]

Solomon\u2019s Preparation.title: Solomon’s Preparation
Solomon\u2019s Preparation.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Solomon_Preparation.png |principles={{Lore|Moon|1}}, {{Lore|Moth|1}}, {{Lore|Winter|4}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Beverage]], [[Restorative]] |Location=[[Hush House]]: * [[Foundry]] * [[Fludd Gallery]] * [[Gaol Cellar]] * [[Crafting]]}} {{quote|Solomon Husher would take this every night without fail before sleep, to close his ears to the sound of the waves. But on the 9th of January 1838, a heavy snow fell on Hush House. When the other residents dug themselves out, Husher was nowhere to be found. He had left a resignation letter, and an undrunk measure of his Preparation.}}
'''Solomon's Preparation''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Winter}} [[Restorative]] [[Beverage]]. It can also be found in: *[[Foundry]] *[[Fludd Gallery]] *[[Gaol Cellar]] ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|The sounds around me remain, but I find that I can attend to each one, diminishing it or returning it as if I were closing a door on a troublesome draught. For no obvious reason, I find myself recalling that the 9th of January is the Agonalia of Janus.
[There are Scholar-level recipes that can use flower-petals alongside Moon or Winter to craft this.]}}
Generates [[Memory: Hindsight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Winter}} or {{Lore|Moon}}, a [[Flower]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Containment]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Winter|10}} |rowspan=6|[[Flower]] |rowspan=6|"Muddle and mix a wintry preparation." |rowspan=4|"[With Keeper-level Winter, Solomon's Preparations are a precursor to the Great Ink Nillycant.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Quenchings & Quellings]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Ragged Crossroads]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sights & Sensations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Edicts Inviolable]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Moon|10}} |rowspan=2|"[With Keeper-level Winter - not Moon - Solomon's Preparations are a precursor to the Great Ink Nillycant.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Maggephene Mysteries]] |}
{{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Nillycant]]. The following [[Workstations]] will accept Flowers and the appropriate [[Aspects]]: * [[Alchemist's Glassware]] [Accepts {{Lore|Winter}}] * [[Altar of the Knot]] [Accepts {{Lore|Moon}}] * [[Calicite Altar]] [Accepts {{Lore|Moon}}] * [[Hearth: Hall of Voices]] [Accepts {{Lore|Moon}}] ==Trivia == *The preparation is hinted in the [[Readable|Book]] ''[[Musgrave's Sketches]]''. It also hints into the preparation of the 'final pigment', [[Nillycant]], using Solomon's Preparations as an ingredient: {{Quote|Musgrave discusses the temptation of the perfectly minimal 'palest painting'. He has so far managed to resist this temptation, but does guiltily describe success in using Sights and Sensations with Winter-aspect to create first a 'chilly elixir' from flowers, which he believes he can refine further into a 'final pigment'..."}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Beverage]] [[Category:Restorative]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Moon]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Winter]]

Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Inks of Revelation]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sacra Solis Invicti]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Watchman's Paradoxes]] |} == Trivia == *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Alloy of the White Rose]]'': {{Quote|'Mistress White-Flower' urges a 'History of Uzult', where the Second Dawn may come to pass. Xanthotic Essence.title: Xanthotic Essence
Xanthotic Essence.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Xanthotic_Essence.png |principles={{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Knock|2}}, {{Lore|Lantern|5}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Pigment]] |Location=*[[Fludd Gallery]] *[[Crafting]]}} {{quote|The rich gold of a summer afternoon. 'If sunlight precedes moonlight,' St Anselm observed, 'the Meniscate must precede the Madrugad; and the light that was lost will remain.'}}
'''Xanthotic Essence''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Lantern}} [[Liquid]] and [[Pigment]]. It can also be found in the [[Fludd Gallery]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Yellower than buttercups. [Various Lantern recipes can be used to create Xanthotic Essence from various precursors.]}} Generates [[Memory: Revelation]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Lantern}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, a [[Liquid]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Auroral Contemplations]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Lantern|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Liquid]] |"Lighten this liquid to a golden essence of Lantern-power." |rowspan=4|"[With Keeper-level Lantern, Xanthotic Essence is the precursor of the Great Ink Uzult.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Purifications & Exaltations]] |"Exalt this liquid into a golden essence of Lantern-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pyroglyphics]] |"Candesce this liquid to a golden essence of Lantern-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |"Transform this liquid into a golden essence of Lantern-power." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Anbary & Lapidary]] |{{Lore|Sky|10}} |"Energise this liquid into a golden essence of Lantern-power." |"[With Keeper-level Lantern - not Sky - Xanthotic Essence is the precursor of the Great Ink Uzult.]" |}
{{PAGENAME}} can also be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Lantern}}, [[Bitterblack Salts]] or [[Iotic Essence]] and [[Purifications & Exaltations]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |rowspan=2|[[Purifications & Exaltations]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Lantern|15}} |[[Bitterblack Salts]] |"Exalt these salts into a golden essence of Lantern-power." |rowspan=2|"Golden as noon…" |- |[[Iotic Essence]] |"Purify this into a golden essence of Lantern-power." |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft: *[[Uzult]] *[[Iotic Essence]] ==Trivia== * Xanthotic Essence is also found [https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Xanthotic_Essence in Cultist Simulator]. *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[The Alloy of the White Rose]]'': {{Quote|...She identifies Xanthotic Essence as Uzult's predecessor; she explains that with sufficient Lantern, Bitterblack Salts can be Purified to Xanthotic Essence, and Iotic Essence can be Exalted to Xanthotic Essence."}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Pigment]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Lantern]]

Yewgall Ink.title: Yewgall Ink
Yewgall Ink.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Yewgall Ink.png |principles={{Lore|Moth|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|2}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Liquid]], [[Ink]] |Location=*[[Watchman's Tower: First Floor|Watchman's Tower:
First Floor]] *[[Hermit Cell]] *[[Crafting]]}} {{quote|A variant of iron gall ink, particularly difficult to erase; a minor Ink of Power.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Nectar}} [[Ink]]. It can be found in the [[Watchman's Tower: First Floor]] and the [[Hermit Cell]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|The deepest of blackish greens. [There are Prentice-level Nectar recipes which can create this.]}} Generates [[Memory: Scent]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Prentice-level {{Lore|Nectar}} or {{Lore|Winter}} and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |[[Inks of Containment]] |rowspan=6|{{Lore|Nectar|5}} |rowspan=7|"Brew a dark and persistent ink." |rowspan=7|"Don't spill it." |- |[[Inks of Power]] |- |[[Inks of Revelation]] |- |[[Insects & Nectars]] |- |[[Leaves & Thorns]] |- |[[Rites of the Roots]] |- |[[Putrefactions & Calcinations]] ||{{Lore|Winter|5}} |} == Trivia == *A hint for this recipe can be found in  ''[[It Is Written]]'': {{Quote|Musgrave coyly refuses to talk of the Great Inks (or else refuses to admit he doesn't know much about them). He insist that yewgall and stargall, which can be mixed with sufficient Nectar or Sky aspect, are sufficient for 'most befitting Purposes'.}} *A hint can be found in  ''[[De Ratio Quercuum]]'' : {{Quote|...He does mention more usefully that the minor Ink of Power, Yewgall, can be brewed through the Rites of the Roots with the assistance of the aspect Nectar."}} *A hint can be found in  ''[[Annals of St Brandan's]]'' : {{Quote|...The helpful scribe explains that for the new foundation, the Abbot has mandated stargall, not yewgall, ink. He outlines the differences (use of Inks of Containment techniques with a Sky, not Nectar, context) but doesn't trouble to explain why."}} *A hint can be found in  ''[[Honey: the Comprehensive Guide]]'' : {{Quote|Hattington insists that all the primary aspects - Nectar, Scale, Heart, Lantern, Moth, Grail - are possessed by bees and expressed in honey... Yewgall Ink is prepared with these techniques...}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Liquid]] [[Category:Ink]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Nectar]]

It can be found in: *[[Librarian's Quarters]] *[[Box of Oddities]] ===[[Consider]] this:=== {{Quote|The taste is like a lingering kiss at the mouth's edge. I'll mix that into a tisane." |rowspan=5|"It's best when it's warm; but it'll keep." |- |[[Leaves & Thorns]] |"The odd leaf and the occasional berry, dried to brew a tisane." |- |[[Orchids & Narcotics]] |"The odd petal and the occasional stem, dried to brew a tisane." |- |[[Sea Stories]] |"Here where the sea sounds, I can mix a tide-touched tisane." |- |[[The Great Signs and the Great Scars]] |"Daub the vessel with suitable signs, and the tisane within

{{BoH_Item |image1=File:Wescott's Compounds.png |principles={{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Grail|1}}, {{Lore|Lantern|1}}, {{Lore|Moth|1}}, {{Lore|Nectar|1}} |category=[[Thing]], [[Material]] |Location=* [[Motley Tower: Dispensary]] * [[Crafting]]}} {{quote|Reagents and activants to enhance alchemical operations, or the flavour of one's pipe tobacco.}}

[There are Prentice-level Forge and Moth recipes which can be used to create more.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Prentice-level {{Lore|Moth}} or {{Lore|Forge}} and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |[[Sacra Limiae]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Moth|5}} |"The Ordo Limiae taught how to prepare Forgeful compounds from ephemeral materials - 'the Moth finds the Flame'." |"The common name now is 'Westcott's Compounds', but the Ordo Limiae is older than Westcott by… quite some centuries. Probably. Westcott wasn't Long as far as anyone ever knew." |- |[[Solutions & Separations]] |"An alchemical trick for rendering the ephemeral into volatile compounds - 'the Moth finds the Flame'." |rowspan=4|"Westcott probably didn't invent all these, but he knew how to make a name stick." |- |[[Meniscate Reflections]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Forge|5}} |"The Reflections include alchemical techniques. I can use those to prepare an odd set of compounds with a variety of uses." |- |[[Pyroglyphics]] |rowspan=2|"Sort, mix, concentrate: an odd set of compounds with a variety of uses." |- |[[Spices & Savours]] |} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Material]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Grail]] [[Category:Lantern]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Nectar]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Lantern}} [[Metal]] [[Material]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|There is a sunset song which tells how in sea-stolen Ys, all the water-ewers were orichalcum, and all the window-panes were amber… [There are Scholar-level Forge recipes which can be used to craft this from another metal.]}} Generates [[Memory: Regret]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Foundry (Workstation)|the Foundry]] or [[Oubliette Containment]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Knock}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, a [[Metal]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Bells & Brazieries]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Forge|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Metal]] |rowspan=5|"Use this metal as a base for the fabled Forge-alloy called orichalcum." |rowspan=5|"[With Keeper-level Forge, orichalcum can catalyse and contain the Azoth.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Disciplines of the Hammer]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Door & Wall]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]] ||{{Lore|Knock|10}} |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Lockworks & Clockworks]] ||{{Lore|Sky|10}} |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Azoth]]. [Certain Keeper-level Winter recipes can be used to craft this from Essential Periost.]}} Generates [[Old Moment]] and destroys the item. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Winter}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, [[Essential Periost]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Putrefactions & Calcinations]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Winter|15}} |rowspan=5|[[Essential Periost]] |rowspan=4|"Draw, very carefully, on an ancient privilege of the House to manifest Winter." |rowspan=5|"Use with care. The Madrugad, for her own reasons, tolerates the house. Let's not test her tolerance." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Ragged Crossroads]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Rhyme & Remembrance]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Snow Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Ouranoscopy]] ||{{Lore|Sky|15}} |"Craft a remedy against age from the celestial influence-trace that striate these remnants. |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: {| class="article-table" !|{{Lore|Winter}} !|{{Lore|Sky}} |- | *[[Alchemist's Glassware]] *[[Catacombs Altar]] *[[Columbic Sarcophagus]] *[[Gullscry Workbench]] *[[Necropsy Table]] *[[Nocturnary]] *[[Oubliette Containment]] *[[Rowenarium (Workstation)|Rowenarium]] | *[[Gullscry Workbench]] *[[Hermit's Workbench]] |} ==Trivia== *A hint for crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[De motu corporum vetitorum]]'': {{Quote|...He insists that Ouranoscopic techniques can be used with Essential Periost and sufficient Sky to create a 'talisman gerifugic'.}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Mark]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Winter]]

Wyrd-Weft.text:
{{BoH_Item |image1=Wyrd-Weft.png |principles={{Lore|Heart|3}}, {{Lore|Winter|6}} |type=[[Thing]], [[Fabric and Fibre]] |Location=[[Crafting]]}} {{Quote|A weave that either entrains, or follows, Fate. It's hard to be sure which.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Winter}} [[Fabric and Fibre]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Tease it apart, and find what might have been.
[There are Keeper-level Winter recipes which can craft one of these with fabric.]}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Winter}}, [[Fabric and Fibre]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Stitching & Binding]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Winter|15}} |rowspan=2|[[Fabric and Fibre]] |rowspan=2|"Draw Winter into a web of little fates." |rowspan=2|"Every thread a future, and every other thread a past." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Weaving & Knotworking]] |} Hint: [[Rags]] can be used at the [[Necropsy Table]], which accepts {{Lore|Winter}} and {{Lore|Heart}}. Wyrd-Weft is arguably the trickiest item to craft in the whole game, as it is available only via Winter Keeper-level recipes with non-Winter skills. Here is one way to do it without having to invest in strong soul cards or use rare/non-renewable ingredients: * Regular [[Wist]] card, providing 2 {{Lore|Winter}}. * Rags as a required fabric, providing 1 {{Lore|Winter}}. Rags can be obtained in a renewable manner by disassembling a [[Pale Mommet]] at a Workbench. Pale Mommet, in turn, may be crafted using [[Swaddled Thunder]] as a required fabric, which can be crafted from [[Thunderskin's Paean]] memory. * Craftable [[Wormwood Dream]] memory, providing 6 {{Lore|Winter}}. * Craftable [[Year-Tally]] mark, providing 6 {{Lore|Winter}}. These ingredients total to 15 {{Lore|Winter}}, which is enough for a Keeper-level recipe. As a crafting station, you will need a shrine that accepts [[Fuel]] (for Rags) and [[Mark]] (for Year-Tally). That means [[Shrine: the Chancel]] for [[Weaving & Knotworking]] skill (since it accepts both Winter and Moth) or [[Shrine: the Madrugad]] for [[Stitching & Binding]] (since it accepts both Winter and Sky). ==Trivia== *A hint for crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Notes on Bindings]]'': {{Quote|Gideon speaks reverently of the 'wyrd-weft', which he has achieved by applying Stitching and Binding arts to a fabric in the presence of sufficient Winter. He laments however that its complexities only approach those understood by the Sisterhood of the Knot, which in turn are only a shadow of 'the true Braid of Histories'.}} [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Fabric and Fibre]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Winter]]
