Writing-Case.title: Writing-Case
Writing-Case.text:
{{Stub}} {{BoH_Item |image1=[[File:Writing-Case.png]] |type=[[Thing]], [[Blank]]}} {{Quote|'A sturdy brass-cornered writing-case which has been of service to at least three Librarians of the House. [Use your Writing-Case in a Desk with Ink to invite Visitors to a Salon. To invite villagers, add your Writing-Case as a discussion subject when you visit them in Brancrug.]}}
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Blank]] item introduced in the ''[[House of Light]]'' DLC, which allows recording the addresses of [[Visitors]] and [[Villagers]] and requesting their presence for a [[Salon]]. It will be sent to the Librarian by [[Dr Serena Blackwood]] after [[A Reply to the Trust]] has been mailed through the [[Post Office]], arriving at the end of the next spring. {{Quote|A package from Dr Serena Blackwood, who once also served as Librarian here:

'Librarian: I remember very well how remote Brancrug is from the world. In Alexandria, I have both a telegraph office and more company than I can easily stand. You will, I think, make better use of this than I.

Best wishes
Serena'|A Gift from Dr Blackwood}} It cannot be [[Consider]]ed. ==Inviting Visitors for a Salon== After a Visitor has been consulted about an ongoing [[Incident]], if the Writing-Case is present, they will give the Librarian their card, which can be used with the Writing-Case at a [[Workstations#Desks|desk]] in order to record it. This destroys the card and generates an [[Occult Scrap]], which will allow them to be summoned by using the Writing-Case at a desk with the necessary [[Principle]] and an [[Ink]], which will be destroyed. [[Perinculate]] cannot be used, as it is dreadfully poisonous. This creates an [[An Invitation]], which needs to be mailed through the [[Post Office]] for a [[Pence|Penny]]. They will arrive 65 seconds later. After holding a Salon, the same visitors can be invited again, but a salon cannot be held again until next [[season]]. Note that only the Ink slot is required, provided it covers the requirements. ==Inviting Villagers for a Salon== Villagers can be invited by first going to their house, using a matching [[Elements of the Soul|Element of the Soul]] and adding the Writing-Case in the Topic verb. They will provide one [[Cooking Ingredient]] from a number of options and get moved to your Sundries tab, where they will stay indefinitely until summoned for a Salon - this does not prevent them from being used to unlock more rooms. Only a single Villager can be invited at a time, and only once per season. If they are unavailable, the Soul card will be returned unfatigued. Note that Villagers can only go into the first slot of a Salon, so they should be added first. [[Category:Thing]] [[Category:Blank]] [[Category:Salon]]

An '''Ascendant Harmony''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Persistent]] [[Memory]] and [[Sound (Aspect)|Sound]]. ==Skill evolution== {{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[Birdsong]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Sky}}, an [[Instrument]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Applebright Euphonies]] |rowspan=6|{{Lore|Sky|10}} |rowspan=6|[[Instrument]] |rowspan=6|"Conjure bright Sky-music." |rowspan=6|"[With Keeper-level Sky, an Ascendant Harmony might conjure a Didumos.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Bells & Brazieries]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Furs & Feathers]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Purifications & Exaltations]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sky Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Strings & Songs]] |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Didumos]]. ===Crafting tips=== Early on, [[Didumos]] and the required Ascendant Harmony can be repeatedly crafted easily in the [[Windlit Gallery]] with the [[Windlit Workbench]], [[Bells & Brazieries]] and two [[Mazarine Fife]]s.
The same strategy applies to the [[Telescope]] in the [[Watchman's Tower: Observatory]] and any of the above Skills, as the Telescope can take two [[Tools]]. [[Category:Evolve via Birdsong]] [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Persistent]] [[Category:Sound]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Lantern]] [[Category:Sky]]

Memory: Sound.title: Memory: Sound
Memory: Sound.text:
{{BoH Memory |image=MemorySound.png |principles={{Lore|Heart|1}} |aspects=[[Memory]] |obtained_by=Consideration, Gathering}} ''{{About|the memory|the aspect|Sound (Aspect)}}'' {{Quote|A memory lasts longer than an echo. Of course when Speech came into the world, and we could cast echoes into words, things got more complicated.}}
'''Memory: Sound''' is a [[Memory]] with {{Lore|Heart|1}}. Although some Memories are [[Sound (Aspect)|Sounds]], '''Memory: Sound''' is not a Sound (just the memory of one). It can be obtained by [[Consider]]ing some objects, [[Gathering|gathering]], or by renouncing [[Thing]]s in the [[Hush House Well]]. The following items can be considered to generate Memory: Sound without consuming them. *[[Chair of Challenges]] *[[Terrence]] *[[Tuppence]] *[[Magnificent Green Cockatoo]] *[[Outsized Egg]] *Pet [[Gull]] *[[Hush House Key]] *[[Mazarine Fife]] *[[Chaise-Longue of Conclusions]] *[[Dappled Practice Sword]] *[[Dappled Quarterstaff]] Memory: Sound can also be gathered at the [[Beehive]] in [[Season|Autumn]] or [[Season|Winter]], and at [[The Gull-Colony]] in any season except for [[Numa]]. [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Enduring Reflection.title: Enduring Reflection
Enduring Reflection.text:
{{BoH_Memory |image=Enduring Reflection.png |principles={{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Knock|1}}, {{Lore|Rose|3}} |aspects=[[Evolve via Nyctodromy]], [[Memory]], [[Persistent]] |obtained_by=[[Hush House]]: * [[Crafting]] [[Gathering]] *[[A Walk on the Moor]] (Numa) *[[The Sea-Caves]] (Numa)}} {{Quote|Refine what is; recall what remains.}}
'''Enduring Reflection''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Rose}} [[Persistent]] [[Memory]]. It can also be [[Gathering|Gathered]] during [[Numa]] in: *[[The Sea-Caves]] (25%) *[[A Walk on the Moor]] (20%) ==Skill evolution==
{{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[Nyctodromy]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. ==Crafting==
{{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Rose}}, a [[Memory]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Path & Pilgrim]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Rose|10}} |rowspan=4|[[Memory]] |rowspan=4|"Refine memory to something of Rose." |rowspan=4|"[With Keeper-level Rose, an Enduring Reflection can give rise to visions of wilder possibilities...]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pearl & Tide]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Preliminal Meter]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sky Stories]] |} {{PAGENAME}} is required to Craft [[Horizon-Sight]]. [[Category:Evolve via Nyctodromy]] [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Persistent]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Rose]]

Horizon-Sight.title: Horizon-Sight
Horizon-Sight.text:
{{BoH_Memory |image=Horizon Sight.png |principles={{Lore|Rose|4}} |aspects=[[Evolve via Hushery]],
[[Memory]], [[Persistent]] |obtained_by=[[Crafting]] [[Gathering]]: *[[The Gull-Colony]] ([[Numa]]) *[[Sea's Edge]] ([[Numa]]) [[Consider]]: *[[Gervinite]] *[[Walls-of-Ys]] [[Talk]]: *[[Stymphling]] *[[Dr Arun Peel]] Resting: *[[The Sweet Bones]] (Numa)}} {{Quote|'On a clear autumn day, the story goes, you can see Ys from the Watchman's Tower. I don't know whether that's true. But on a clear day in Numa… you would see the City Unbuilt.'|Dr Brian Levinsen}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Rose}} [[Persistent]] [[Memory]]. It can also be acquired by: *[[Consider]]ing [[Gervinite]] or [[Walls-of-Ys]] *[[Talk]]ing to a [[Stymphling]] *Renouncing a [[Pence|Penny]] at the [[Sea's Edge]] during Numa *[[Gathering]] at [[The Gull-Colony]] during [[Numa]] (14%) *Resting at [[The Sweet Bones]] in Numa. This will inflict a Malady. *Talking with [[Dr Arun Peel]] about ''[[The Radical Measure]]'' (once only) == Skill evolution == The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[Hushery]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Rose}}, [[Enduring Reflection]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Path & Pilgrim]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Rose|15}} |rowspan=4|[[Enduring Reflection]] |rowspan=4|"Draw a Rose-vision from this memory." |rowspan=4|"Lift your eyes. That's often good advice, but when we're about this business, it's the best. Lift your eyes, and look around." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Preliminal Meter]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sand Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sky Stories]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: *[[Deeplight Corals]] *[[Governor's Phonograph]] *[[Instrument: Grand Piano]] *[[Loggia Prospect]] *[[Rowenarium (Workstation)|Rowenarium]] *[[Shrine: St Januarius]] *[[Shrine: the Watchman]] *[[Telescope]] == Trivia == *Talking with Stymphling is probably the easiest way to get it early (can be repeated via [[Canned Ham]]). Crafting Gervinite and Considering it is also relatively easy in mid-to-late-game. *A hint to the creation of this memory is written in ''[[A Novel Method for Invocation & Contrition]]'': {{Quote|Morrow demonstrates that Preliminal Meter techniques can be used with sufficient Rose to invoke the Vagabond's Names, transforming an Enduring Reflection into 'something wider of sky.'}} [[Category:Evolve via Hushery]] [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Persistent]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Rose]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Numa]] [[Category:Consideration]] [[Category:Conversation]]

Invincible Audacity.title: Invincible Audacity
Invincible Audacity.text:
{{BoH Memory |image=Invincible Audacity.png |principles={{Lore|Edge|6}}, {{Lore|Forge|3}}, {{Lore|Lantern|3}} |aspects=[[Memory]], [[Persistent]],
[[Evolve via Illumination]], [[Evolve via Ithastry]] |obtained_by=*[[Crafting]] *Burning the [[Journals|Journal]]}} {{Quote|A general says: when I make the right choice, I win. An Illuminate says: when I win, I determine which choice was the right one.|Natalia Brulleau}}
'''Invincible Audacity''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] [[Memory]] with {{Lore|Edge|6}}, {{Lore|Forge|3}} and {{Lore|Lantern|3}}. It can also be obtained by burning the [[Journals|Journal]] in any [[Workstation#Fireplaces|Fireplace]], rendering the game unwinnable. == Skill evolution == The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[Illumination]] or [[Ithastry]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Edge}}, a [[Winning Move]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Auroral Contemplations]] |rowspan=3|{{Lore|Edge|15}} |rowspan=3|[[Winning Move]] |rowspan=3|"Extend your understanding into a more potent Edge-lesson." |rowspan=3|"The Colonel's lessons, and the Lionsmith's lessons, have been unkindly, and reductively, rendered as 'stab' versus 'thump'.." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Disciplines of the Hammer]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Edicts Martial]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: {| class="article" !colspan=2| |- | *[[Altar: Ascite]] *[[Condignator]] *[[Desk: Eva]] *[[Desk: Governor]] *[[Desk: Vagabond]] *[[Exercise Yard]] | *[[Foundry (Workstation)|Foundry]] *[[Hearth: Hall of Voices]] *[[Oubliette Containment]] *[[Practic Garden Dummy]] *[[Practice Equipment]] *[[Shrine: the Chancel]] |} == Trivia == *The recipe for Crafting this Memory is described in the book ''[[Seven Shards]]'': {{quote|'The Seventh Shard we call, informally, the Invincible Audacity, which is struck from the Winning Move as the Winning Move is struck from a memory - with the application of sufficient Edge.'}} [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Persistent]] [[Category:Evolve via Illumination]] [[Category:Evolve via Ithastry]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Edge]] [[Category:Forge]] [[Category:Lantern]]

|} === Strategy for Crafting === One of the easiest ways to Craft this recipe is to use the [[Stymphling]] ({{Lore|Scale|3}}), [[Living Relic]] ({{Lore|Scale|4}}), and {{ES|Health}} ({{Lore|Scale|1}}) {{BoH Memory |image=music.hive.png |principles={{Lore|Moth|2}}, {{Lore|Nectar|4}}, {{Lore|Winter|2}} |aspects=[[Evolve via The Bosk]], [[Memory]], [[Persistent]], [[Sound (Aspect)|Sound]] |obtained_by=[[Hush House]]: *[[Crafting]] *[[Talk]]ing to a [[Perilous Imago]] [[Gathering]]: *[[Beehive]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Winter}} [[Persistent]] [[Memory]] and [[Sound (Aspect)|Sound]]. It can also be obtained by: *[[Talk]]ing to a [[Perilous Imago]] *[[Gathering]] at the [[Beehive]] in [[Season|Autumn]], [[Season|Winter]], and [[Numa]] *Resting at [[The Sweet Bones]] in [[Numa]] ==Skill evolution== {{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[The Bosk]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Nectar}}, an [[Instrument]] and [[Drums & Dances]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Drums & Dances]] ||{{Lore|Nectar|10}} |[[Instrument]] |"A beating in the heart…" |"A buzzing in the skull…" |- |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: {| class="article-table" !Normally !colspan=2|Requires the use of a [[Mazarine Fife]] |- |[[Instrument: Hallowed Drum]] |[[Desk: Natan]] |Only with [[Memory: Impulse]] |- |rowspan=4| |[[Desk: Nonna]] | - |- |[[Desk: Reading Room]] |No compatible memories |- |[[Necropsy Table]] |Only with [[Earth-Sign]] |- |[[Windlit Workbench]] |No compatible memories |- |} It's technically possible to use some workstations, but it would require high skill levels or the use of a [[Numen]]. [[Evolve via Horomachistry]],

{{BoH Memory |image=Achievement NumenBellsOfYs.jpg |principles={{Lore|Edge|5}}, {{Lore|Forge|5}}, {{Lore|Rose|5}} |aspects=[[Memory]], [[Numen]], [[Persistent]] |obtained_by=Reading}} {{Quote|Ys, by her arts, found the strike-tone that shakes the Hours. Numen: Loopholes.text:
{{BoH Memory |image=Achievement NumenLoopholes.jpg |principles={{Lore|Knock|5}}, {{Lore|Moon|5}}, {{Lore|Moth|5}} |aspects=[[Memory]], [[Numen]], [[Persistent]] |obtained_by=Reading}} {{Quote|When Eternity came into the world, certain prudent powers arranged loopholes: the House of the Moon, the persistence of possibility, the right to vengeance. In the right Histories, those loopholes will open again... [Any Librarian can use this to establish a [[History]] and complete the game - but [[the Twice-Born]] can win a particular victory.]}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Numen]] with {{Lore|Knock|5}}, {{Lore|Moon|5}} and {{Lore|Moth|5}}. It can be obtained by reading [[Serpent-Root]]. If used to establish a [[History]], this Numen will provide a unique [[Endings|Ending]] for [[The Twice-Born]]. [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Numen]]

{{BoH Memory |image=Achievement NumenAFinalUnderstanding.jpg |principles={{Lore|Rose|5}}, {{Lore|Sky|5}}, {{Lore|Winter|5}} |aspects=[[Numen]], [[Memory]], [[Persistent]] |obtained_by=Reading}} {{Quote|Eternity and History cannot be reconciled. Freedom cannot be perfection - not unless we understand the paradox of the eternal ending. And only in certain Histories is that paradox possible... '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Numen]] with {{Lore|Rose|5}}, {{Lore|Sky|5}} and {{Lore|Winter|5}}. It can be obtained by reading [[Towards a Fundamental Aesthetic: Second Edition]]. '''Wind-in-Waiting''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Persistent]] [[Memory]]. == Skill evolution == The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[The Bosk]] or [[Birdsong]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Sky}}, a [[Mazarine Fife]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Furs & Feathers]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Sky|15}} |rowspan=4|[[Mazarine Fife]] |rowspan=4|"Secure a wind's promise from the Sky." |rowspan=4|"One last pipe-shrill, and the wind is still." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sacra Solis Invicti]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sky Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Strings & Songs]] |} Workstations with appropriate slots and Principles to create {{PAGENAME}} include: * [[Desk: Ambrose]] * [[Desk: Pale]] * [[Desk: Reading Room]] * [[Gullscry Workbench]] * [[Hermit's Workbench]] * [[Telescope]] === Crafting Tips === The 15 {{Lore|Sky}} required to Craft '''Wind-in-Waiting''' can be easily achieved by using two [[Mazarine Fife]]s and an [[Ascendant Harmony]] at the [[Hermit's Workbench]] or at the [[Telescope]]. Wind-Rumour.title: Wind-Rumour
Wind-Rumour.text:
{{BoH Memory |image=Wind-Rumour.png |principles={{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Sky|2}} |aspects=[[Evolve via Birdsong]], [[Memory]], [[Omen]] |obtained_by= [[Beast]]: *[[Gull]] [[Gathering]]: *[[A Walk on the Moor]] (Numa) *[[The Gull-Colony]]
(all seasons except Spring)}} {{Quote|'If the cloud were a canvas, who spread it? If the sky were a sheet, who knotted it?' A Wind-Rumour is an auspice found in the sky by those who look too long, interpretable only by the wise.}}
A '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Memory]] and an [[Omen]]. It can be obtained by: *[[Talk]]ing to a [[Gull|Pet Gull]] *[[Gathering]] at: **[[A Walk on the Moor]] in [[Numa]] **[[The Gull-Colony]] in all [[Season]]s except Spring. Note that, unlike other [[Omen|Omens]], the Wind-Rumour isn't [[Persistent]]. If you're not planning to use it in the day you obtained it, don't forget to preserve it via [[Bed|Dreaming]]. == Skill evolution == The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to [[Elements of the Soul#Evolution|Evolve Elements of the Soul]] with [[Skill|Skills]] committed to [[Birdsong]] at any [[Workstations|Workstation]] that takes two Soul cards and the relevant [[Principles]]. [[Category:Evolve via Birdsong]] [[Category:Memory]] [[Category:Omen]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Weather.title: Weather
Weather.text:
[[File:Weather icon.png|right]] {{Quote|Each kind of weather brings its own influence. I can make use of these as a Memory.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Aspects|Aspect]] of [[Memory]].
Each day a weather memory is generated by drawing from a seasonal [[Decks|Deck]] of possible weather conditions. The chance of different weather being drawn varies depending on the [[Season]]. The seasons decks are saved between years: in other words, if the first Autumn drew all Fog, then the second Autumn will have no Fog. [[Numa]]'s weather will always be [[Nume-Brume]]. During Numa, the game draws both [[Nume-Brume]] and a Weather card from the current seasonal deck, which means that the day after Numa, no weather card is drawn. After Numa ends, it also immediately ends the current season and starts the next one. [[Storm]] can also be obtained by [[Consider]]ing a [[Swaddled Thunder]] (this will destroy the Swaddled Thunder and can be stacked multiple times, alongside the current weather). Living Relic.title: Living Relic
Living Relic.text:
{{BoH Item |image1= Savage Relic.png|Savage Living Relic.png|Living Hungry Relic.png|Hungry |principles=When Living:
{{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Scale|4}}, {{Lore|Sky|2}}
When Savage or Hungry:
{{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Scale|4}}, {{Lore|Sky|1}} |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]],
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=[[Hush House]]: *[[Crafting]] [[Gathering]]: *[[Outsized Egg]] **[[The Gull-Colony]] (Numa) **[[The Sea-Caves]]
(Spring, Summer) *'''Savage Relic''' **[[Beachcombing]] (Numa)}} {{Quote|A shrieking little bundle of primordial ill-temper.}} __NOTOC__
The '''Living Relic''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Sky}} [[Beast]] and [[Comfort]]. It can also be [[Gathering|Gathered]]: *As an [[Outsized Egg]]: **[[The Gull-Colony]] in Numa **[[The Sea-Caves]] in Spring and Summer *As a Savage Relic: **[[Beachcombing]] in Numa The Egg can be hatched by [[Brewable|Brewing]] it in a [[Workstations|Fireplace or Kitchen Range]]. The resulting Savage Relic can then be [[Talk|Fed]] with [[Sustenance]] and turned into a Living Relic. It will only eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]]. A hatched or crafted Relic will always be obtained as a Living Relic, skipping the Savage Relic stage. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Its sigils evolve with age… but it ages so very slowly.}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Living Relic== {{Quote|Few of these have been seen in the world under this sun.}} [[Talk]]ing to it will generate an [[Old Moment]] and turn it Hungry. Considering it generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Hungry Relic== {{Quote|Quarrelsome, until it feeds again.}} Feeding it turns it back into a Living Relic. Considering it generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Scale}} or {{Lore|Sky}}, an [[Egg]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Furs & Feathers]] |rowspan=4|{{Lore|Scale|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Egg]] |rowspan=5|"Hatch a Scale-relic from the egg. |rowspan=4|"[With Keeper-level Scale, a Living Relic can be induced to help with the production of Houndsgall.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Hill & Hollow]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Pentiments & Precursors]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Stone Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Stitching & Binding]] ||{{Lore|Sky|10}} |"[With Keeper-level Scale - not Sky - a Living Relic can be induced to help with the production of Houndsgall.]" |} The Living Relic is required to Craft [[Houndsgall]]. ==Trivia== *The elements on its shell are similar to the symbols on the game loading screen. [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Heart]] [[Category:Scale]] [[Category:Sky]]

Chimeric Larva.title: Chimeric Larva
Chimeric Larva.text:
{{BoH Item |image1= Larva (Chimeric).png|Chimeric Larva Larva (Hungry).png|Hungry Larva |principles={{Lore|Knock|2}}, {{Lore|Moon|2}}, {{Lore|Moth|4}} |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]]
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=[[Crafting]]}} {{Quote|Approaching the chrysalis crossroads.}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Moth}} [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. [[Talk]]ing to it will generate [[Memory: Fear]] and turn it Hungry. Feeding it [[Sustenance]] will allow you to interact with it again.
It will refuse to eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]], but it will accept a [[Bottle of Milk]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|An undulating bundle of possibilities…
[Certain Scholar-level recipes will hatch this from an Egg in the presence of sufficient Moth - or sometimes Moon.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Hungry Larva== {{Quote|Twitching voraciously.}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Knock}} or {{Lore|Moth}}, an [[Egg]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Insects & Nectars]] |rowspan=2 |{{Lore|Moon|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Egg]] |"Beneath the auspices of dusk, hatch an eyeless larva pulsing with Moth-potential." |"[With Keeper-level Moon, perhaps I could coax this to develop further - as long as it's well-fed.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Hill & Hollow]] |rowspan=4|"Hatch an eyeless larva pulsing with Moth-potential." |"[With Keeper-level Moth - not Moon - and a more suitable skill, perhaps I could coax this to develop further - as long as it's well-fed.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Horns & Ivories]] ||{{Lore|Knock|10}} |"[With Keeper-level Moth - not Knock - and a more suitable skill, perhaps I could coax this to develop further - as long as it's well-fed.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Resurgences & Emergences]] |rowspan=2 |{{Lore|Moth|10}} |rowspan=2|"[With Keeper-level Moth, perhaps I could coax this to develop further - as long as it's well-fed.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |} The Chimeric Larva is required to Craft the [[Perilous Imago]]. [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Moon]] [[Category:Moth]]

Cat.title: Cat
Cat.text:
{{BoH Item |image1= Wild Cat.png|Stray Cat.png|Pet Cat Hungry Cat.png|Unimpressed |principles=When Stray or Pet:
{{Lore|Grail|2}}, {{Lore|Heart|2}}, {{Lore|Moth|2}}
When Unimpressed:
{{Lore|Grail|1}}, {{Lore|Moth|1}} |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]],
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[Beachcombing]]}} {{Quote|Feed some animals and earn their loyalty. Feed this one, and earn its patience.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] by [[Beachcombing]]. At first, it is a Stray. Feeding it [[Sustenance]] will turn it into a Pet. [[Talk]]ing to it will give [[Memory: Solace]] and make it Unimpressed and hungry.
It will only eat [[Egg]]s, [[Remains]] and a [[Bottle of Milk]]. The Cat is unique. Only one can ever be found, and if released it can never be found again. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Elegant, inscrutable, indefatigable.}} == Stray Cat == {{Quote|Feed some animals and earn their loyalty. Feed this one, and earn its patience.}}Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Pet Cat== {{Quote|Oh? Were you hoping to work on that desk?}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Unimpressed Cat== {{Quote|RECENTLY THERE HAS BEEN A DEARTH OF FOOD. YOU WILL UNDERSTAND THE GRAVITY OF THE SITUATION. NO DOUBT YOU ARE EAGER TO RECTIFY IT.}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Trivia== *It seems to be modelled after Alexis Kennedy's own cat, Sulochana. [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Dog.title: Dog
Dog.text:
{{BoH Item |image1= Wild Dog.png|Stray loyaldog.png|Loyal Hungry Dog.png|Hungry |principles=When Stray or Loyal:
{{Lore|Edge|2}}, {{Lore|Heart|2}}, {{Lore|Scale|2}}
When Hungry:
{{Lore|Edge|1}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}}, {{Lore|Scale|1}} |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]],
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[A Walk on the Moor]]}} {{Quote|Lost, frightened, eager.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] by taking [[A Walk on the Moor]]. At first, it is a Stray. Feeding it [[Sustenance]] will turn it Loyal. [[Talk]]ing to it will give [[Memory: Solace]] and make it Hungry.
It will only eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]]. The Dog is unique. Only one can ever be found, and if released it can never be found again. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Something noble in its ancestry; and something else.}} Considering it generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Loyal Dog== {{Quote|Walkies are surely a small price to pay for his unshakeable fidelity.}} Considering it generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Hungry Dog== {{Quote|A bottomless and reproachful appetite! But such a good bottomless appetite!}} Considering it generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Trivia== *(No longer true, as of at least 2024.3.e.19 "EHSAN bis")
If acquired by wandering the moors, the Dog will teleport to the Staff-Room the moment it has been unlocked. Considering its 'Loyal' moniker, it seems likely the dog may have been part of the guards of the Cucurbit Prison and somehow survived the fire. Unshakeable fidelity, indeed. [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Gathering]]

{{BoH Item |image1= Orphaned Chick.png|Chick Pet Gull.png|Pet Gull Hungry Gull.png|Hungry Gull |principles=When Chick or Pet Gull:

(Spring, Summer)}} {{Quote|A peeping little thing, its mother is dead or flown.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. It can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] in [[The Gull-Colony]], either as a [[Gull's Egg]] (any Season) or as an Orphaned Chick (in Spring and Summer). The Egg can be hatched by [[Brewable|Brewing]] it in a [[Workstations|Fireplace or Kitchen Range]]. The resulting Orphaned Chick can then be [[Talk|Fed]] and turned into a Pet Gull. It will only eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|Fragile as a feathered petal.}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Pet Gull== {{Quote|As noisy and demanding as it was in its youth. But much bigger.}} [[Talk]]ing to it will generate a [[Wind-Rumour]] and turn it Hungry. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|Why would it fly free, when it can get free food?}} Generates [[Memory: Sound]]. ==Hungry Gull== {{Quote|Squawking urgently.}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. {{BoH Item |image1= File:Imago (Perilous).png|Perilous Imago File:Imago (Hungry).png|Hungry Imago |principles={{Lore|Knock|2}}, {{Lore|Moon|2}},
{{Lore|Moth|6}}, {{Lore|Scale|2}} |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]]
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=[[Crafting]]}} {{Quote|It's come so far. Release it, and it could fly farther.}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Scale}} [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. [[Talk]]ing to it will generate [[Hive's Lament]] and turn it Hungry. Feeding it [[Sustenance]] will allow you to interact with it again.
It will refuse to eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]], but will accept a [[Bottle of Milk]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|If this had developed very differently, we might call it Carapace Cross…
[There are Keeper-level recipes that can develop this from a Chimeric Larva, in the presence of sufficient Moon or Moth.]}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Hungry Imago== {{Quote|Torpid with hunger.}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Keeper-level {{Lore|Moth}} or {{Lore|Moon}}, a [[Chimeric Larva]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Resurgences & Emergences]] |rowspan=2|{{Lore|Moth|15}} |rowspan=3|[[Chimeric Larva]] |rowspan=2|"Coax the larva to develop into a greater Moth-beast." |rowspan=3|"One wet wing, then the other, and then it shakes them dry; and from that point, it will bear watching always." |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Transformations & Liberations]] |- ||[[Insects & Nectars]] ||{{Lore|Moon|15}} |"Beneath the auspices of dusk, coax the larva to develop into a greater Moth-beast." |} ==Trivia== *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Cucurbit Prisoner Records 1927]]'': {{quote|...Collers describes how he's successfully induced an unstable Carapace-larva to develop into a greater form, using Insects and Nectars techniques In the context of considerable Moon-aspect...}} [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Knock]] [[Category:Moon]] [[Category:Moth]] [[Category:Scale]] [[Category:Herbivore]]

Stymphling.title: Stymphling
Stymphling.text:
{{BoH Item |principles={{Lore|Moon|3}}, {{Lore|Scale|3}} |image1= Stymphling.png|Stymphling Hungry Stymphling.png|Hungry Stymphling |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]],
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=*[[Gullscry Tower: Eales' Room|Gullscry Tower:
Eales' Room]] *[[Crafting]]}} {{quote|Eva Dewulf taught her father Valentine how to hatch these silvery little villains, but he never learnt to like them.}} __NOTOC__
The '''Stymphling''' is a [[Crafting|Craftable]] {{Lore|Moon}} and {{Lore|Scale}} [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. It can also be found in [[Gullscry Tower: Eales' Room]]. [[Talk]]ing to it will generate [[Horizon-Sight]] and turn it Hungry. Feeding it [[Sustenance]] will allow you to interact with it again.
It will only eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{Quote|A distant cousin of salamanders, and of moonlight.
[Certain Scholar-level recipes will hatch this from an egg in the presence of sufficient Moon.]}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Hungry Stymphling== {{Quote|Hissing avidly.}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Crafting== {{PAGENAME}} can be Crafted at [[Workstations]] with Scholar-level {{Lore|Moon}}, an [[Egg]] and the following [[Skills]]: {| class="sortable article-table" !Skill !colspan=2|Requirements !Start Quote !End Quote |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Rhyme & Remembrance]] |rowspan=5|{{Lore|Moon|10}} |rowspan=5|[[Egg]] |rowspan=5|"Hatch a mischievous Moon-thing from the egg." |rowspan=5|"[With Keeper-level Moon, stymphlings can produce Wormwood Dreams.]" |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Sand Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Serpents & Venoms]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Snow Stories]] |- |style="white-space:nowrap"|[[Tridesma Hiera]] |} The Stymphling can be used to Craft [[Wormwood Dream]]. == Trivia == *A hint for Crafting this recipe can be found in ''[[Ascite Supplications]]'': {{Quote|"One prayer describes how sufficient Moon-aspect can be used with Tridesma Hiera with almost any egg to hatch 'the Stone's children, the Sky's daughters, the Sea's sons.'"}} [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Crafting]] [[Category:Moon]] [[Category:Scale]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. She can be found in the [[Kitchen Garden]]. [[Talk]]ing to her will generate one [[Hen's Egg]] and turn her hungry and Pleading. Feeding her [[Sustenance]] will allow you to interact with her again. Tuppence will refuse to eat [[Egg]]s and [[Remains]], but will accept a [[Bottle of Milk]]. ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|Tuppence, in her uncertainty.}} Generates [[Memory: Sound]]. ==Pleading Tuppence== {{Quote|Cluck. …cluck?}} Generates [[Memory: Sound]]. Viper.title: Viper
Viper.text:
{{BoH Item |image1= Wild Viper.png|Wild Tame Viper.png|Tame Hungry Viper.png|Hungry |principles=When Wild or Tame:
{{Lore|Knock|2}}, {{Lore|Scale|2}}
When Hungry:
{{Lore|Knock|1}}, {{Lore|Scale|1}} |type=[[Beast]], [[Comfort]],
[[Co-operative]] (when fed) |Location=[[Gathering]]: *[[A Walk on the Moor]] **[[Viper Egg]] (Spring) **'''Wild Viper''' (Summer)}} __NOTOC__
The '''Viper''' is a [[Beast]] and a [[Comfort]]. It can be hatched by [[Brewable|Brewing]] a [[Viper Egg]], or found while [[Gathering]] with [[A Walk on the Moor]] in [[Season|Spring]] (Egg) or [[Season|Summer]] (Wild Viper). At first, it is Wild. Feeding a Wild or Hungry Viper with [[Sustenance]] will turn it Tame. [[Talk]]ing to it will generate an [[Earth-Sign]] and turn it Hungry again. The Viper will only eat [[Egg]]s, [[Remains]] and a [[Bottle of Milk]]. {{Quote|A full belly makes a helpful friend. [This beastie is now inclined to co-operate.]|Feed the Beastie}} ==Wild Viper== {{quote|Don't make any sudden moves.}} ==== [[Consider]] this: ==== {{quote|Ware fingers…}} Generates [[Memory: Sight]]. ==Tame Viper== {{Quote|An avid student of warm fireplace stones, warm mice, and warm milk.}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. ==Hungry Viper== {{Quote|Inclined to strike, although sluggishly, until fed.}} Generates [[Memory: Touch]]. [[Category:Beast]] [[Category:Comfort]] [[Category:Co-operative]] [[Category:Gathering]]

Beast.title: Beast
Beast.text:
[[File:Beast.png|right]] {{Quote|When it moves, and it's not the wind, and it's not a person.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Aspects|Aspect]] found in animals, which can be tamed in [[Hush House]], or are already haunting the premises. When used with [[Talk]], a [[Memory]] or item will be obtained. The Beast will no longer be [[Co-operative]] after this action, so it must be Talked to once more and fed an appropriate [[Sustenance]] to become Co-operative once more. Beasts can be Released at the [[Sea's Edge]], [[Brancrug Boathouse]] or the [[Loading Dock Crane]] in order to gain [[Memory: Hindsight]]. Doing so removes them from the game. All Beasts are also a [[Comfort]], which means they can be placed along the floors of rooms. == Feeding the Beasts == To reliably obtain Memories from Beasts requires a steady supply of items with the Sustenance tag. Many of the carnivorous early-game animals, such as the [[Cat]] or [[Viper]], only take Sustenance items with either the [[Egg]] or [[Remains]] tag. In the early game, this means you can only feed them with [[Viper Egg]]s [[Gathering|Gathered]] from the [[A Walk on the Moor|Moor]], or by collecting [[Mackerel]], which you can find by [[Beachcombing]]. If you have unlocked the [[Pantry]], there are [[Pickled Pilchards]] and some [[Canned Ham]], which will also do the trick. Once the [[Kitchen Garden]] is unlocked, [[Hen's Egg]]s can be obtained by Talking to the chickens [[Tuppence]] and [[Terrence]]. They can be fed using vegetables Gathered from the same garden. Note that this means obtaining a single Memory from a Beast will fatigue two, three, or even four [[Elements of the Soul]]: some Memories are therefore comparatively cheaper to obtain by reading [[Book|Books]] or [[Crafting]]. ==List of Beasties== {| class="article-table sortable" style="width:100%" |+ !Beast !class="unsortable"|State Names !class="unsortable" colspan="2"|Principles !Diet !class="unsortable"|Acquired By !Talking !Considering |- |rowspan="3" |[[Cat]]You can only find one of these per game. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Aspects|Aspect]] found in [[Beast]]s after they have been fed. This allows the Librarian access to a [[Memory]] by [[Talk]]ing with them, which will temporarily remove this Aspect, until they have been fed again. [[Category:Aspect]] [[Category:Beast]]

Blank.title: Blank
Blank.text:
{{Stub}} [[File:Blank.png|thumb]] {{quote|Come friendly words.}}
'''Blank''' is an [[Aspects|Aspect]] of [[Thing]]s. They can be found around [[Hush House]]. The type of [[Workstations|Workstation]] used does not matter as long as it will accept [[Skills]], [[Elements of the Soul]], and materials of the required [[Principles]]. Blanks can be used to help with mastering [[Readable]]s and are required when [[Numa#Summoning Numa|summoning Numa]]. But as the recipe rejects {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Edge}} and {{Lore|Heart}}, [[Hallowed Anthropoderm]] and [[Nivine Parchment]] are ruled out. They can also be used for creating an [[Avenue of Enquiry]]. A [[Quire of Paper]] is required for writing a [[Manuscript]]. ==List of available Blanks== {| class="article-table" |- !Name !colspan=2|Principles !Aspects !Description |- |[[Canvas]] | - | | - |(YOUR PICTURE HERE) |- |[[Hallowed Anthropoderm]] |{{Lore|Heart}} |2 |[[Thing]] |''Yes, it's human skin, but it's not just human skin.'' |- |[[Nivine Parchment]] |{{Lore|Winter}} |1 |[[Thing]] |''Pale as the first wisp of mountain-cloud.'' |- |[[Petition for a Labyrinth Season]] | - | |style=white-space:nowrap|[[Ready to Post]]
[[Readable]] |''If this ever reaches its destination, it might bring Numa.'' |- |[[Quire of Paper]] |{{Lore|Nectar}} |1 |[[Thing]]
[[Fuel]] |''Creamy-smooth, eagerly awaiting ink.'' |- |[[Writing-Case]] | - | |[[Thing]] |''A sturdy brass-cornered writing-case which has been of service to at least three Librarians of the House. [Use your Writing-Case in a Desk with Ink to invite Visitors to a Salon. To invite villagers, add your Writing-Case as a discussion subject when you visit them in Brancrug.]'' |} [[Category:Aspect]] [[Category:Blank]]

Instrument.title: Instrument
Instrument.text:
[[File:Instrument.png|thumb|right|64px]]
'''Instrument''' is an Aspect of a number of [[Workstations#Instruments|Workstations]], and one [[tool]], the [[Mazarine Fife]]. Instruments and music are strongly associated with {{Lore|Sky}}. Several of the instrument workstations are located in the [[Mazarine Room]], where [[Kitty Mazarine]] would occasionally invite visitors to recitals.

[[File:Metal.png|right]] {{Quote|This is what happens when stone gets serious.}}

Crowcross Sands.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Crowcross_Sands.png]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Moon|2}} or {{Lore|Winter|2}} |workstations=*[[Sea's Edge]] *[[Gathering]]: **[[Beachcombing]] }} {{Quote|Look out across the bay. Long long ago, this was a forest.}}
'''Crowcross Sands''' is a [[Locations|Location]] to the south of [[Brancrug Village]] in [[St. Brandan's Cove]]. Items can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] through [[Beachcombing]], and the [[Sea's Edge]] activity allows abandoning [[Thing|Things]] and releasing [[Beast|Beasts]]. ==Tidal Flats (Locked)== {{Quote|Brancrug is a tidal island; at low tide you could walk there. Though you probably shouldn't.}}
Before unlocking, it is called "Tidal Flats" and requires {{Lore|Moon|2}} or {{Lore|Winter|2}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Gathering== *[[Beachcombing]] ({{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Rose}}) [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Out of Bounds]]

Gathering.title: Gathering
Gathering.text:
[[File:Workstation.png|right]]'''Gathering''' stations are special [[Workstations]] within [[Hush House]] that allow the Librarian to obtain items from random, seasonally changing decks. Many of these stations can produce unusual items during the season of [[Numa]], even if descriptions in other seasons do not hint at it. Gathering stations have two card slots. The first for an [[Elements of the Soul|Element of the Soul]], the second for a [[Skills|Skill]]. The stations with {{Lore|Nectar}} as their only [[Principles|Principle]] accept {{Lore|Heart}} Elements and {{Lore|Nectar}} Skills. Gathering stations with multiple Principles accept Elements and Skills matching any of their principles in both slots. The aspects of the Element and Skill and their combined magnitude have no impact on the result. ==Locations== There are gathering stations across many locations. Some locations have multiple identical stations. For specific details, see the page for the station's [[Locations|Location]]. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible" |+List of Gathering Locations !Name !Principles !Location !Description |- |'''[[Beachcombing]]''' |{{Lore|Heart}}

Brancrug Village.title: Brancrug Village
Brancrug Village.text:
{{BoH Room |image1=[[brancrug village.png]] |required_aspects= *{{Lore|Sky}} [[Assistance]] *Forbidden - [[Sceptical]]}} {{Location |location=[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cornwall Cornwall, England] |inhabitants=[[Villagers]]}} {{Quote|This quiet Cornish fishing village has lain long in the Isle's shadow. It might be as old as Hush House itself. And like Hush House, Brancrug Village has provided sanctuary over the years for its share of misfits and exiles.}} __NOTOC__
'''Brancrug Village''' is a fictional fishing village, located in Cornwall in South West England, and the location of [[Hush House]]. It is the first location unlocked in [[The Beginning]] of ''[[Book of Hours]]'', with the help of [[The Fisherman]] after choosing [[Elements of the Soul]]. ==Brancrug Village (Locked)== {{Quote|Brancrug Village: sanctuary in the storm. I'll need help to climb the cliffs in the dark, and the locals are suspicious of outsiders... more than ever so since the Restoration, and the New King.}} Before unlocking, it has the same name and requires {{Lore|Sky}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Establishments== ===The Sweet Bones=== '''[[The Sweet Bones]]''' is Brancrug's pub. The Librarian can visit The Sweet Bones to restore [[Elements of the Soul]], earn [[Pence]] doing odd jobs, or hire [[Assistants]]. ===The Post Office=== Brancrug's '''[[Post Office]]''' is just to the east of The Sweet Bones. It can be used to send correspondence, sell [[Tally|Spintria]] and break down [[Pence]]. ===Blacksmith=== '''[[The Smithy]]''' can be found south of the Post Office. This is where [[The Blacksmith]], Denzil, lives and works. The Librarian can hire Denzil's assistance for a shilling. Denzil can also break down Spintria into smaller denominations. ===Rectory=== '''[[The Rectory]]''' is one of the northernmost buildings in the village. This is where [[The Rector|Reverend Timothy]] lives with his housekeeper, Terrence. Reverend Timothy can be hired for a shilling. ===Mrs and Mr Kille's=== '''[[Mrs and Mr Kille]]'s''' is the last town building before the [[Cucurbit Bridge]] leading to Hush House. It is the home of [[The Midwife]], Mrs Kille, and [[The Coffinmaker]], Mr Kille, whom can both be hired for a shilling. ==Surrounding Area== ===Crowcross Sands=== The beach near Brancrug is known as '''[[Crowcross Sands]]'''. The Librarian can [[Gathering|Gather]] materials here, or discard items and go for a swim at the [[Sea's Edge]]. ===The Moor=== '''[[A Walk on the Moor|The Moor]]''' is south-east of the village. The Librarian can go for a walk here and gather various materials. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Out of Bounds]]

Chapter House.title: Chapter House
Chapter House.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=File:Chapter_House.png |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Lantern|9}}, {{Lore|Moon|9}}
or {{Lore|Winter|9}} |workstations=*[[Desk: Nonna]]}} {{Quote|Here the monastic superiors would meet to manage the affairs of St Brandan's and to resolve its disputes. Here in 1349, the last trial of the last nuns of St Brandan's took place. Two were executed for the murder of Abbess Nonna, supposedly with 'perversions of the healing arts'. Nonna was the last abbess of St Brandan's, and after the trial, the monastery never accepted female novices again. From the wide windows, the sea is always visible, beating on the rocks far below.}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. It has a long table and one large bookshelf. ==Echoing Chamber (Locked)== {{Quote|This has long been a holy place, but the voices of the monks have outlasted their prayers. A surly muttering circles the room, picking up speed as it goes. Each time it passes me, it almost manages to articulate my name.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Echoing Chamber" and requires {{Lore|Lantern|9}}, {{Lore|Moon|9}}, or {{Lore|Winter|9}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== *[[Desk: Nonna]] ({{Lore|Lantern|}}, {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) ==Salon== {{Main|Salon}} ''Peaceful, with excellent acoustics; although a little draughty. [Here one might have Elevenses in the morning, and Afternoon Tea later in the day. Neither event should include any Intoxicating drinks.]'' Chapter House can be used to host Elevenses or Afternoon Tea for up to five guests. == Contents == * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Solar]]) (x3) * [[Perhibiate]] * [[C&H Second Flush Assam]] (Pot, Cup x4) * [[Tall Candlestick]] (x2) * [[Quire of Paper]] * [[White Matilda]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]] [[Category:Salon]]

Atrium.title: Atrium
Atrium.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Atrium.png]] |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Knock|5}} or {{Lore|Lantern|5}} |workstations=*[[Shrine: St Januarius]]}} {{Quote|In 1651, Musgrave Dewulf endowed the atrium with a shrine to St Januarius of the Gate. Musgrave was a pious man but also a Puritan, so this grand shrine was a little unusual. St Januarius is also an unusual choice - but he is the patron saint of boundaries, and the Dewulfs were often said in some sense to be 'Marcher Lords' charged with the keeping of boundaries.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Shadowed Atrium (Locked)== {{Quote|This has long been a holy place, but in the absence of prayers, other influences have crept in. I'll need help to purify it, step by step.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Shadowed Atrium" and requires {{Lore|Knock|5}} or {{Lore|Lantern|5}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: * [[Glorious Stair]] * [[Nave of the Abbey Church]] * [[Grand Ascent - Third Floor]] ==Workstations== *[[Shrine: St Januarius]] ({{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Knock}}) - Can [[Evolve via Nyctodromy]]. == Contents == *[[Aglaophotis-Scented Candle]] (x2) *[[Watchful Candle]] (x2) *[[Atrium Chair]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]]

Glorious Stair.title: Glorious Stair
Glorious Stair.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Glorious Stair.png]] |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|6}}, {{Lore|Forge|6}}
or {{Lore|Winter|6}} |workstations=*[[Shrine: the Madrugad]]}} {{Quote|Each stair tread is decorated with a quotation from the Book of Suns, so that the congregation might be edified as they ascend. The quotes are worn to half-legibility by the passage of all those worshipful feet, which may be why some of these quotations differ troublingly from any orthodox version.

It has of course been claimed that the Sisterhood of the Knot, who first held the Isle, also held a copy of the long-suppressed Shuritic version of the Book...}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Gloomy Stair (Locked)== {{Quote|This has long been a holy place, but the Madrugad has withdrawn her favour now, and a chillness waits here where dawn will not touch it. Only once it is pacified can I safely pass.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Gloomy Stair" and requires {{Lore|Edge|6}}, {{Lore|Forge|6}} or {{Lore|Winter|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Windlit Gallery]]. ==Workstations== * [[Shrine: the Madrugad]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Forge}}) - Can [[Evolve via Ithastry]]. == Contents == *[[Snowflake Candle]] (x3) [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]]

Chancel of the Abbey Church.title: Chancel of the Abbey Church
Chancel of the Abbey Church.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Chancel of the
Abbey Church |image1=[[File:Chancel of the Abbey Church.png]] |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|9}}, {{Lore|Lantern|9}}, {{Lore|Moon|9}} or {{Lore|Winter|9}} |workstations=*[[Shrine: the Chancel]]}} {{Quote|The Church of the Unconquered Sun acknowledges only a handful of Hours: the Sun in Rags or Splendour; the Meniscate; the Madrugad; the Watchman; and, reluctantly, the Wolf-Divided. Any other so-called 'Hours' must be lesser powers, wicked impostors, or superstitions.

So the Church denies two of the three Hours of the Chancel. And yet it's the Chancel who are said to determine which of their peers qualify as Hours. That's theology for you.

Abbot Geffrey decreed that all three should be venerated in this holiest of rooms. To avoid actual heresy, he would not permit any of the three to be named. That's theology, too.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Veiled Chamber (Locked)== {{Quote|This has long been a very holy place - too holy to be left untended safely for this long. There are seventy-seven candles, and each one burns with a chill blue flame, each flame inhabited by a watchful spirit. I should not enter until each flame has been cleansed or extinguished.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Veiled Chamber" and requires {{Lore|Heart|9}}, {{Lore|Lantern|9}}, {{Lore|Moon|9}} or {{Lore|Winter|9}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Radiant Stair]]. ==Workstations== * [[Shrine: the Chancel]] ({{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Edge}}; also {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}- see the Workstation's page) - Can [[Evolve via Horomachistry]]. == Contents == * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Solar]]) (x3) * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Dawn]]) * [[Ichor Auroral]] * [[Ichor Vitreous]] * [[Historywax Candle]] (x2) [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]]

Church Tower.title: Church Tower
Church Tower.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Church Tower.png]] |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|9}}, {{Lore|Lantern|9}}
or {{Lore|Sky|9}}}} {{Quote|The bells in this tower rang every Sunday, even in Solomon Husher's time, until Thirza Blake finally cancelled services so she could save money by sacking the priest. This brought a deputation of angry locals from Brancrug Village, where there was a fearful superstition that when the bells of Brancrug fell silent, the bells of Ys would be heard.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Ill-Omened Tower (Locked)== {{Quote|The stairway has been chained off - more than chained off. The whole thing is wrapped or swathed in chains. Authoritative sigils forbid entry.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Ill-Omened Tower" and requires {{Lore|Forge|9}}, {{Lore|Lantern|9}} or {{Lore|Sky|9}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: * [[Solarium]] * [[Tower Clock]] == Contents == ===Books=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Solar]]) (x3) ===Tools=== * [[Mop and Bucket]] ===Beverages=== * [[Veiled Goddess Lapsang Souchong]] (Pot, Cup) ===Comforts=== * [[Bell-Tower Chair]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]]

Bells.title: Bells
Bells.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Bells.png]] |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|11}}, {{Lore|Heart|11}}
or {{Lore|Sky|11}} |workstations=*[[Instrument: Bells]]}} {{Quote|Giver, Teller, Shur's Tongue, Lady Janice and Great Paycock are the names of these bells, though they're older than the Abbey itself and those names have certainly been corrupted over the years. By 1915, Shur's Tongue and Lady Janice were too cracked to ring, and the Suppression Bureau paid for them to be recast - Serena Blackwood's quid pro quo for the assistance she gave George Collers with his clock project.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Fallen Bells (Locked)== {{Quote|Someone has smashed the headstocks of the bells so that they fell to the floor here. The stone is cracked beneath them - the noise must have been unbearable. One has fallen against the stairs to the tower top.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Fallen Bells" and requires {{Lore|Forge|11}}, {{Lore|Heart|11}} or {{Lore|Sky|11}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Spire]]. ==Workstations== *[[Instrument: Bells]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Forge}}) - Can [[Evolve via Ithastry]]. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]]

Examination Room.title: Examination Room
Examination Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=EXAMINATION ROOM.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|5}} or {{Lore|Heart|5}} |workstations=*[[Necropsy Table]]}} {{Quote|Hendrik Dewulf evicted the family of the healer Natan from the Barber's Tower - as it was then called. ('I have rooted out the barber's brood,' he is recorded to have gloated.) But his great-great-grandson Gideon - 'the Motley Baron', for his brindled hair - restored the Tower and made it a place of healing again.

Of course the equipment in this room dates from the current century. But Gideon's other nickname was 'the Cutter'. It was rumoured that he bought corpses for dissection - even that he was a vivisectionist. The latter was probably a slander, but one way or another, scholars have been cutting up corpses in here for a very long time.}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Gloomy Room (Locked)== {{quote|The window of this room is coated thickly with black paint. A little light seeps through.
Otherwise, the room is dark. Very faintly, I can still smell rotting meat.}}
Before unlocking, it is called "Gloomy Room" and requires {{Lore|Edge|5}} or {{Lore|Heart|5}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Infirmary]] *[[Grand Ascent - Third Floor]] ==Workstations== *[[Necropsy Table]] ({{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Winter}}) == Contents == ===Books=== [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Nocturnal]]) (x2) ===Remains=== *[[Essential Periost]] *[[Phosphorescent Scrapings]] *[[Heart in a Jar]] ===Stone=== *[[Serpentinite Slab]] ===Comfort=== *[[Morgue Boots]] *[[Bucket of Seawater]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Entrance Hall.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=The entrance hall.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Knock|3}} or {{Lore|Rose|3}} |workstations=[[Entrance Hall Fireplace]]}} {{Quote|The beginning of the House proper. The Curia used to issue gloves and slippers of soft leather to protect the books and premises. Visitors were often asked to remove their shoes. Pause a moment and listen to the Histories.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==The First True Threshold (Locked)== {{Quote|I have reached the threshold of the Hush House proper. The Librarians of the Curia were scholars of note - some were potent adepts. From here I should proceed carefully, observing the proper forms, making the appropriate offerings. The villagers and other locals know the ways of the earth and sea hereabouts. Their assistance will be invaluable.}}
Before unlocking, it is called "The First True Threshold" and requires {{Lore|Knock|3}} or {{Lore|Rose|3}} [[Assistance]] to access.
