Patients' Lounge.title: Patients' Lounge
Patients' Lounge.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Patients' Lounge.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Grail|5}} or {{Lore|Heart|5}} |workstations=*[[Projector]]}} {{Quote|In this room, the accursed of the Great War gathered to recuperate - those who had suffered something no more horrible, but somewhat more mysterious, than the War's usual wounds to body and spirit - an irruption of Worms, perhaps, or the risks at the military end of Suppression Bureau activities. Among them were minor luminaries of the invisible world - Christopher Illopoly, Zachary Wakefield, Harvey Hattington. But not Brian Levinsen, who had been ninth Librarian, and under whose tenure the Infirmary had flourished. He enlisted; he served for a time as a medical officer on the Western Front; his body was never found.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Neglected Room (Locked)== {{Quote|The room above might once have been some sort of lounge, but the furniture and equipment has been smashed and overturned; the walls are streaked with mildew. An unlovely smell wafts from further up.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Neglected Room" and requires {{Lore|Grail|5}} or {{Lore|Heart|5}} [[Assistants|Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose [[Motley Tower: Illopoly's Nook]]. ==Workstations== *[[Projector]] ({{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Sky}}) - The only workstation that can take [[Reels of Film]]. ==Contents== ===Books=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Nocturnal Period|Nocturnal]]) ===Beverages=== * [[C&H Second Flush Assam]] (Pot, Cup x2) ===Thing=== * [[Lacquered Bone Chess Set]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Infirmary.title: Infirmary
Infirmary.text:
{{BoH Room |image1=Infirmary.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistants|Assistance]]
*{{Lore|Heart|4}} or {{Lore|Rose|4}} |workstations=*[[Guest Bed: Infirmary]] (x3) *[[Infirmary Fireplace]]}} {{Quote|In the fifteenth century, Natan of Regensburg came to Brancrug. The brothers of St Brandan's granted sanctuary, but they would not permit a Jew - and his family! - to live on abbey grounds. Still they built this tower for him to dwell in and practice his healing arts. It has changed greatly since that time, but a place of healing it remains.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Infirmary (Locked)== {{quote|Careless visitors have tracked in mud through the door, and the windows have been open to the elements for years.}} Before unlocking, the Infirmary has the same name and requires {{Lore|Heart|4}} or {{Lore|Rose|4}} [[Assistants|Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Patients' Lounge]] *[[Examination Room]] *[[Grand Ascent - Second Floor]] ==Workstations== *[[Guest Bed: Infirmary]] ({{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Edge}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) (x3) - Can be camped in, or used by [[Visitors]] with an interest in {{Lore|Heart}}. *[[Infirmary Fireplace]] ==Contents== ===Things=== *[[Pale Mommet]] *[[Vase of Lilies]] *[[Basket of Towels]] ===Beverages=== *[[Serpent-Milk]] *[[Rubywise Ruin]] *[[Mist-Kissed Water]] (Pitcher) *[[T.R.N. Limited Drinking Cocoa]] (Pot, Cup x2) ===Bust=== *''[['Musgrave Dewulf']]'' ===Comforts=== *[[Watchful Potted Plant]] *[[Wicker Chair]] *[[Pale Stool]] ===Wall Art=== *''[['The Velvet' (Wall Art)|'The Velvet']]'' *''[['The Thunderskin']]'' *''[['The Witch-and-Sister']]'' *''[['The Sister-and-Witch']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Physic Garden.title: Physic Garden
Physic Garden.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[physic garden.png]] |era=[[Dawn Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|3}} or {{Lore|Nectar|3}} |workstations=*[[Garden]] (x2): **[[Catsclaw]] **[[Trumpeter's Lily]] **[[Aglaophotis]] *[[Salon]]: **[[Salon|A Picnic in the Physic Garden]]}} {{Quote|The nuns of the Knot planted this garden of healing herbs in the Dawn Period. Natan of Regensburg and Gideon Dewulf both expanded it, and the Curia of the Isle tended it. Even the Branch and the Bureau made use of it in the grim days that Brancrug served as a prison..}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. It contains two [[Gathering|Gardens]], which you can gather from. ==Weed-Choked Garden (Locked)== {{Quote|From what I can make out of the garden beyond, it must have been very peaceful - but now it's neglected and overgrown.}} Before unlocking, it is called "Weed-Choked Garden" and requires {{Lore|Heart|3}} or {{Lore|Nectar|3}} [[Assistance]] to access.
Opening it will expose: *[[Infirmary]] *[[Grand Ascent - First Floor]] ==Gardens== There are two gardens to [[Gathering|gather]] from in the {{PAGENAME}}, with varying [[Flower]]s, depending on the [[Season]].
In [[Numa]], you can gather [[Aglaophotis]]. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Garden !! Spring !! Summer !! Autumn !! Winter !! Numa |- | ''Catsclaw in spring, trumpeter's lily in summer.
Rarer plants might flourish in Numa.'' || [[Catsclaw]] || [[Trumpeter's Lily]] || [[Trumpeter's Lily]] || | - || [[Aglaophotis]] |} == Salon == {{Main|Salon}} ''The peace of flowers, the murmur of leaves. [Here one might have a Picnic, but only in Spring or Summer.]'' The Physic Garden can be used to host a Picnic in Spring or Summer for up to five guests. == Contents == ===Thing=== *[[Roscraggan Whisky]] (Bottle, Glass x2) ===Comfort=== *[[Restful Garden Chair]] *[[Comfortable Garden Chair]] (x2) [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Gardens]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Dawn]] [[Category:Open Air]] [[Category:Salon]]

Nave of the Abbey Church.title: Nave of the Abbey Church
Nave of the Abbey Church.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Nave of the Abbey Church.png]] |era=[[Solar Gothic Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Lantern|6}} |workstations=* [[Instrument: Organ]] * [[Solar Altar]]}} {{Quote|For a thousand years the Unconquered Sun has been worshipped here in all his Aspects - though since the heresies of the Intercalate, many of those aspects are considered distinct Hours in their own right, and the Sun's death and birth are both now celebrated.

The Abbey Church used to be more golden, but many of the valuables were lost at the Abbey's dissolution, including the original stained glass. These magnificent windows are of recent manufacture, financed by the eighth Librarian, Greene, who was a believer of the Second Dawn variety.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Darkened Church (Locked)== {{Quote|This has long been a holy place, but shadows are the only worshippers here now. The windows have been painted black, the pews overturned, the organ hung with black ribbons.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Darkened Church" and requires {{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Lantern|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Chancel of the Abbey Church]]. ==Workstations== * [[Instrument: Organ]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Forge}}) * [[Solar Altar]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}) - Can [[Evolve via Hushery]]. == Contents == ===Books=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Solar]]) x3 ===Things=== * [[Small Candlestick]] (x6) * [[Vase of Amaryllis]] * [[Vase of Lilies]] ===Comforts=== * [[Uncomfortable Seat]] (x3) ===Wall Art=== * [[Sol Invictis Symbol]] ===Fixed in Place=== * [[Stained Glass Window: the Watchman]] * [[Stained Glass Window: the Meniscate]] * [[Stained Glass Window: the Sun-in-Rags]] * [[Stained Glass Window: the Madrugad]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Solar Gothic Period]]

Motley Tower: Illopoly's Nook.title: Motley Tower: Illopoly's Nook
Motley Tower: Illopoly's Nook.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=[[Motley Tower: Illopoly's Nook|Motley Tower:
Illopoly's Nook]] |image1=[[Motley tower Illopoly's nook.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] * {{Lore|Heart|5}} or {{Lore|Moth|5}} |workstations=[[Barber's Chair]]}} {{Quote|Christopher Illopoly - poet, painter, archivist, ruiner of seances - stayed on for a while at Hush House after the Great War. The Librarian, Serena Blackwood, arranged rooms for Illopoly in the Motley Tower, ostensibly so he could help with the collection, but perhaps also because she saw a potential ally against the Governor of the Cucurbit... relations between the Cucurbit and the House were badly strained at the time.}}__NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Motley Tower: First Floor (Locked)== {{Quote|The door jams half-open, but the room above is a bright oasis after the dreary neglect of the lower tower. The previous occupant has probably left some sort of protections in place. I'll find somebody suitably qualified to deal with them.}} Before unlocking, it is called "Motley Tower: First Floor" and requires {{Lore|Heart|5}} or {{Lore|Moth|5}} [[Assistance]] to access.
Opening it will expose the [[Motley Tower: Dispensary]]. ==Workstations== *[[Barber's Chair]] ({{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Moth}}) - Can [[Evolve via Preservation]]. ==Contents== ===Books=== *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia]]) (x3) *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Nocturnal]]) (x3) ===Ink=== *[[Perhibiate]] ===Things=== *[[Holiest Hemolymph]] *[[Urn of Ashes]] *[[Vase of Rushes]] *[[Red Lotus Vase]] *[[Twilight Pot]] ===Comforts=== *[[Elegant Sunburst Lamp]] *[[Russet Couch]] ===Bust=== *''[['Fraser Strathcoyne']]'' ===Wall Art=== *''[['Love in a Quiet Place']]'' *''[['Red, Blue']]'' *''[['To Be Fruitful']]'' *''[['Again, at Night']]'' *''[['Sedona, Not Yet']]'' *''[['To Hear Those Voices']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Motley Tower: Dispensary.title: Motley Tower: Dispensary
Motley Tower: Dispensary.text:
{{BoH_Room |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Moth|6}} |workstations=[[Dispensary]] |image1=Motley tower dispensary.png}} {{Quote|This room may originally have served as a working dispensary, but some at least of its more eccentric fittings were added by Christopher Illopoly in his time here. By that point he had severed ties with his adoptive father. He'd been using the Illopoly name for years and had no access to the Strathcoyne fortune - but 'Traveling at Night' had sold surprisingly well (much better than his poetry) and he had a little money of his own by then - enough to indulge his preferences.}}
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]], which is unlocked decently into the midgame.__NOTOC__ == Motley Tower: Second Floor (Locked) == {{Quote|A nasty theoplasmic miasma hangs around the room above. It's no longer strong, but it'll take years to dissipate to the point of safety. With the right help, I can raise counter-influences.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Motley Tower: Second Floor" and requires {{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Moth|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Motley Tower: Regensburg Room]]. == Workstations == *[[Dispensary]] ({{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) ==Contents== ===Books=== *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Baronial Period|Baronial]]) *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia Period|Curia]]) (x2) *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Nocturnal Period|Nocturnal]]) (x3) ====Tools==== *[[Snootle Jar]] *[[Spice Scales]] *[[Mortar & Pestle]] *[[Shears of the Sisterhood]] *[[Serpent-Styled Glass (Gervinus)]] ===Ink=== *[[Catwink]] ====Beverage==== *[[Leathy]] (x2) *[[Sly Alembic]] *[[Thirza's Cordials]] *[[Domaine Raveline]] (Glass) *[[Lambig Broceliande]] (Chalice) ====Egg==== *[[Viper Egg]] ===Light=== *[[Tall Candlestick]] ====Pigment==== *[[Iotic Essence]] *[[Ichor Auroral]] *[[Ichor Vitreous]] *[[Bitterblack Salts]] ===Liquid=== *[[Glassfinger Toxin]] *[[Wolf-Snow Ampoule]] *[[January Sanguinary]] ====Material==== *[[Desiccated Witchworms]] *[[Tanglebrag]] *[[Westcott's Compounds]] *[[Skaptodon Fang]] *[[Leathy Lees]] ===Things=== *[[Cranial Tchotchke]] *[[Glinting Cranial Tchotchke]] ===Wall Art=== *[[Brazen Clock]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Motley Tower: Regensburg Room.title: Motley Tower: Regensburg Room
Motley Tower: Regensburg Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Motley Tower:
Regensburg Room |image1=Motley tower regensburg room.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] * {{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} |workstations=* [[Guest Bed: Motley]] * [[Desk: Natan]]}} {{Quote|The physician Natan lived here in the fifteenth century - and his family after that, tolerated by the monks - until King Henry dissolved the foundation and granted the Isle to Hendrik. Hendrik turfed them out of the tower and furnished the place more to his own taste. But when Christopher Illopoly moved in four hundred years later, he restored what he could. Illopoly wrote at the time of his sympathy, as a rootless foundling, for the outcast Natan: 'I don't know what I am, but I don't think I'm English.'}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Motley Tower: Third Floor (Locked)== {{Quote|The theoplasmic miasma that hung around the room below is a little stronger here, and a little different, with a rotten, musky scent that suggests a decaying reptile house. Perhaps something laired here after the inhabitants departed; perhaps the inhabitants dreamed unwisely. In any case, the right counter-influences will dispel it.}}
Before unlocking, it is called "Motley Tower: Third Floor" and requires {{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== *[[Guest Bed: Motley]] ({{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can be camped in, or used by [[Visitors]] with an interest in {{Lore|Moth}}. *[[Desk: Natan]] ({{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Moth}}) ==Contents== ===Books=== *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Baronial]]) (x3) ===Cache=== *[[Bag of Tricks]] ===Light=== *[[Weighty Bedside Candleholder]] *[[Regensburg Menorah]] ===Blank=== *[[Quire of Paper]] ===Thing=== *[[Reference Image]] ===Comfort=== *[[Wine-Dark Chair]] ===Wall Art=== *[[Storm-Tossed Mirror]] *''[['Our Benefactor']]'' *''[['Our Benefactress']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Long Tower: Solomon's Study.title: Long Tower: Solomon's Study
Long Tower: Solomon's Study.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Long Tower:
Solomon's Study |image1=Long tower solomons study.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] * {{Lore|Lantern|3}} or {{Lore|Winter|3}} |workstations=* [[Long Tower Study Fireplace]] * [[Desk: Pale]]}} {{Quote|In 1818, the Very Reverend Solomon Husher became third Librarian of the Curia of the Isle. He took rooms in the Long Tower as his quarters. Husher's tastes were spartan; although the Curia generally liked a little more luxury, no-one ever quite dared to redecorate the place after his disappearance.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Long Tower: First Floor (Locked)== {{Quote|The Long Tower looks like it's been abandoned much longer than seven years. In the Nocturnal Period, the inhabitants probably spent most of their time on the seaward side of the Isle. I'll need help to restore the room above.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Long Tower: First Floor" and requires {{Lore|Lantern|3}} or {{Lore|Winter|3}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose [[Long Tower: Solomon's Quarters]]. ==Workstations== *[[Desk: Pale]] ({{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Winter}}) *[[Long Tower Study Fireplace]] ==Contents== ===Books=== *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia]]) (x2) ===Ink=== *[[Perinculate]] ===Light=== *[[Chalice Candle]] *[[Widow's Candle]] (x2) ===Material/Glass=== *[[Whispering Sand]] ===Blank=== *[[Nivine Parchment]] ===Bust=== *''[['Solomon Husher']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Long Tower: Solomon's Quarters.title: Long Tower: Solomon's Quarters
Long Tower: Solomon's Quarters.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Long Tower:
Solomon's Quarters |image1=Long tower solomons quarters.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Lantern|4}} or {{Lore|Winter|4}} |workstations=*[[Guest Bed: Solomon]]}} {{Quote|Generally reckoned the chilliest room in the House. The Long Tower was usually called the Winter Tower until Julian Coseley - magus, epistler, reputed Long - dwelt here briefly in the seventeenth century. Solomon Husher was the second known to sleep in the room. Evidently they didn't mind the cold.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Long Tower: Second Floor (Locked)== {{Quote|Freezing air - even tendrils of fog - drift from the tower top. I should probably seek help from someone who knows the local traditions for dealing with restless spirits.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Long Tower: Second Floor" and requires {{Lore|Lantern|4}} or {{Lore|Winter|4}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== *[[Guest Bed: Solomon]] - ({{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can be camped in, or used by [[Visitors]] with an interest in {{Lore|Winter}}. == Contents == ===Books=== *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Baronial]]) (x2) *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia]]) (x2) ===Beverage=== *[[Isle-Water]] (Glass) ===Light=== *[[Widow's Candle]] (x2) ===Wall Art=== *''[['The Foundation of the Sun']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Grand Ascent - Second Floor.title: Grand Ascent - Second Floor
Grand Ascent - Second Floor.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Grand Ascent -
Second Floor |image1=Grand ascent second floor.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Grail|4}}, {{Lore|Knock|5}},
{{Lore|Nectar|5}} or {{Lore|Winter|5}}}} {{Quote|By long tradition, each Baron Brancrug had their image set in a niche in the Grand Ascent. Later, the Curia of the Isle continued the tradition for their Librarians.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Grand Ascent - Second Floor (Locked)== {{Quote|It is unexpectedly difficult to raise my foot to the last step before the landing. Leaf-shadows drift across my sight, and the windows hiss and rattle. I have heard that Gervinus van Lauren, last Librarian before me, was skilled at the forbidding of ways.}} Before unlocking, it has the same name and requires {{Lore|Grail|4}}, {{Lore|Knock|5}}, {{Lore|Nectar|5}} or {{Lore|Winter|5}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: * [[Grand Ascent - Third Floor]] * [[Severn Chamber]] * [[Infirmary]] * [[Grand Ascent - First Floor]] ==Contents== ===Flower=== *[[Vase of Lilies]] ==Niches==
There are five niches here, where the [[Busts]] of their respective owners can be placed in:
====Fourth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who died not but passed within'}} ====Fifth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who was denied victory, though never defeated'}} ====Sixth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who brought a key long lost'}} ====Seventh Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who dwells still in the three-flowered tree'}} ====Eighth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who served two masters as best he could'}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Grand Ascent - Third Floor.title: Grand Ascent - Third Floor
Grand Ascent - Third Floor.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Grand Ascent -
Third Floor |image1=[[File:Grand ascent third floor.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|5}}, {{Lore|Forge|4}},
{{Lore|Knock|5}} or {{Lore|Winter|5}}}} {{Quote|By long tradition, each Baron Brancrug had their image set in a niche in the Grand Ascent. Later, the Curia of the Isle continued the tradition for their Librarians.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Grand Ascent - Third Floor (Locked)== {{Quote|Frost crackles on the window-panes as I ascend, and the light strikes at my eyes like knives. Another of van Lauren's forbiddings.}} Before unlocking, it has the same name and requires {{Lore|Edge|5}}, {{Lore|Forge|4}}, {{Lore|Knock|5}} or {{Lore|Winter|5}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: * [[Atrium]] * [[Fludd Gallery]] * [[Examination Room]] * [[Grand Ascent - Second Floor]] == Contents == ===Leaf=== *[[Potted Bamboo]] ==Niches==
There are five niches here, where the [[Busts]] of their respective owners can be placed in:
====Ninth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who saw his fate, and did not shirk it'}} ====Tenth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who departed, but did not forget'}} ====Eleventh Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|A niche with a plaque: 'Who returned to complete what he began.'}} ====Twelfth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle==== {{Quote|This, of course, would be me. I could use whatever I want as my image.}} ====Thirteenth Librarian of the Curia of the Isle?==== {{Quote|If I have a successor, their image might stand here.}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Pale Chamber.title: Pale Chamber
Pale Chamber.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Pale Chamber.png]] |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Moth|7}} or {{Lore|Winter|7}} |workstations=*[[Guest Bed: Pale]] *[[Pale Chamber Fireplace]]}} {{Quote|In the time of the Dewulfs, this magnificent bedroom was reserved for the Baron... or in Lady Eva's time, the Baroness. Eva had the whole room decorated in black as a gesture of permanent mourning for her father Valentine (or, according to ribald rumours, to set off her own paleness for her lovers). It was Kitty Mazarine, much later, who freshened the furnishings and made it the Pale Chamber.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Icy Bedroom (Locked)== {{Quote|A thick and freezing murk, like a clinging black mist, roils at floor level. Not theoplasma exactly - the ragged remnants of some chilly Wood-thing? Or a good old-fashioned ghost, decayed to half-elemental energies? Some local will probably know.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Icy Bedroom" and requires {{Lore|Moth|7}} or {{Lore|Winter|7}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Librarian's Quarters]]. ==Workstations== *[[Guest Bed: Pale]] ({{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can be camped in, or used by [[Visitors]] with an interest in {{Lore|Sky}}. *[[Pale Chamber Fireplace]] == Contents == ===Things=== * [[Armagnac d'Ys]] (Bottle) * [[Vase of Golden Bulrushes]] (x2) * [[Daybreak Clock]] ===Bust=== * ''[['Thirza Blake']]'' ===Comfort=== * [[Sea-Green Sofa]] ===Wall Art=== * ''[['Self-Born']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Hall of Voices.title: Hall of Voices
Hall of Voices.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Hall of Voices.png |era=[[Dawn Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Moth|15}} or {{Lore|Rose|15}} |workstations=*[[Hearth: Hall of Voices]]
|[[Salon|A Salon in the Hall of Voices]]}} {{Quote|Here the higher initiates of the Threefold Mysteries would meet to manage the affairs of the Black Dove and to resolve its disputes. Here they voted to blind and expel the Chorates of the Thunderskin, who had trespassed in the inner chambers and spied on the Mysteries. From that time on, the rites of the Thunderskin were not permitted on the Isle, and the sacred drums fell silent. But the waves still beat in the bones of the rock. Even now that slow pulse comes.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Silent Hall (Locked)== {{Quote|The hearth is cold, the floor thick with dust, the walls streaked with nitre. Old invocations and forbiddings squeak and whisper like rats.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Silent Hall" and requires {{Lore|Moth|15}} or {{Lore|Rose|15}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose [[Chapel Calicite]]. ==Workstations== * [[Hearth: Hall of Voices]] ({{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Edge}}, {{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Grail}}) ==Salon== {{Main|Salon}} ''An eccentric, or at least atmospheric, choice of venue for a Salon. [Here one might have Elevenses in the morning, or Afternoon Tea later in the day. Neither event should include any Intoxicating drinks.]'' The Hall of Voices can be used to host Elevenses or Afternoon Tea for up to five guests. == Contents == ===Books=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Dawn]]) (x3) ===Tool=== * [[Mortar & Pestle]] ===Beverage=== * [[Lambig Broceliande]] (Chalice) ===Light=== * [[Widow's Candle]] ===Liquid=== * [[Holiest Hemolymph]] * [[Black Sapphire Wash]] ===Material=== * [[Leathy Lees]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Dawn]] [[Category:Salon]]

Ivory Vault.title: Ivory Vault
Ivory Vault.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Ivory Vault.png |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Knock|14}} or {{Lore|Scale|14}}}} {{Quote|How did the Curia of the Isle begin? There is no evidence they began with the House of Lethe, that society of unseen immortals bound by three oaths. But this vault - much newer than the tunnels above - does seem to reference the oath called the Ivory Chain, which forbade commerce with the Hours - except, sometimes, with the winter Hour known as the Elegiast, or the Ivory Dove. Solomon Husher remarked that this might be considered less an oath of rejection of the Hours, and more an oath of loyalty to the Elegiast. But Solomon, of course, vanished into the snow.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Sealed Vault (Locked)== {{Quote|A heavy granite door sealed with white wax; a triple lock ornamented with ivory and black nephrite.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Sealed Vault" and requires {{Lore|Knock|14}} or {{Lore|Scale|14}} [[Assistance]] to access. == Contents == ===Readable=== * ''[[Kopralith Omphalos]]'' * ''[[The Sky in the Scar]]'' ===Cache=== * [[Records Box]] * [[Attaché Case]] * [[Scaled Casket]] * [[Scarred Casket]] * [[Imperial Casket]] * [[Ironclad Casket]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Gullscry Loggia.title: Gullscry Loggia
Gullscry Loggia.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Gullscry Loggia.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Rose|9}} or {{Lore|Sky|9}} |workstations=*[[Loggia Prospect]]}} {{Quote|When Baron Valentine's melancholia and his acusis became too much to bear, he began to take his meals here, with none of those sounds that he found troubling - only the wind, the sea, and the cries of his beloved birds. After the Dewulfs were gone, the Librarians of the Curia would come here when they needed to think in peace.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Squawkful Loggia (Locked)== {{Quote|Birds crowd every corner of this place, glaring at me with malevolent yellow eyes. Guano cakes the walls and feathers drift the floor. Something has drawn them here - it'll need to be dealt with. Once it has, the place will take an awful lot of cleaning.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Squawkful Loggia" and requires {{Lore|Rose|9}} or {{Lore|Sky|9}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose [[Gullscry Tower: Valentine's Room]]. ==Workstations== * [[Loggia Prospect]] ({{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Rose}}) - Can [[Evolve via Hushery]]. ==Salon== {{Main|Salon}} ''Sombre conversations where once poor Valentine sat alone. [Here one might have a Picnic, but only in Spring or Summer.]'' Gullscry Loggia can be used to host a Picnic in Spring or Summer for up to three guests. == Contents == ===Ink=== * [[Asimel]] ===Beverages=== * [[Armagnac d'Ys]] (Bottle, Glass) ===Flower=== * [[Shadowless Silk]] ===Comforts=== * [[Snug Chair]] * [[Comfortable Garden Chair]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]] [[Category:Salon]]

Iron Vault.title: Iron Vault
Iron Vault.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Iron Vault.png |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|16}} or {{Lore|Knock|16}}}} {{Quote|Where did the Curia of the Isle come from? Across the western ocean from Noon, where the Ordo Limiae made their home? That would raise more questions than it answered. But this vault would seem to be of their making, and it would also seem to reference the oath called the Iron Chain, which binds every resident of Noon, to remain hidden from the world, 'so that the Calyptra might not look upon us, so that the Chancel might not hear our names, so that the Hours might not devour us.'}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Sealed Vault (Locked)== {{Quote|A heavy iron door sealed with black wax; a triple lock of unornamented iron.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Sealed Vault" and requires {{Lore|Edge|16}} or {{Lore|Knock|16}} [[Assistance]] to access. == Contents == ===Readable=== * ''[[Amiranis Beteli]]'' * ''[[A Child's Treasury of Golden Afternoons]]'' ===Cache=== * [[Hive Casket]] * [[Morbid Casket]] * [[Coppery Casket]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Hermit Cell.title: Hermit Cell
Hermit Cell.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Hermit Cell.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|12}} or {{Lore|Moth|12}} |workstations=*[[Hermit's Workbench]] *[[Guest Bed: Hermit]] *[[Hermit's Stove]]}} {{Quote|The words RED WILLIAM are scratched into the wall by the bed-nook. This was the name of the cunning-man who laid a curse on Hendrik Dewulf, that there would be no seventh of his line - the cunning-man that Hendrik Dewulf gelded and imprisoned beneath the House.

But this doesn't look like a cell. There could have been no locks. Perhaps that other story is true - that William was an initiate of the Thunderskin, secretly maintained by Hendrik to prophesy for him 'in the ancient manner.' Who were the Dewulfs, really?}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Gaping Darkness (Locked)== {{Quote|Thunder prowls the entrance to this cave - a dying curse, or a capricious storm-spirit? It must be dealt with carefully.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Gaping Darkness" and requires {{Lore|Heart|12}} or {{Lore|Moth|12}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Gull Colony]] *[[Smuggler's Den]] *[[Boathouse]] ==Workstations== *[[Hermit's Workbench]] ({{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Moon}}) *[[Guest Bed: Hermit]] ({{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can be camped in, or used by [[Visitors]] with an interest in {{Lore|Moon}}. *[[Hermit's Stove]] == Contents == ===Books=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Baronial]]) * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Dawn]]) (x2) ===Ink=== * [[Perhibiate]] * [[Yewgall Ink]] ===Beverages=== * [[Dandelion Wine]] * [[Schloss Jannings]] (Bottle) * [[Lambig Broceliande]] (Bottle) * [[Domaine Raveline]] (Bottle x2) ===Liquid=== * [[January Sanguinary]] ===Light=== * [[Bedside Candleholder]] ===Blank=== * [[Quire of Paper]] ===Leaf=== * [[Tiny Potted Tree]] ===Material=== * [[Granite Slab]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Gull Colony.title: Gull Colony
Gull Colony.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Gull Colony.png |era=[[:Category:Open Air|Open Air]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|12}} or {{Lore|Sky|12}} |workstations=*[[The Gull-Colony]]}} {{Quote|Through all the Isle's long years, the gulls, heedless of our affairs, have taken their due from the sea and returned it to the rocks. Careful where you step.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[:Category:Open Air|Open Air]] location below [[Hush House]]. ==Shrieking Gull-Cloud (Locked)== {{Quote|The gulls have made this their kingdom, and they have grown intolerant of interlopers. We'll have to pacify or discourage them.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Shrieking Gull-Cloud" and requires {{Lore|Edge|12}} or {{Lore|Sky|12}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Earl Brian's Field]] *[[Hermit Cell]] ==Gathering== * [[The Gull-Colony]] ({{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Sky}}) [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Open Air]]

Our Lady Beneath.title: Our Lady Beneath
Our Lady Beneath.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Our Lady Beneath.png |era=[[Dawn Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Liquid]] *{{Lore|Knock|4}}, {{Lore|Moth|4}}, {{Lore|Nectar|4}} or {{Lore|Winter|4}} |workstations=*[[Altar of the Knot]]}} {{Quote|Who is 'Our Lady'? The Red Grail, which gives life, which takes life, which is not sated? The Horned-Axe, who bears two blades, who waits at the threshold, who sunders that which should not be joined? The Ring-Yew, who is succulent, who is renewed, who encompasseth? Or a fourth, who is always signified but never named?

A Librarian might phrase the question differently: who was first?}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Abandoned Church (Locked)== {{Quote|This is a holy place of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot. The Hours they worshipped are not worshipped now, but those Hours are not dead, nor even sleeping. I should not enter this place without pouring out a sufficient offering.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Abandoned Church" and requires a [[Liquid]] with {{Lore|Knock|4}}, {{Lore|Moth|4}}, {{Lore|Nectar|4}} or {{Lore|Winter|4}} to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Whispering Stair]] *[[Smuggler's Den]] *[[Narthex]] ==Workstations== * [[Altar of the Knot]] ({{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can [[Evolve via The Bosk]]. == Contents == ===Tools=== * [[Mortar & Pestle]] * [[Shears of the Sisterhood]] ===Light=== * [[Moth-Orchid-Scented Candle]] * [[Widow's Candle]] (x2) ===Materials=== * [[Gervinite]] * [[Lignum Vitae Blank]] * [[Ambergris Chunk]] * [[Quartz Chunk]] * [[Beeswax]] ===Fabric and Remains=== * [[Human Hair]] ===Fixed in Place=== * [[Aspect of the Axe: Xenodice Half-Faced]] * [[Aspect of the Grail: Lagiah, the Queen Unsated]] * [[Aspect of the Malachite: Mylissa, Queen and Palace]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Dawn]]

Lower Pump Room.title: Lower Pump Room
Lower Pump Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Lower Pump Room.png |era=[[Dawn Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Circumstance]] *{{Lore|Forge|3}} or {{Lore|Knock|3}} |workstations=*[[Pumps: Lower Level]]}} {{Quote|The Curia installed these pumps when the lower levels of the Sisterhood's holy place were already dry. Why? What were they looking for? What lies beneath Brancrug Isle that even the Sisterhood never found?}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Flooded Level (Locked)== {{Quote|Gleaming black water, still as bone. I'll need to find some way to lower the water level before I can descend.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Flooded Level" and requires a [[Circumstance]] ([[Receding Waters]]) with {{Lore|Forge|3}} or {{Lore|Knock|3}} to access. Opening it will expose the [[Columbic Crypt]]. ==Workstations== * [[Pumps: Lower Level]] ({{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Knock}}) - This [[Workstation]] is required to create a [[Circumstance]] ([[Uncovered Depths]]) to open up the [[Sea-Caves]]. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Dawn]]

Loading Dock.title: Loading Dock
Loading Dock.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Loading Dock.png |era=[[Nocturnal Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Moon|14}} or {{Lore|Rose|14}} |workstations=*[[Loading Dock Crane]]}} {{Quote|Here the supplies came in, from every continent that the seas touch - from the Bounds, and beyond. Now and then prisoners would try to escape, but the sea is always hungry.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Sagging Dock (Locked)== {{Quote|The storms have had their way with this since the prison was abandoned. It won't last much longer.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Sagging Dock" and requires {{Lore|Moon|14}} or {{Lore|Rose|14}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== * [[Loading Dock Crane]] - A place to discard objects and beasts. == Contents == ===Cache=== *[[Records Box]] *[[Abandoned Luggage]] *[[Crate of Supplies]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Nocturnal Period]]

Oubliette.title: Oubliette
Oubliette.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Oubliette.png |era=[[Nocturnal Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|15}}, {{Lore|Knock|15}}
or {{Lore|Winter|15}} |workstations=*[[Oubliette Containment]]}} {{Quote|Here in a vessel shaped by fire and fate, George Collers confined a flame in human flesh, a blazing shadow of a blazing future, a Name of greed and time. Greene called it 'the Sun's bastard grandchild.' Van Lauren warned of 'the Second Dawn's first spark'. But Collers spoke of it reverently: as 'the Leashed Flame's true heir'.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. It is the deepest part of the Cucurbit Prison. ==Incandescent Hollow (Locked)== {{Quote|Sullen heat still roils below. Its originator must be long gone, but it must be quelled before I can descend safely.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Incandescent Hollow" and requires {{Lore|Forge|15}}, {{Lore|Knock|15}} or {{Lore|Winter|15}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== * [[Oubliette Containment]] ({{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Edge}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Forge}}) - Can [[Evolve via Ithastry]]. {{Spoilers |caption=Spoilers |caption_element=h2 |content= Using the Oubliette Containment with [[Disciplines of the Hammer]] or [[Disciplines of the Scar]] allows the Librarian to find the tablet [[The Sun's Design]]. }}
[[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Nocturnal Period]]

Narthex.title: Narthex
Narthex.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Narthex.png |era=[[Dawn Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|14}}, {{Lore|Knock|14}}
or {{Lore|Scale|14}}}} {{Quote|If you were a pilgrim to the Abbey of the White Crow, you'd purify yourself here. You didn't want to track profane Dumnonian mud or alien Mare Britannicum salt into the holy precincts. Or unclean thoughts. Especially not unclean thoughts. The priestesses here were a little more merciful than the Hours they served, but only a little.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Slithering Fountain (Locked)== {{Quote|After all these years, the fountain in this hall is blocked. That's not a surprise. A little more surprising is this: the blockage appears to be mostly snakes; a great many snakes. This, no doubt, is why we have seen so few rats.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Slithering Fountain" and requires {{Lore|Edge|14}}, {{Lore|Knock|14}} or {{Lore|Scale|14}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Our Lady Beneath]] *[[Sacred Spring]] == Contents == ===Sustenance=== *[[Viper Egg]] ===Light=== *[[Aglaophotis-Scented Candle]] *[[Widow's Candle]] ===Materials=== *[[Atlantic Amber]] *[[Sea-Glass]] ===Leaf and Flower=== *[[Eva's Locks]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Dawn]]

Librarian's Quarters.title: Librarian's Quarters
Librarian's Quarters.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Librarian's Quarters.png |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|3}}, {{Lore|Heart|3}}, {{Lore|Lantern|3}} or {{Lore|Scale|3}} |workstations=*[[Guest Bed: Librarian's Quarters|Guest Bed:
Librarian's Quarters]] *[[Librarian's Quarters Fireplace]]}} {{Quote|When the Curia of the Isle acquired the deed to the abandoned Dewulf estate, Ambrose Westcott became first Librarian, and had this cosy nook constructed above the north wing to fit his preferences. His successor Kitty preferred the room next door (she lamented that the reek of Westcott's pipe remained long after his death) and her successor, Solomon Husher, preferred the Long Tower for his own chilly reasons. But most Librarians have enjoyed the peace and the sea view.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Abandoned Librarian's Quarters (Locked)== {{Quote|A bright haven on the House's seaward side, innocent of protections and menacing influences - though it'll take some work to set it right and clean it.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Abandoned Librarian's Quarters" and requires {{Lore|Forge|3}}, {{Lore|Heart|3}}, {{Lore|Lantern|3}} or {{Lore|Scale|3}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== * [[Guest Bed: Librarian's Quarters]] ({{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can be camped in, or used by [[Visitors]] with an interest in [[Lantern]]. * [[Librarian's Quarters Fireplace]] ==Contents== {| width="45%" class="table" style="text-align: left;white-space: pre;" |- !Books !Leaves |- |● [[Potted Fern]] |- |● [[Potted Avidity]] |- |● [[Potted Bamboo]] |- | | |- !Tools !Things |- |● [[Inscribed Stone]] |- | |● [[Twinned-Fish Stone]] |- |● [[Librarian's Timepiece]] |- | | |- !Lights !Busts |- |● [[Pale Bust]] |- |● [[Fringed Lamp]] !Comforts |- | |● [[Librarian's Footstool]] |- |● [[Potted White Orchid]] !Wall Art |- |● ''[['Gods Return']]'' |}
{{Spoilers |caption=Hidden items |caption_element=h2 |content=
{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table" style{{=}}"width:100%" ! Item !! How to find {{!}}- {{!}} [[Journal of Sir David Greene, 1903]] {{!}}{{!}} At floor level, click the panel that is between the foot of the stairs and the fireplace. {{!}}}
}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Map Room.title: Map Room
Map Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[Map Room.png]] |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|6}}, {{Lore|Rose|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} |workstations=*[[Desk: Vagabond]]}} {{Quote|At the turn of the century, Sir David Greene - eighth librarian and former Nocturnal Branch superintendent - had this room refurnished to plan his explorations, and to manage the operations of his many agents.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Web-Snared Room (Locked)== {{Quote|The cobwebs here are thick as ivy, clinging to the walls and furniture. Black-furred bodies rustle stickily. Van Lauren was creative here. Many of the spiders are probably only seemings, but the webs are real, and it'll be long and tiresome work clearing away the webs.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Web-Snared Room" and requires {{Lore|Heart|6}}, {{Lore|Rose|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: * [[Duelling Hall]] * [[Westcott Room]] ==Workstations== *[[Desk: Vagabond]] ({{Lore|Edge}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Rose}}, {{Lore|Scale}}) == Contents == ===Books=== *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia]]) (x3) ===Tool=== *[[Lunar Globe]] ===Ink=== *[[Catwink]] ===Flower=== *[[Vase of Roses]] ===Blank=== *[[Hallowed Anthropoderm]] ===Comfort=== *[[Greene's Red Chair]] ===Wall Art=== *''[[Caer Ys]]'' *''[['A Sacrifice']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Night Gallery.title: Night Gallery
Night Gallery.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Night Gallery.png]] |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Moon|10}} or {{Lore|Winter|10}} |workstations=*[[Nocturnary]]}} {{Quote|In the 1850s, and in deep secrecy, Natalia Brulleau built the Night Gallery into the foundations of the Gullscry Tower. Behind this heavy steel door the Curia, and later the Suppression Bureau, kept treasures too difficult for common view, but too relevant to consign to a deeper vault. If anything difficult might, hypothetically, have been inclined to creep up the stairs from below, it would also have been discouraged by that door.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Shrouded Space (Locked)== {{Quote|If the wards on this place were real, they would be heavy curtains of black velvet that stung the grazing hand. They aren't real in any meaningful sense of the word. I'll still need to dispose of them before I can enter safely.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Shrouded Space" and requires {{Lore|Moon|10}} or {{Lore|Winter|10}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Lesser Bridge]] *[[Gullscry Loggia]] *[[Vestibulum Transitus]] *[[Stair Tenebrous]] ==Workstations== * [[Nocturnary]] ({{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Moon}}) - Can [[Evolve via Skolekosophy]]. == Contents == ===Things=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia]]) * [[Urn of Ashes]] * [[Honeyscar-Scented Candle]] ===Liquids...=== * [[Gideon's Soaks]] ====... and Beverages==== * [[Leathy]] * [[Thirza's Cordials]] ===Materials=== * [[Arsenic]] * [[Rose-Pearl]] * [[Whispering Sand]] ===Busts=== * ''[['Thomas Dewulf']]'' ===Wall Art=== * ''[['Chac']]'' * ''[['A Bargain']]'' * ''[['The First End']]'' * ''[['The Boy Prays']]'' * ''[['Our Benefactor']]'' * ''[['The First Answer']]'' * ''[['Our Benefactress']]'' * ''[['Leaves in the Wind']]'' * ''[['As Above, So Below']]'' * ''[['The Wheel Still Turns']]'' * ''[['Crowcross Sands at High Tide']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Kitchen.title: Kitchen
Kitchen.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Kitchen.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} |workstations=*[[Kitchen Range: Servants]] *[[Serve Here]]}} {{Quote|'Kingsluck pie' - a beef pie with pears and cinnamon and secret ingredients - is the traditional dish of the House. It was first cooked, they say, for King Henry, when in great secrecy on St Piran's Day he came to Cornwall seeking the 'King's Metal', tin, to 'restore his Alloy'. It probably didn't happen. But the pie did.}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Ruined Kitchen (Locked)== {{Quote|Finally, signs of a fire - but it looks as if, fortunately the chimney-breast collapsed before it could spread too far. It can't be why the House was abandoned. In any case, the kitchen will need skilled labour to restore it to a usable state.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Ruined Kitchen" and requires {{Lore|Forge|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Servants' Hall]], the [[Foundry]], and the [[Pantry]]. ==Workstations== *[[Kitchen Range: Servants]] ({{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Heart}}, {{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Grail}}) *[[Serve Here]] == Contents == ===Tool=== *[[Kitchen Bowls]] ===Beverage=== *[[Dandelion Wine]] *[[Lambig Broceliande]] (Bottle) *[[Schloss Jannings]] (Bottle) *[[C&H Second Flush Assam]] (Packet) *[[Isle-Water]] (Pitcher) ===Sustenance=== *[[Cuckoo-Honey]] *[[Hen's Egg]] *[[Pickled Mushrooms]] *[[Honey]] (x3) *[[Bunch of Grapes]] ===Material=== *[[Labhitic Tincture]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Pantry.title: Pantry
Pantry.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Pantry.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|7}} or {{Lore|Nectar|7}}}} {{Quote|This room is close to the roots of the House; and so it had a troubled reputation with the servantry, who late at night might hear the pulse of an unseen drum, the buzzing of flies, voices crying out in tongues unknown... and so the servants would trade favours not to be the one to fetch spices for his Lordship's posset after dark.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Wrecked Pantry (Locked)== {{Quote|Smashed glass and shattered timber. This room can be restored, and there'll be salvageable provisions tucked away in the wreckage, but I'll need someone with strong arms and a patient heart.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Wrecked Pantry" and requires {{Lore|Heart|7}} or {{Lore|Nectar|7}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Kitchen]] *[[Servants' Quarters - South]] *[[Well]] == Contents == {| width="65%" class="table" style="text-align: left;white-space: pre;" |- !Sustenance !width=385px|Beverage !Materials |- |● [[Veiled Goddess Lapsang Souchong]] (Packet) |● [[Soft Amber Pumpkin]] |● [[Phosphorescent Scrapings]] |- |● [[C&H Second Flush Assam]] (Packet) |● [[Canned Ham]] |● [[Rose-Pearl]] |- |● [[Dawnlion Coffee]] (Packet x2) |● [[Pale Marrow]] |● [[Pickled Pilchards]] (x2) |● [[Pickled Mushrooms]] |● [[Tall Parcel]] |- |● [[Scrumpy]] |● [[Rosehip Jam]] |● [[Box of Oddities]] |- |● [[Dandelion Wine]] |- |● [[Gideon's Soaks]] |- |● [[Flour]] |- |}
[[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Mazarine Room.title: Mazarine Room
Mazarine Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Mazarine Room.png]] |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} |workstations= *[[Instrument: Quivering Double Bass|Instrument:
Quivering Double Bass]] *[[Instrument: Sunset Harp]] *[[Instrument: Hallowed Drum|Instrument:
Hallowed Drum]] *[[Instrument: Grand Piano]]}} {{Quote|'Kitty's pride, and the House's joy.' Kitty Mazarine was better known for her vocal compositions, but she was a versatile musician, and on winter evenings she'd invite visitors and villagers alike to her recitals.}} __NOTOC__
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Reeking Chamber (Locked)== {{Quote|The room reeks like a rotting reptile. The curtains ripple restlessly with the watchful presences that van Lauren left behind. Perhaps I can find someone to sing them to sleep.}}
Before unlocking, it is called "Reeking Chamber" and requires {{Lore|Heart|6}} or {{Lore|Sky|6}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Refectory]] *[[Reading Room]] ==Workstations== *[[Instrument: Quivering Double Bass]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Grail}}) - Can [[Evolve via Birdsong]]. *[[Instrument: Sunset Harp]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Moon}}) - Can [[Evolve via Birdsong]]. *[[Instrument: Hallowed Drum]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Heart}}) - Can [[Evolve via Preservation]]. *[[Instrument: Grand Piano]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Rose}}) == Contents == *''[['Kitty Mazarine']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]]

Hall of Division.title: Hall of Division
Hall of Division.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Hall of Division.png]] |era=[[Curia Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|8}} or {{Lore|Winter|8}} |workstations=*[[Mirrors]] *[[Hall of Division Fireplace]] *[[Salon|A Salon in the
Hall of Division]]}} {{Quote|Eva Dewulf first furnished this as her Hall of Division, holding feasts where the guests were selected by unusual and exacting criteria. Later, Thirza Blake, seventh Librarian, employed the speculist Poemander to add more mirrors. Lots more mirrors.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Silvered Snares (Locked)== {{Quote|The mirrors in this room teem with watchful spirits and perilous reflections. They can be mollified and banished, but only a fool would attempt a solitary exorcism of a room where all the haunts are doubled.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Silvered Snares" and requires {{Lore|Edge|8}} or {{Lore|Winter|8}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== *[[Mirrors]] ({{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}) - Can [[Evolve via Nyctodromy]]. *[[Hall of Division Fireplace]] ==Salon== {{Main|Salon}} ''Bring light back to the mirrors where once Lady Eva held court. [Here one might have Lunch in the afternoon, or Supper in the evening. A good host will provide at least one first course, one main course, one side dish and one pudding.]'' The Hall of Division can be used to host a Luncheon or Supper for up to five guests. == Contents == ===Knife=== * [[Hendrik's Blade]] ===Flower=== * [[Vase of Amaryllis]] (x2) ===Wall Art=== * ''[['Eva and Abraham, 1724']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Curia]] [[Category:Salon]]

Gullscry Tower: Valentine's Room.title: Gullscry Tower: Valentine's Room
Gullscry Tower: Valentine's Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Gullscry Tower:
Valentine's Room |image1=[[File:Gullscry Tower- Valentine's Room.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|10}}, {{Lore|Heart|10}}
or {{Lore|Sky|10}} |workstations=*[[Gullscry Workbench]]}} {{Quote|In his youth, Baron Valentine inclined to religion, and he made pilgrimages to holy sites on the Continent. After he made his final pilgrimage - to Fermier Abbey - the dreams began - of blood seeping from the earth; of a vast and pulsing Wheel crushing the temples of men; and, which troubled him most, of twisted birds, shrieking in pain, growing like fruit in the branches of an ancient yew.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Weeping Chamber (Locked)== {{Quote|Water trickles like tears from broken pipes in the ceiling, splashing over the cages that hang here. The floor is inches deep in water. The wind flutters mournfully in the cage bars.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Weeping Chamber" and requires {{Lore|Forge|10}}, {{Lore|Heart|10}} or {{Lore|Sky|10}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose [[Gullscry Tower: Eales' Room]]. ==Workstations== * [[Gullscry Workbench]] ({{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, {{Lore|Knock}}) == Contents == ===Eggs=== * [[Gull's Egg]] * [[Outsized Egg]] ===Pigments=== * [[Paint: Red]] * [[Paint: Palest Blue]] ===Wall Art=== * [['Departure']] * [['Chac']] ===Beasts...=== * [[Magnificent Green Cockatoo]] ===... and Comforts=== * [[Painter's Stool]] * [[Soft Blue Sofa]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Kitchen Garden.title: Kitchen Garden
Kitchen Garden.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Kitchen Garden.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Grail|9}} or {{Lore|Nectar|9}} |workstations= * [[Beehive]] * [[Garden]] (Grapevine) * Garden (Vegetable)(x3)}} {{Quote|In 1652, Musgrave Dewulf caught a travelling pedlar stealing vegetables from this garden - an eccentric wanderer who went by 'Ricardo Milagro'. Musgrave's ancestors would simply have hung the fellow, but Musgrave decreed seven years' service in the garden instead. When the seven years were up, Milagro had proved his worth as a gardener and chose to make Brancrug his home. The grapevines here are cultivated with rootstock he carried in his pack.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Overgrown Kitchen Garden (Locked)== {{Quote|This place has been surrendered to wind and weed. Bees buzz menacingly. Somewhere, something clucks plaintively.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Overgrown Kitchen Garden" and requires {{Lore|Grail|9}} or {{Lore|Nectar|9}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: * [[Wine Cellar]] * [[Servants' Quarters - North]] * [[Servants' Quarters - South]] * [[Well]] == Gathering == * [[Beehive]] ({{Lore|Nectar}}, {{Lore|Scale}}) * [[Garden]] (Grapevine) ({{Lore|Nectar}}) * [[Garden]] (Vegetable) ({{Lore|Nectar}}) The Beehive can be [[Gathering|Gathered]] from by using [[Health]], as well as any [[Skill]] with {{Lore|Nectar}} or {{Lore|Scale}}. The garden patches can be Gathered from by using Health or [[Chor]], as well as any Skill with {{Lore|Nectar}}. In Spring and Summer the grapevines yield a [[Bunch of Grapes]]. In Summer and Autumn the vegetable patches yield a [[Sack of Vegetables]]. == Contents == *[[Terrence, the Chicken]] *[[Tuppence, the Other Chicken]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Gardens]] [[Category:Gathering]] [[Category:Open Air]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Hidden Stair.title: Hidden Stair
Hidden Stair.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Hidden Stair.png]] |era=[[Dawn Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Moon|11}} or {{Lore|Scale|11}}}} {{Quote|After Brulleau's retirement in 1861, the Curia found itself short of promising candidates - until the arrival of Willem Harries, a former Dutch Lutheran priest and a sometime correspondent of Stanislav Schaller. He had been a missionary in the Dutch East Indies until his faith was lost or transmuted into a devotion to St Agnes of the Gate, and he was drawn to Hush House.

He won his position by presenting the Curia with a 'key long lost'. That was the key to this very stair, but only the naive would assume the key was a tangible object.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Rustling Stair (Locked)== {{Quote|Serpent-scales whisper on stone; serpent-eyes glitter in the pale window-light.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Rustling Stair" and requires {{Lore|Moon|11}} or {{Lore|Scale|11}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose: *[[Wine Cellar]] *[[Whispering Stair]] == Contents == ===Light=== *[[Beeswax Candle]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Dawn]]

Gullscry Tower: Eales' Room.title: Gullscry Tower: Eales' Room
Gullscry Tower: Eales' Room.text:
{{BoH_Room |title1=Gullscry Tower:
Eales' Room |image1=[[File:Gullscry Tower- Eales' Room.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Knock|11}}, {{Lore|Sky|11}}
or {{Lore|Winter|11}} |workstations=*[[Cage]]}} {{Quote|Eales Dewulf inherited his father Valentine's madness, and was found unfit to inherit, so his sister Eva held the Isle in his stead. When his fits of violence became uncontrollable, he was confined here in the tower, where his sister would visit him three times a week - until his escape, some time in the late 1720s. Eales's ultimate fate remains unknown.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Howling Chamber (Locked)== {{Quote|Great chunks have been torn from the walls of this room. The wind roams the place like a trapped beast, battering to and fro.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Howling Chamber" and requires {{Lore|Knock|11}}, {{Lore|Sky|11}} or {{Lore|Winter|11}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Gullscry Tower: Summit]]. ==Workstations== * [[Cage]] ({{Lore|Moth}}, {{Lore|Moon}}, {{Lore|Knock}}, {{Lore|Scale}}) == Contents == ===Books=== * [[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Baronial]]) (x2) ===Beast...=== * [[Stymphling]] ===...and Comfort=== * [[Restful Garden Chair]] ===Wall Art=== * ''[['The Watcher']]'' [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Gullscry Tower: Summit.title: Gullscry Tower: Summit
Gullscry Tower: Summit.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Gullscry Tower- Summit.png]] |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Rose|12}}, {{Lore|Sky|12}}
or {{Lore|Winter|12}} |workstations=*[[Tower-Top Prospect]]}} {{Quote|In 1721, Valentine fell - or leapt - from the tower top. There were no witnesses, and his body was not found for three days. His daughter Eva was the last to see him alive, and of their last conversation, she would say only that he had begun to fear the sun.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Screaming Summit (Locked)== {{Quote|Here the wind's rage is so great that I can barely stand upright. It forces me to retreat back to the stairs. I can hear the voice in the wind now, crying out in sorrow as great as the wind's rage.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Screaming Summit" and requires {{Lore|Rose|12}}, {{Lore|Sky|12}} or {{Lore|Winter|12}} [[Assistance]] to access. ==Workstations== * [[Tower-Top Prospect]] ({{Lore|Sky}}, {{Lore|Winter}}) - Can [[Evolve via Hushery]]. == Contents == ===Beverage=== * [[Dandelion Wine]] ===Leaf=== * [[Potted Avidity]] ===Materials=== * [[Atlantic Amber]] * [[Granite Slab]] ===Comfort=== * [[Valentine's Memorial]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Lesser Bridge.title: Lesser Bridge
Lesser Bridge.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=[[File:Lesser Bridge.png]] |era=[[Nocturnal Period]] |required_aspects=*[[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Edge|9}}, {{Lore|Forge|9}}
or {{Lore|Knock|9}}}} {{Quote|Brancrug Gaol: built in 1896 at the behest of Nocturnal Branch, to contain 'troubles unseemly and occult'. A mere six years later, after the Ortucchio Incident, the Branch came itself to be considered 'unseemly and occult', and its functions were absorbed into the Suppression Bureau. But the Gaol still stands.

Over the gate is the Bureau's motto: ALIIS SI LICET, TIBI NON LICET, commonly rendered as IT IS PERMITTED TO US; IT IS NOT PERMITTED TO YOU.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room in [[Hush House]]. ==Broken Bridge (Locked)== {{Quote|The gaol bridge still stands, but charred and twisted. It groans dangerously in the wind. A fire, then, but what fire does this? It's as if someone had trailed a match-flame along a bridge of wax.

On the far side, the gate stands wide. When the bridge is repaired, I can enter the gaol.}}
Before unlocking, it is called the "Broken Bridge" and requires {{Lore|Edge|9}}, {{Lore|Forge|9}} or {{Lore|Knock|9}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose the [[Gaol Yard]]. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Nocturnal Period]]

Keeper's Lodge.title: Keeper's Lodge
Keeper's Lodge.text:
{{BoH_Room |image1=Keeper's Lodge.png |era=[[Baronial Period]] |required_aspects=* [[Assistance]] *{{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}}
or {{Lore|Knock|1}} |workstations=*[[Guest Bed: Lodge]] *[[Lodge Fireplace]] *[[Serve Here]]}} {{Quote|For five hundred years - in the times we call Baronial, Curia, Nocturnal - there was always a keeper to watch the ways, weed the gardens, mend the roof when the sun was shining. There is no keeper now, but the Lodge's roof still weathers the storms of Brancrug Bay.}} __NOTOC__
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a room just outside of [[Hush House]]. ==Lodge at the Gate (Locked)== {{Quote|A cottage where Hush House's groundskeeper lived - until the fire. If I can get into the place and make it habitable, I can use it as a base for reclaiming more of the House.}} Before unlocking, it is called the "Lodge at the Gate" and requires {{Lore|Forge|2}}, {{Lore|Heart|1}} or {{Lore|Knock|1}} [[Assistance]] to access. Opening it will expose [[Watchman's Tower: Gatehouse]]. ==Workstations== *[[Guest Bed: Lodge]] - Can be used with {{Lore|Scale}}, {{Lore|Forge}}, {{Lore|Knock}} or {{Lore|Heart}}. *[[Lodge Fireplace]] *[[Serve Here]] ==Contents== ===Books=== *''[[Travelling at Night, vol 1]]'' *''[[Travelling at Night, vol 2]]'' *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Curia]]) *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Baronial]]) *[[Uncatalogued Book]] ([[Nocturnal Period|Nocturnal]]) === Thing === *[[C&H Second Flush Assam]] (Packet) *[[Dawnlion Coffee]] (Packet) *[[Dandelion Wine]] *[[Pillas-Oat Bread]] *[[Honeyscar-Scented Candle]] *[[Basket of Clean Linen]] *[[Shadowless Silk]] *[[Potted Dragon Tree]] *[[Hush House Key]] ===Comfort === *[[Straw-Cushioned Chair]] ===Wall Art === *[[Fractured Mirror]] *[[Shaving Mirror]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Baronial]]

Lighthouse Institute.title: Lighthouse Institute
Lighthouse Institute.text:
[[File:Behind the Scenes.png|right|160px]] {{Quote|The Curia of the Isle is long gone. Once, it helped preserve a little knowledge and a kind of safety here in Brancrug - and established the position of Librarian. Rowena, Secretary Persistent of the Curia, a complex entity who has long protected Hush House, is both exhausted and compromised... and so it's time for the Librarian to return the favour, and establish a successor to the Curia.
[Help Visitors to pursue their goals and develop their Agendas. When you've found six suitable candidates inspired by Agendas, you can suggest they found an organisation that's a worthy successor to the Curia of the Isle. If you cannot find a suitable Secretary Persistent, Rowena will continue to serve in that role, even as she continues to wane.]|Behind the Scenes}}
The '''Lighthouse Institute''' can be established in the ''[[House of Light]]'' DLC by interacting with the Lighthouse left of [[Hush House]]. Establishing the Lighthouse Institute is the starting point for the [[Endings]] added with ''House of Light''. ==Positions== There are seven positions that can be filled: {{Clear}} {| class="article-table mw-collapsible" style="width:100%" |+ style="white-space:nowrap; text-align:left"| ! Icon !! Appointment !! Description |- |[[File:Treasurer.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Treasurer''' |The Treasurer would be responsible for the Institute's finances. This would be a good excuse to ask for an an initial endowment - so they should be wealthy. |- |[[File:Secretary Salvant.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Secretary Salvant''' |The Secretary Salvant would lead the Institute's healing and restoration efforts. |- |[[File:Secretary Vigilant.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Secretary Vigilant''' |The Secretary Vigilant would ensure the Institute's safety. |- |[[File:Secretary Enigmatic.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Secretary Enigmatic''' |The Secretary Enigmatic would conceal or reveal the Institute's secrets. |- |[[File:Secretary Nunciant.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Secretary Nunciant''' |The Secretary Nunciant would communicate and negotiate with other organisations. |- |[[File:Secretary Persistent.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Secretary Persistent''' |The Secretary Persistent must not only be immortal, but must stand with one foot outside the laws of the Hours... and so she must always be a Ligeian. |- |[[File:Journal_icon.png|64px]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | '''Records''' |The Librarian will record who and where. |} The first five positions must be filled. The sixth can be left empty, leaving [[Professor Rowena Hengerst|Rowena]] as Secretary Persistent, although her powers are waning. The seventh slot takes the Librarian's [[Journal]], representing their role in the institute. ==Candidates== Each position has candidates, as laid out in the table below: {| class="article-table" style="width:100%" ! Position !! colspan="4" | Candidates |- | '''Treasurer''' || [[Mr Fraser Strathcoyne]] || [[Princess Coquille Amirejibi]] || [[Daymare|'Daymare']] || [[Magister Hokobald]] |- | '''Secretary Salvant''' || [[Mr Peter Agdistis]] || [[Black Elie|Elie's Promise]] || [[Mr Ehsan Fekri]] || [[Fr. Stanislav John Schaller]] |- | '''Secretary Vigilant''' || [[Lalla Chaima]] || [[DI Douglas Moore]] || [[Ms Azita Bukhara]] || [[Lt Arthur Thomas Moore (Ret.)]] |- | '''Secretary Enigmatic''' || [[Dr Arun Peel]] || [[Sr. Corso Reverte]] || [[Dr Yvette Southey]] || [[Mr Zachary Wakefield]] |- | '''Secretary Nunciant''' || [[Dr Serena Blackwood]] || [[Mme Olympe Bechet]] || [[Dr Ibn al-Adim]] || [[MCO Constance Lee]]/Constance Lee (if resigned) |- | '''Secretary Persistent''' || [[Mlle Margot Matutine]] || [[Mrs E]] || [[Professor Rowena Hengerst]] (default)|| |} ==Agenda, Sympathies, and Fears== In order for a candidate to be suitable, they must have the [[Inspired]] aspect, which only [[Mr Fraser Strathcoyne]] has by default; other [[Visitors]] can become inspired through [[Further Stories]]. In addition to Inspired, the [[Agenda]], [[Fear]]s, and [[Sympathy|Sympathies]] of the characters must not conflict, or the certain options during the establishment of Lighthouse Institute will be in a deadlock. Most Agendas, Fears and Sympathies are mirrored, so the Librarian simply needs to ensure that no candidates have opposing Agendas and opposing Fears or Sympathies to their planned Missions, Foes and Allies for the Institute- for example, if a character with Fear: Carapace works with Fraser Strathcoyne, who starts with Sympathy: Carapace, it's impossible to choose the Carapace Cross as an ally or a foe of the Institute. The agenda, sympathies, and fears of the chosen candidates will dictate what missions, allies, and foes can be chosen for the Insitute. {| class="article mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+ style="white-space:nowrap; text-align:left" | '''Agenda''' | {{#lst:Agenda|agenda.table}} |} {| class="article mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+ style="white-space:nowrap; text-align:left" | '''Sympathy''' | {{#lst:Sympathy|sympathy.table}} |} {| class="article mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+ style="white-space:nowrap; text-align:left" | '''Fear''' | {{#lst:Fear|fear.table}} |} ==Mission== The Missions correspond to candidates' agenda. At least one candidate needs to have an agenda for it to be an eligible mission. Each Mission has a corresponding [[Achievements|achievement]]. {| class="article-table" style="width:100%" ! Mission !! Description |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Autarchy.png|64px]] '''Autarchy''' || The Institute will learn to survive without the patronage of any Hour... so that one day, mortalkind can do the same. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Better Gods.png|64px]] '''Better Gods''' || The Institute will strive to create alternatives to the Hours - substitutes to the cosmic primalities that will be more benevolent, or more biddable. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Corrivality.png|64px]] '''Corrivality''' || The Corrivality sustains the world, literally and also metaphorically. Without the constant innovations and remaking of war, all humanity will stagnate. The Institute will ensure that does not happen. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Peace.png|64px]] '''Peace''' || In all the long-marked histories of thinkingkind, war has been an unimaginable scourge. The Institute will set itself to protecting the world from that scourge. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Revelation.png|64px]] '''Revelation''' || Knowledge can be dangerous: but ignorance is more dangerous still. The Institute will work to free all mortalkind from the tyranny of Calyptra. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Secrecy.png|64px]] '''Secrecy''' || Some knowledge is too dangerous for the common mind. Calyptra might be tyrannous, but there is a truth at its core - and even if Calyptra were to fall, the Institute would take up their burden. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Stone Consumed.png|64px]] '''Stone Consumed''' || The gods-from-Stone came before the Hours we now know. Their return would be earthquake, famine, wilderness prowling the streets. It will not be permitted. But they are resources as precious as oil or gold or the knowledge in the marrow. The Institute will study them; uncover them; repurpose them, for the benefit of all mortalkind. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Agenda- Stone Remembered.png|64px]] '''Stone Remembered''' || The Institute will unrearth, preserve, honour, recall something of the gods-from-stone, who came before the Hours we know. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Mission- Uncertain.png|64px]] '''Uncertain''' || The Institute never resolved on a mission, beyond 'to keep all mortalkind from the rocks of eternal night.' |} ==Allies and Foes== Similarly to Missions, candidates' fears and sympathies will influence the Institute's potential Foes and Allies. {| class="article-table" style="width:100%" ! Ally !! style="width:90%" | Description |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Sympathy- Carapace.png|64px]] '''The Carapace Cross''' || The Institute has resolved to forge alliances with the Carapace Cross, as their return begins. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Sympathy- Chandler.png|64px]] '''The Chandler''' || The institute has resolved to work with the Chandler... when the Chandler finally becomes manifest. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Sympathy- Reckoners.png|64px]] '''The Reckoner Lords''' || The Institute has resolved to make a mutually beneficial arrangement with the merchants of years. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Sympathy- Ys.png|64px]] '''Ys''' || The Institute has resolved that the benefits of working with Ys greatly outweigh its dangers. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Ally- None.png|64px]] '''None''' || The founders of the Institute couldn't agree on who to work with. |} {| class="article-table" style="width:100%" ! Foe !! Description |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Carapace.png|64px]] '''The Carapace Cross''' || The Institute has resolved that the returning Carapace Cross, and the changes that might come, are the most significant occult threat to mortalkind. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Chandler.png|64px]] '''The Chandler''' || The Institute has resolved that the coming Hour called Chandler is the most serious occult threat to mortalkind. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Devourers.png|64px]] '''Devourers''' || The Institute has resolved to guard mortalkind first against the perils of the hidden world: alukites, Mansus-spirits, hungry ghosts... |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Nowhere.png|64px]] '''The Nowhere Hours''' || The Institute has resolved that the all-consuming horror of the gods-from-Nowhere is the greatest threat mortalkind ever need fear. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Ys.png|64px]] '''Ys''' || The Institute has resolved that Ys, the city beyond the wave, has been left unchallenged too long: its seductions might capsize the waking world. |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Foe- None.png|64px]] '''None''' || The Institute's founders couldn't agree on the nature of the most significant occult threat. |} If there are two founders who have both Sympathy and Fear for either the Carapace Cross, the Chandler or Ys, it will result in a deadlock: {{Quote|Deadlock: founders have opposing Fear/Sympathy. We can't inaugurate the Institute with the Carapace Cross/the Chandler/Ys as either an Ally or a Foe.}} {| class="article-table" style="width:100%" ! Name !! Description |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Carapace.png|64px]] '''The Carapace Cross''' || ''One founder insisted we should embrace our kinship with the Carapace Cross; another refused to countenance any loss of our truer humanity.'' |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Chandler.png|64px]] '''The Chandler''' || ''One founder insisted we should ally with the Chandler; another was horrified at any dealings with that rising power.'' |- | style=white-space:nowrap | [[File:Fear- Ys.png|64px]] '''Ys''' || ''One founder insisted we should ally with Ys; another refused, warning of Ys' legendary and fundamental treachery.'' |} == Maximalist Mission Builds == Here are some potential ways to build for various [[Agenda]]s / Missions. These builds are an attempt at maximalist builds - i.e. maximizing matching of the selected Mission / Foe / Ally for each. These builds attempt to use a wide variety of Foes / Allies, and uses the [[Further Stories|Further Story]] for every [[Incident]] besides [[The Affair of the Oriflamme Heist]], and do throughout all these builds use all the [[Visitors]] in some capacity. These builds make the assumption that when a [[Visitor]] arrives for consultation, you will give them a book that satisfies their requirement. Most [[Visitors]] are not able to be used in [[Further Stories]] if they are not initally consulted, and it changes potential story paths. If it is assumed that a [[Visitor]] is given a particular [[Principles|Principle]] for consultation when the option to give one of two, that assumption is listed in that particular build. === Mission: Autarchy [[File:Agenda- Autarchy.png|64px]] === {| class="article-table" ! (Must be given {{Lore|Sky}} Book) |- |} == Singular Flexible Mission Build == This build is constructed such that if you follow it, you will be able to select ''any'' Mission. As some [[Fear]]/[[Sympathy]] aspects and specific [[Agenda]] aspects can conflict with each other, causing some missions to be unable to be selected, there need to be two "sub-builds" to seperate the Missions that conflict. This build make the assumption that when a [[Visitor]] arrives for consultation, you will give them a book that satisfies their requirement. Most [[Visitors]] are not able to be used in [[Further Stories]] if they are not initally consulted, and it changes potential story paths. If it is assumed that a [[Visitor]] is given a particular [[Principles|Principle]] for consultation when the option to give one of two, that assumption is listed in that particular build. As [[Agenda: Better Gods]] and [[Agenda: Autarchy]] do not conflict with any other [[Agenda]], they can be used with either of the sub-builds. === All Visitor Selections === {| class="article-table" !
